results.title: Setting Up PayFast (South Africa) As Your Payment Gateway | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: Setting Up PayFast (South Africa) As Your Payment Gateway Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000043027 For Brilliant Directories users in S outh Africa , PayFast is the recommended payment gateway solution. To configure PayFast as the payment gateway, the Merchant ID and Merchant Key from the PayFast account are required. For the most recent information about locating these credentials, refer to the PayFast documentation on this topic . Creating the PayFast Sandbox Environment Before processing live transactions, test payments can be completed using the PayFast sandbox environment. To access the sandbox, navigate to https://sandbox.payfast.co.za and sign in using the PayFast account email address. After signing in, the sandbox environment provides a Merchant ID, Merchant Key, Buyer Email, and Buyer Pass for testing purposes. These credentials should be saved, as they will be required during the test payment process. Making Test Transactions Next, select PayFast as the payment gateway in the Brilliant Directories Admin by navigating to Finance >> Payment Settings and selecting PayFast: Enter the Merchant ID and Merchant Key provided by the PayFast sandbox account, then set Enable Test Mode to Yes . After saving the credentials, a test payment can be processed. To complete a test payment, create a member account on the website using the standard registration process. The member should be redirected to PayFast and automatically logged into the test account. If automatic login does not occur, the Buyer Email and Buyer Pass provided by the PayFast sandbox account can be used to access the test account manually. After completing the test payment in PayFast, the member should be redirected back to the website and see a successful payment confirmation message. Once testing has been completed successfully and the website is ready to accept live payments, update the payment gateway settings by replacing the sandbox Merchant ID and Merchant Key with the live PayFast credentials, and set Enable Test Mode to No . Accepting Credit Cards PayFast accounts can accept both international and domestic Visa and Mastercard payments. However, PayFast account verification is required before credit card payments can be accepted. For more information, refer to the PayFast account verification documentation . Issuing Refunds PayFast does not provide an automatic or programmatic method for issuing refunds. As explained in the PayFast documentation , refunds must be requested by contacting PayFast Support. IMPORTANT NOTE: The Brilliant Directories Admin area includes an option to mark payments as refunded. When PayFast is used as the payment gateway, this option only updates the transaction status for internal reporting purposes and does not initiate an actual refund through PayFast. When processing a refund, it is recommended to first request the refund through PayFast. After the refund has been confirmed by PayFast, the invoice can then be marked as refunded using the Refund option in the Brilliant Directories Admin area. This provides an internal record that the payment was refunded. Minimum & Maximum Transaction Amounts The minimum and maximum transaction amounts available through PayFast vary depending on the account. These limits can be reviewed by navigating to Settings >> Payment Methods within the PayFast account. At the time this article was written, recently launched and verified accounts allowed Credit Card, EFT, Debit Card, and Masterpass payments with a minimum transaction amount of R 5.00 and a maximum transaction amount of R 10,000.00 per transaction. Other payment methods may have different limits. When testing transactions or configuring pricing on a website, PayFast account transaction limits should be considered to help prevent processing errors. For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . Was this article helpful and accurate? results.title: Stripe or PayPal Express/Standard? | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: Stripe or PayPal Express/Standard? Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000043160 Recommended Payment Gateway: Stripe.com Stripe is the recommended payment gateway solution for Brilliant Directories websites. Main Differences PayPal Express/Standard is an off-site payment gateway, while Stripe is an on-site payment gateway. The main differences between these payment gateways are outlined below: Feature Stripe PayPal Express/Standard Payment Experience Members complete payments directly on the website without being redirected to another platform. Members are redirected to PayPal to complete the payment. Recurring Subscription Payments Payments are automatically processed when subscriptions are due. Members may need to log in and complete additional steps when payments are due. Purchasing Leads Members can complete payments directly through the website. Members must leave the website, log in to PayPal, and complete the payment before accessing lead details. Member Experience Provides a faster and more seamless checkout experience. The additional steps may create friction during the payment process. Subscription Payments with PayPal Express/Standard Using PayPal Express/Standard as a payment gateway may result in fewer successful subscription payments due to the additional steps required from members. With PayPal Standard, each time a member's subscription payment is due, the member must log in to the website, access the Billing area, select the PayPal payment option, log in to the PayPal account, and complete the payment through PayPal. If a member wants to purchase a lead, the same process applies. The member must log in to the website, select the lead purchase, continue to PayPal, log in to the PayPal account, and complete the payment before accessing the lead details. Benefits of Using Stripe One of the main advantages Stripe provides over PayPal is that members do not need to leave the website to complete payments. When a member subscribes using Stripe, the credit card is charged automatically whenever the subscription payment is due, without requiring additional action from the member. Stripe Pricing Stripe costs the same as the free version of PayPal. Stripe has no monthly fee and uses the same per-transaction pricing structure as the free version of PayPal. Why Brilliant Directories Recommends Stripe Brilliant Directories is not affiliated with Stripe. However, based on experience with thousands of users who have connected different payment gateways, Stripe has proven to be one of the easiest payment gateways to set up, one of the most reliable options, and the solution that provides the best payment experience for website members. Setting Up Stripe For a complete walkthrough of setting up Stripe as the payment gateway, see the following guide: Setting Up Stripe . Supported Payment Gateways For more information about all currently supported payment gateways, refer to this article: Supported Payment Gateways . For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . Was this article helpful and accurate? Brand Images List Below is a full list of default brand images to be uploaded to the website. Useful Tip: To crop or resize any image, please consider using this free online tool . Visual Guide of Brand Images Full visual list of the Brand Images Tab: 1. Website Logo Image This will be the main logo of the website, it will show up on the top-left corner of the header of the website. The recommended dimensions for the logo are 450 x 70px Display Max Width Setting If the logo uploaded is too wide, the maximum width of the logo displayed on the live website can be edited by entering a numerical value in this field. AI Logo Generator Setting The AI Logo Creator helps generate logo concepts based on brand preferences and visual direction. Detailed instructions on how the feature works are available in the documentation: Website Logo AI Generator 2. Email Template Logo Image This will be the logo used in email templates, both automated emails and email campaigns. This setting also includes the option to specify the Display Width (the height will be adjusted accordingly). The recommended dimensions for the logo are 450 x 70px 3. Invoice Logo Image This will be the logo used in system invoices, images used in this section should only by JPG. The recommended dimensions for the logo are 450 x 70px 4. Favicon Image This will be the favicon for the website, this will be used across the entire front end of the website. The recommended dimensions for this image are 56 x 56px 5. Default Member Photo Image This will be the image used on member profiles that do not have an image. If the member of the directory does not upload their own image, this is the image that will be used instead. The recommended dimensions for this image 250 x 250px 6. Default Member Logo Image This will be the logo used on member profiles that do not upload their own logo. If the member of the directory does not upload their own logo, this is the logo that will be used instead. The recommended dimensions for this image 250 x 250px 7. Default Member Cover Image This will be the image used on member profiles that do not upload their own cover photo. If the member of the directory does not upload their own cover photo, this is the image that will be used instead. Very Important Note : This section will only be available if the Profile Cover Photo add-on is enabled on the site. The recommended dimensions for this image 1520 x 800px 8. Default Social Media Image This will be the image used by social media platforms in case the post completed on the website do not have their own image. The recommended dimensions for this image 1200 x 1200px 9. Member Badge Image Default image used as the badge for member of the directory, this image shows up inside member dashboards. The "Member Badge" is located in the member's dashboard. They are able to copy custom code that they can then paste on their own website to advertise that they are a member of the website. This adds credibility to their own company, and helps promote the website at the same time. The recommended dimensions for this image 250 x 250px 10. Verified Member Icon Default image used when members of the directory have been verified. The recommended dimensions for this image 100 x 100px 11. Google Map Pin Drop Image Default image used inside Google Maps, both front-end and member dashboards. The recommended dimensions for this image 25 x 42px 12. All Locations Badge Image Default image used when members of the directory are listed in all available locations. This Badge will only be available for users that have the Multi-Location Listing Add-on. In the Listing Settings, there's an option to " List in All Locations " which is set to NO by default. This image will appear on any members that have been edited to display in All Locations. This can be done in the Members » Search Members » Quick Edit Section . If this is set to YES , this member will show in the search results regardless of the location being searched, even in searches outside of their country, this will also activate the All Locations Badge on their member profile. The recommended dimensions for this image 100 x 100px 13. Post Search Results Placeholder Image Default image used when members of the directory complete posts without an image. The recommended dimensions for this image 400 x 200px For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . results.content: Setting up One Time Payments Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000043478 The following guide explains how to set up fixed one-time fees or a combined structure featuring an initial service fee paired with recurring subscriptions. This is ideal for platforms looking to implement lifetime access plans. If this is the case, follow these simple steps to set it up correctly: 1. Go to Finance » Membership Plans and click Edit: 2. If need to set up a one-time fee only, go to the "Sign Ups & Upgrades" tab. Scroll down and add the price in the "One-time setup fee" option. Leave blank the monthly, semi-yearly and yearly or type a "0". 3. Make sure the "Account type" says "Paid". About the "Preferred Payment Term" option, it doesn't matter what is chosen, it won't affect the one-time payment. 4. Then scroll down and in the "Sign Up Settings" section, make sure to select "Sign Up Email Sent" --> "Welcome-paid-member": 5. When everything has been set up, make a test by creating a new member. To do this, scroll up and click on the "Sign Up Page" button: Now, in the "Select a Payment Option" should be the amount added to the membership plan settings as a one-time payment: NOTES: If need to create a one-time fee + a recurring payment, add a price to the "One-time Setup Fee" and to the monthly, yearly, semi-yearly, and quarterly options. To learn how to set up recurring payments, check this article: Setting up Recurring Payments To create Free Membership Plans read this documentation: Setting up Free Membership Plans To edit the amounts displayed on the /join page, read these articles: Side-By-Side Pricing Plans: How To Link Membership Plans To The Price Matrix Guide 5. results.title: How To Geocode Members - Sync Members with Google Maps | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: How To Geocode Members - Sync Members with Google Maps Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000044148 What Is Geocoding? Geocoding is the process of assigning latitude and longitude coordinates to member listings based on their address data. This step is required for members to become searchable by location on the site's Google Maps-powered location search engine. The Geocoder submits each member's available location data to the Google Maps search engine, which cross-references that data against its location database and returns the most accurate coordinate match it can identify. The accuracy of the result is directly proportional to the completeness and specificity of the location data provided. ⚠ CRITICAL PREREQUISITE — Google Maps API Integration Required: The Geocode tool will not function unless the Google Maps API integration has been fully configured on the site. This must be completed before initiating any geocoding process. ? Reference: Google Maps API Setup Step 1 - Prepare Import Location Fields For geocoding to produce accurate results, the member CSV import file should be populated with the following location fields before import. Incomplete or vague location data at the import stage will result in lower coordinate accuracy and potential geocode errors that require manual correction afterward. Reference: How To Import Members Via CSV File Recommended Fields (Full Accuracy) Field Notes address1 Required for street-level precision. Without it, coordinates default to zip code, city, or state center. city Strongly recommended. zip_code Strongly recommended. state_code Use either state_code or state_name — both are not required. country_code Use either country_code or country_name — both are not required. state_name Optional if state_code is present. country_name Optional if country_code is present. ⚠ NOTE — Code vs. Name Fields: The system will geocode correctly using either the _code variants or the _name variants for state and country. When both are present, the system will use what is available. Providing both sets does not cause errors. Minimum Required Fields (Baseline Accuracy) If full location data is not available, the following three fields represent the minimum for reliable geocoding. Google Maps recognizes this combination successfully in approximately 99% of cases: city state_code country_code ⚠ NOTE — Acceptable Substitutions: In some cases, address1 alone can substitute for city , and zip_code alone can substitute for city . However, these substitutions are not guaranteed to resolve with the same reliability as the three-field minimum set above. Identifying Members Missing Coordinates Members that are missing latitude and longitude coordinates will display a red "Find Geocode" indicator next to their location in the Search Members results. These members will not appear in location-based search results until geocoding is completed. Step 2 - Launch the Batch Geocoder Tool Navigate to My Members » Search Members in the admin dashboard. Click the "Sync Members With Google Maps" button. The Batch Geocoder Tool will open. Step 3- Geocoding Options Three geocoding options are available. Each processes location data at a different level of specificity. The selection determines which address component is used as the primary coordinate reference for every member in the batch. Option Processing Speed Location Precision Recommendation Street Address Slowest Highest — uses the most specific available location data ✅ Recommended Zip / Postal Code Moderate Moderate — skips street address, uses postal code only Use if street data is unavailable City Fastest Lowest — skips street address, uses city center coordinates Use only if postal and street data are absent ⚠ CRITICAL CAUTION — Choose the Right Option Before Starting: The geocoding option selected applies to the entire batch. Street Address is the recommended option in all cases where address data was included in the import. Selecting Zip / Postal Code or City when street-level data is available will result in less precise coordinates being permanently assigned to affected listings, requiring manual correction afterward. ⚠ CRITICAL CAUTION — Processing Time: Depending on the total number of members being geocoded and the option selected, the batch process may take several minutes to complete. The process runs in the background. Do not close the browser tab or navigate away from the tool while the batch is processing, as this may interrupt the operation. Step 4- Review Geocode Errors If any member's location data is incomplete, misspelled, or does not match a recognized location in the Google Maps database, the Geocoder will flag that member as an error rather than assigning approximate coordinates. Flagged members are displayed in a list on the right side of the Geocoding module. To resolve a geocode error for an individual member: Locate the member in the error list on the right side of the module. Enter a corrected or more specific address into the address bar for that member. The location fields will auto-populate based on the corrected address entered. Confirm the updated coordinates are applied to that listing. ⚠ CRITICAL CAUTION — Manual Correction Required: Members with geocode errors will not have latitude and longitude coordinates assigned. These members will remain unsearchable by location until their location data is manually corrected and geocoded individually. Errors are not resolved automatically on subsequent batch runs unless the underlying location data in the member record is first corrected. Step 5 - Confirm Results Once the geocoding process completes, all successfully processed members will display assigned latitude and longitude coordinates in the Search Members view. Members that previously showed the red "Find Geocode" indicator will no longer display it once coordinates have been successfully assigned. results.title: Settings » Design Settings » Color Sets | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: Settings » Design Settings » Color Sets Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000044726 Understanding Color Sets Brilliant Directories recognizes that not every website owner has a background in graphic design. While some users excel at sales, business development, and operations, others may prefer a simpler approach to website design customization. To help streamline the design process, Brilliant Directories, in collaboration with its user community, has created a collection of ready-made color templates. More than 300 professionally designed Color Sets are available, providing a wide range of style options for different industries, branding preferences, and website aesthetics. To streamline the selection process, Color Sets are organized by color tags, allowing administrators to browse templates by preferred color scheme quickly. This categorization helps reduce the time required to find a suitable design and makes it easier to identify Color Sets that align with an organization's branding requirements. What Are Color Sets? The software includes a wide range of design settings that allow for fully customized color schemes and branding. Color Sets provide a simplified alternative by combining multiple design settings into predefined templates that can be applied with a single selection. Accessing Color Sets Color Set options can be found in the Admin Panel under: Settings → Design Settings → Color Sets Applying a Color Set To apply a Color Set to the website: Select the desired Color Set template. Click the Save Changes button in the upper-right corner of the Admin Panel. Refresh the website cache. For additional information, refer to Refreshing the Cache of the Website . Refresh the Admin Panel page by pressing Ctrl + Shift + R on the keyboard. Visit the website by clicking the website preview button in the upper-right corner of the Admin Panel. Finalizing the Changes Once applied, the selected Color Set will update the website's design settings based on the predefined color combination included in that template. results.title: User Consent Tools (GDPR Compliance) | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: User Consent Tools (GDPR Compliance) Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000044937 IMPORTANT NOTE: The information below is not legal advice. Please consult with an attorney that specializes in the GDPR regulation and all other regulations applicable to your website to make sure the processes of your website are in full compliance. Brilliant Directories is not liable for any violations of the GDPR or any other regulations that apply to your website. On May 25, 2018, the European Union began enforcing the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) , requiring additional requirements for websites that store and process the personal information of European Union citizens. We added a User Consent Tool to make it easier for websites using the Brilliant Directories platform to collect consent from a user before they submit potential personal data in forms and to collect and record the specific items that users of the website consent to when submitting their personal information to the site. When installed and activated, this tool will display additional checkboxes on forms that could potentially receive personal information from users of the website. These checkboxes must be checked in order for the form to be submitted, and a record of the consent will be kept along with that user's information for future reference. Collecting consent to store and process personal information is one of the listed ways to establish Lawful Basis for Processing , one of the requirements of the GDPR. In addition, this can be useful information to track for any website owner that would like to keep records of what users of the website consented to when creating their account. This is a Free Add-On and Enabled on All Websites Installation and Activation The User Consent Tools can be installed and activated by navigating to the Settings » General Settings » General tab in the Admin area of the site. If this website was created before this tool was launched, you will see an Install button here: Click on " Install " to install the feature. If the website was created after this tool was made available, or after installation, there will be a field here to activate the tool. Select " Yes " and click on " Save Changes " to activate the tool: Functionality Once this feature is enabled, consent checkboxes will automatically be added to the following places: Signup Forms (both free and paid): Upgrade Form: Update Credit Card Form: Review Form: Managing the Consent Items Consent items can easily be edited, removed, or added (up to 5 items total per form) through the Text Labels functionality of the website. To edit the Text Labels, navigate to the Admin >> Settings >> Text Labels. Once here, enter "consent" in the search field to display all of the Text Labels related to this tool. There are different sets of text labels for different purposes. Member Consent Items Used when members will submit data to the website (when members sign up, update their credit card, or upgrade): member_consent_1 member_consent_2 member_consent_3 member_consent_4 member_consent_5 Review Consent Items When a visitor to the website submits a review for a member: review_consent_1 review_consent_2 review_consent_3 review_consent_4 review_consent_5 Contact Us Consent Items When a visitor to the website submits a lead: contact_us_consent_1 contact_us_consent_2 Lead Consent Items When a visitor to the website submits a lead: lead_form_consent_1 lead_form_consent_2 Newsletter Consent Items When a visitor to the website submits a lead: newsletter_consent_1 newsletter_consent_2 The number of the text label relates to the order it will appear in the form. For example, the text in the "member_consent_1" Text Label will be the text of the first consent checkbox related to members, "member_consent_2", will be the second consent item, etc. Editing a Consent Item To edit the text of one of the existing consent items, simply search for the consent item Text Label you would like to change the content of, and edit the text directly. Adding a Consent Item To add an additional consent item, simply enter text into one of the blank consent Text Labels. For example, if member_consent_1, 2, and 3 all have text already, enter new text into member_consent_4, and it will automatically appear as a 4th checkbox for members. Removing a Consent Item To remove a consent item, simply delete the content of the Text Label, and it will no longer appear. Storing and Exporting Consent History When a user submits a form that has consent items, the name, email, date and time, and the full text of each item that was consented to will be stored in your website's database along with the user's information in JSON format. Member consent items will be stored in the users_data table in the user_consent field. Review consent items will be stored in the users_reviews table in the user_consent field. Lead consent items will be stored in the leads table in the user_consent field. All of this data can be exported at any time in SQL or CSV format by logging into the website's database and using the export tools found there. Requiring New Consent for Each Action By default, once a user has clicked on the consent checkboxes once, they will not be prompted for future actions. For example, if a member signed up and consented at that time, they will not have to consent again when upgrading or updating their credit card. However, in some use cases, a website will have the need to frequently update the consent items and store a complete history of a user's consent to those changing items over time. By setting the Advanced Setting "require_new_consent" to 1, every time a member upgrades or updates their credit card information, they will be required to consent again. This additional consent will be stored in the same field in the users_data table, added as an additional item to the JSON file. In other words, the new consent will not overwrite any existing consent, instead, it will be added to any existing consent. results.title: My Members » Search Members Overview | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: My Members » Search Members Overview Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000045147 The Search Members section is one of the most frequently used areas of the admin dashboard. It provides access to member records, filtering tools, bulk management actions, and AI-assisted member data queries, all from a single screen. To access the section: Navigate to My Members in the admin dashboard. Click Search Members . The Search Members screen is organized into four main areas: Search Filters — narrow the member list by specific criteria. Member Sidebar — toolbar containing member management tools. BD Butler Tool — AI assistant for member data queries and actions. Member Search Results Table — the list of member records matching the active filters. 1 - Search Filters A set of filters is displayed at the top of the Search Members page. These allow the administrator to narrow the member results list based on specific criteria before taking any action. Full Reference: My Members Search Members - Search Filters . 2- Member Sidebar The Member Sidebar is located in the upper right area of the Search Members page. It contains three tools for managing and importing member records. Add New Member Opens the Add New Member form, allowing the administrator to manually create a member account directly from the admin dashboard without requiring a front-end sign-up. Full Reference: How to Add Members Manually via Admin Sync Members with Google Maps Opens the Batch Geocoder tool, used to assign latitude and longitude coordinates to member records in bulk so they become searchable by location. Full Reference: How to Geocode Members List Actions Dropdown A dropdown menu containing three additional member management options. Import Members via CSV File Imports member records into the site from a CSV file. Template files and import guidelines are available in the reference article. Full Reference : How To Import Members Via CSV File Export List of Current Members Exports the currently filtered member data, including fields such as email addresses and phone numbers, into a downloadable CSV file. ⚠ ADD-ON REQUIRED — Export Member Data: This option is only available when the Export Member Data add-on is active on the site. If the add-on is not active, this option will not appear in the List Actions dropdown. Create Smart Lists from Current Results Generates a Smart List based on the filters currently active in the Search Members section. The Smart List automatically groups members who match those filter criteria. Full Reference : My Members » Smart Lists 3 - BD Butler Tool The BD Butler AI tool is located below the Member Sidebar on the right side of the Search Members page. It is designed to assist administrators with member data queries and certain member-level actions without requiring manual navigation through the dashboard. The tool can be used to ask questions about member data and to perform actions such as changing the top-level category for one or multiple members. Full Reference: BD Butler Tool 4 - Member Search Results The Member Search Results Table is displayed below the filters and sidebar. It lists all member records that match the currently active search filters. Full Reference: Member Search Results Table Sort Options The results table can be sorted using the following options: Sort Option Description Sort Name A–Z Alphabetical ascending by member name. Sort Name Z–A Alphabetical descending by member name. Sort ID Highest Members with the highest system ID shown first. Sort ID Lowest Members with the lowest system ID shown first. Sort Newest First Most recently joined members shown first. Sort Oldest First Earliest joined members shown first. Sort Most Revenue Members with the highest revenue shown first. Sort Least Revenue Members with the lowest revenue shown first. Sort Most Credits Members with the most credits shown first. Sort Least Credits Members with the fewest credits shown first. Full Reference: My Members - Search Members - Sorting Options Bulk Actions The far-left column of the results table contains checkboxes for selecting individual member records. Selected members can then have a bulk action applied to them simultaneously via the Bulk Actions dropdown. Full Reference : Bulk Actions For Search Members Section Verified Members Indicator When a member has been set to Verified status, a verified icon is displayed alongside their record in the results table. References : How to Verify a Listing · Quick Edit Module For Members Internal Notes Indicator When internal notes have been added to a member record via the Quick Edit module, a notes icon is displayed alongside that member's record in the results table. This provides a visual confirmation that notes exist without requiring the Quick Edit module to be opened. Reference : Quick Edit Module For Members For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . Was this article helpful and accurate? results.title: Detect Visitor Locations | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: Detect Visitor Locations Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000045203 Overview Enable the website to detect and grab a visitor’s geo-location. Once detected, the visitor’s location will automatically be inserted into the location search fields on the website. The Detect Visitor Locations add-on saves visitors an extra step by automatically using their current location when conducting local searches on the website. Very Important For this add-on to work, the site needs to have an SSL Certificate installed and Google Maps API Integration needs to be completed. How To Get This Add-On Websites with the VIP Add-Ons Club automatically have this add-on available: Join The VIP Add-Ons Club Purchase Individually: Detect Visitor Locations Enabling the Add-On 1. Go to Settings » Design Settings » Search Results Pages: 2. Now Enable or Disable this functionality: 3. Select the icon that will appear in the Location Search when the addon is enabled: Detect Location Permission When this add-on is enabled, an icon will display throughout any of the location-related search modules: Clicking on it will prompt the browser with this message: Once permission is given, the location will auto-populate within the location fields. Prompt Automatic Location Module By default the system will wait until the user clicks on the detect location icon to autofill the users location: However the popup can be set to automatically appear on the page when a user visits the page with the advanced setting: Prompt Visitors To Share Their Location Automatically On Page Load? System Variable: location_auto_fill_at_once Automatically prompting the user to allow the website to " Know your location " prior to clicking or completing a search: How the Add-On Works Gets the location of the user's device using the very accurate HTML5 Geolocation API (not the user's IP) Searches that location using the Google Maps Geocoding API to get the user's city as recognized by Google Maps Inputs that city into the location search fields of the site automatically When doing a search, the search is based on the center of the city that was processed using the steps above. It is not calculating distance between the user's device and the members in search results. results.title: Emails » Email Templates » New Email Template | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: Emails » Email Templates » New Email Template Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000045575 This article explains how to create a new email template from the admin area. Email templates can be created to store and reuse email messages sent from the website. This helps keep formatting, wording, and branding consistent when sending messages to members, users, or contacts. How to Create a New Email Template Go to Emails >> Email Templates . Click the New Email Template button. A blank email template editor will open. Email Template Editor Overview The new email template editor includes the main fields needed to create and save a reusable email template. The following areas can be edited: Subject Line: The subject line that will display when the email is sent. Email Content: The main body of the email template. This area can include text, headings, links, images, buttons, and other formatted content. Template Name: The internal name used to identify the template in the admin area. Important: The Template Name should be unique and should not include spaces. Use lowercase letters and dashes when creating the template name. Example: welcome-email-template Design the Email Template The email content can be created and edited using the WYSIWYG editor. The editor can be used to add and format content such as: Paragraph text Headings Links Images Buttons Spacing and layout elements For more information about using the WYSIWYG editor, see the following article: Everything About WYSIWYG Editors How to Post Images On WYSIWYG Editors Use Draggable Content Blocks The right sidebar includes Premium Content Blocks that can be added to the email template. These blocks make it easier to build a structured email layout without creating everything manually. Draggable content blocks can be used to add prebuilt content sections, formatting blocks, layout elements, and other design components to the email template. To use a draggable content block: Find the content block in the sidebar. Drag the block into the email content area. Edit the text, images, links, or styling as needed. Template Configuration Settings The sidebar includes additional settings that control how the email template is categorized and displayed. Template Category The Template Category setting determines where the template is organized in the admin area. Available template categories may include: Billing Customer Service Lead Emails My Saved Templates System Emails Select the category that best matches the purpose of the email template. Include Signature The Include Signature setting controls whether the website email signature is added to the end of the email template. When enabled, the signature will display below the email content. For instructions on editing the email signature, see the following article: How To Edit The Website Email Signature Include Default Template w/Logo The Include Default Template w/Logo setting controls whether the system’s default email wrapper and logo are included when the email is sent. Available options may include: Yes, Template + Logo Left: Includes the default email template wrapper with the logo aligned to the left. Yes, Template + Logo Center: Includes the default email template wrapper with the logo aligned to the center. Yes, Template + Logo Right: Includes the default email template wrapper with the logo aligned to the right. Yes, Template + No Logo: Includes the default email template wrapper without displaying the logo. No, Do Not Use Template or Logo: Sends the email without the default template wrapper or logo. Select the option that best matches the desired email layout. Include Unsubscribe Link The Include Unsubscribe Link setting controls whether an unsubscribe link is included in the email template. Important: The unsubscribe link cannot be removed from newsletter campaigns. Newsletter recipients must have the option to unsubscribe from future newsletter emails. For non-newsletter email notifications, this setting can be adjusted based on the type of email being created. Save the Email Template After the subject line, content, template name, and configuration settings have been added, save the email template. Review the subject line. Review the email content. Confirm the template name is unique and properly formatted. Confirm the template category and display settings. Click Save Changes . Once saved, the template will be available to use when composing emails or creating email campaigns. Use the Saved Template After the email template has been saved, it can be selected from the Template dropdown when composing an email. This allows the saved email content and settings to be reused without recreating the email from scratch. For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . Was this article helpful and accurate? results.title: Finance » Transaction History | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: Finance » Transaction History Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000046232 The Transaction History page provides the admin with an overview of the billing history and expected payments for all site members. This article explains all the features available on this page. It can be accessed by navigating to Finance » Transaction History in the admin area. The Transaction History page is organized into five tabs: Payments Received Upcoming Payments Past Due Refunded Stopped Payments Received The Payments Received tab records all payments collected from members and displays the total amount received, which matches the Finance Snapshot in the Dashboard. This total includes payments for services like leads, pay-per-posts, digital downloads, and membership subscriptions. This section provides key transaction details such as Invoice ID, date paid, member’s name, product, and amount paid (1). An Actions button (2) allows the Admin to manage invoices efficiently. Quick Actions The Actions button (1) in the far-right column opens several invoice-related options (2). Send Email Notification: Click this button to send an email notification to the member. It will display the Compose Email pop-up and the system will automatically use the invoice_payment_received email template when clicking this button under the Payments Received tab. Refund Payment: Click on this button to refund the payment to the member and label the invoice as Refunded . Mark as Unpaid: Mark this invoice as Unpaid . This is useful if the member disputes the charge with their bank or the payment is refunded directly through the payment gateway and not through the website. This enables an admin to track this billing event in the admin area in cases where it could not be tracked automatically. Changing the status of an invoice in this way will move the invoice to the appropriate tab (Upcoming Payments or Past Due, depending on when the invoice was originally due). Download Invoice: Download a copy of this invoice in PDF format. Members can also download PDF copies of invoices through their Member Dashboard in the Billing History section. End Subscription: Use this button to stop (Cancel) the subscription related to this invoice, and do not collect any future payments connected to this subscription. If there are unpaid invoices related to the Subscription, the system will cancel those invoices as well. Clicking it opens the Confirm End Subscription window, which has an optional Reason for cancelling box (up to 1,000 characters). A reason entered there is saved with the cancellation and shown on the Finance » Search Subscriptions page. Full steps: How Do I Cancel Payment Subscriptions - Orders . * Note: The End Subscription button will only appear when the invoice has an active subscription associated with it. Delete This Invoice: Delete the invoice completely from the system. This is permanent and cannot be undone. Delete Subscription: Delete the subscription completely from the system. This will not delete any invoices related to the subscription but will delete the subscription itself from the system and will not collect any new invoices related to the subscription. This is permanent and cannot be undone. It is better to choose End Subscription in most cases unless there is a specific need to delete the subscription from the system entirely. Upcoming Payments The Upcoming Payments tab displays all payments scheduled for processing within the next 14 days, making it easier to track upcoming dues and contact members if needed. Above the tab name, the total amount of upcoming payments is also shown for quick reference. In this section, the Due Date column is organized in ascending order rather than descending. Key details such as Invoice ID, status, date paid, member’s name, product (membership plan), and amount due are displayed. Quick Actions The Actions button (1) in the far-right column opens several options for the invoice (2). Send Email Notification: Click this button to send an email notification to the member. Clicking this button will display the Compose Email pop-up and the system will automatically use the invoice_reminder_notice_first template when clicking this button under the Upcoming Payments tab. Mark as Paid: It allows marking this specific member as Paid. This is used for members who pay directly by bank deposit or with other payment methods that are not the default payment gateway. This way there is a record on the site. It allows changing the status of the payment from Unpaid to Paid, if this button is used, the system will move this payment to the Payments Received tab. Download Invoice: The admin can download the invoice for this specific payment. Keep in mind that in the member's dashboard, they can also download invoices. Stop This Payment: As this payment is going to be taken in the next 14 days, it can be stopped if needed. Using this option, the subscription (order) is not going to be cancelled, it will only cancel this specific payment. End Subscription: Use this button to stop (Cancel) the subscription related to that specific payment. If there are unpaid invoices, the system will cancel them as well. Clicking it opens the Confirm End Subscription window, which has an optional Reason for cancelling box (up to 1,000 characters). A reason entered there is saved with the cancellation and shown on the Finance » Search Subscriptions page. Full steps: How Do I Cancel Payment Subscriptions - Orders . * Remember that the system will create the unpaid invoice 13 days before the next due date. Also, the End Subscription button will only appear when the invoice has an active subscription associated with it. Delete This Invoice: It will delete the invoice from the admin and member's account. Delete Subscription: This one deletes the subscription from the admin and member's account. Past Due Tab The Past Due tab displays all payments that the system was unable to process. These payments remain visible until the day after their due date. For instance, if a payment is due on the 29th and the system fails to process it, it will appear in this section until the 30th. The total amount of past-due payments is also displayed above the tab name for quick reference. In this section, key payment details such as Invoice ID, status, date paid, member’s name, product (membership level), and amount due are listed. Quick Actions An Actions button (1) on the right opens additional management options for the admin (2). Send Email Notification: Click this button to send an email notification to the member. Clicking this button will display the Compose Email pop-up and the system will automatically use the invoice_overdue_notice_first template when clicking this button under the Past Due tab. Collect Payment: Payment can be collected manually. If the payment is taken successfully, it means that there are no issues with that card, but the money couldn't be taken because the bank declined the transaction on the first attempt, insufficient funds, etc. Mark as Paid: It allows marking this specific member as Paid. This is used for members who pay directly by bank deposit or with other payment methods that are not the default payment gateway. This way, there is a record on the site. It allows changing the status of the payment from Unpaid to Paid. By using this button, the system will move this payment to the Payments Received tab. Download Invoice: Download a copy of this invoice in PDF format. Members can also download PDF copies of invoices through their Member Dashboard in the Billing History section. Stop This Payment: As this payment is going to be taken in the next 14 days, it can be stopped if needed. Using this option, the subscription (order) is not going to be cancelled, it will only cancel this specific payment. End Subscription: Use this button to stop (Cancel) the subscription related to this invoice. If there are unpaid invoices related to the subscription, the system will cancel them as well. Clicking it opens the Confirm End Subscription window, which has an optional Reason for cancelling box (up to 1,000 characters). Full steps: How Do I Cancel Payment Subscriptions - Orders . Delete This Invoice: It will delete the invoice from the admin and member's account. Delete Subscription: This one deletes the subscription from the admin and member's account. Bulk Manual Invoice Collection Since the billing system attempts to process each payment only once, unsuccessful transactions require manual follow-up. Payments can be collected manually, and members can update their credit card information if needed. There is a button at the top right that attempts to collect all selected invoices. On the Past Due tab (1), tick the checkbox next to each invoice to collect, then click Attempt to Collect All Selected Invoices (2). Updating Account Status If the status of a member is Active, but it needs to be changed manually to Past Due , the system will show this error (1) and the change is not saved: This error only appears while the advanced setting Suspend Past Due Member Accounts is ON. With it ON, the status cannot be changed from Active to Past Due unless the member has at least one past-due invoice. The setting is OFF by default. To override this setting and manually update each member's account status, the advanced setting Suspend Past Due Member Accounts needs to be set to OFF. It is on the Sign Ups & Billing tab of Settings » Advanced Settings , under Member Account Status. Refunded The Refunded Payments section displays all successful payments that have been refunded. Above the tab name, the total amount of refunded payments is shown for easy reference. This section includes key details such as the Invoice ID, status, date paid, member’s name, product (membership level), and amount refunded, allowing administrators to track and manage refunded transactions efficiently. Quick Actions An Actions button (1) on the right opens additional management options for the admin (2). Send Email Notification: Click on this button to send an email notification to the member. Clicking on this button will display the Compose Email pop-up and the system will automatically use the invoice_refund_confirmation template. Mark as Paid: It allows marking this specific member as Paid. This is used for members who pay directly by bank deposit or with other payment methods that are not the default payment gateway. This way, there is a record on the site. It allows changing the status of the payment from Unpaid to Paid, using this button the system will move this payment to the Payments Received tab. Download Invoice: Download a copy of this invoice in PDF format. Members can also download PDF copies of invoices through their Member Dashboard in the Billing History section. End Subscription: Use this button to stop (Cancel) the subscription related to this invoice. If there are unpaid invoices related to the subscription, the system will cancel them as well. Clicking it opens the Confirm End Subscription window, which has an optional Reason for cancelling box (up to 1,000 characters). Full steps: How Do I Cancel Payment Subscriptions - Orders . Delete This Invoice: It will delete the invoice from the admin and member's account. Delete Subscription: This one deletes the subscription from the admin and member's account. Stopped The Stopped Payments section displays payments that were scheduled for processing but were stopped and cancelled before completion. Above the tab name, the total amount of stopped payments is shown for easy reference. This section includes important details such as the Invoice ID, status, date paid, member’s name, product (membership plan), and amount. Additionally, an Actions button on the right allows admins to manage these payments. Quick Actions Mark as Paid: This option allows marking this specific member as Paid. This is used for members who pay directly by bank deposit or with other payment methods that are not the default payment gateways. This way, there is a record on the site. It allows changing the status of the payment from Unpaid to Paid, using this button the system will move this payment to the Payments Received tab. Download Invoice: Download a copy of this invoice in PDF format. Members can also download PDF copies of invoices through their Member Dashboard in the Billing History section. End Subscription: Use this button to stop (Cancel) the subscription related to that specific payment. If there are unpaid invoices the system will cancel them as well. Clicking it opens the Confirm End Subscription window, which has an optional Reason for cancelling box (up to 1,000 characters). A reason entered there is saved with the cancellation and shown on the Finance » Search Subscriptions page. Full steps: How Do I Cancel Payment Subscriptions - Orders . * Remember that the system will create the unpaid invoice 13 days before the next past due. Also, the End Subscription button will only appear when the invoice has an active subscription associated with it. Delete This Invoice: It will delete the invoice from the admin and member's account. Delete Subscription: This one deletes the subscription from the admin and member's account. Delete Several Stopped Invoices at Once The Stopped tab also has a checkbox next to each invoice and a select-all checkbox in the table header. To delete several stopped invoices in one step, select them and click List Actions » Delete Selected . The steps are explained in Delete Several Stopped Invoices at Once below. Member Information In all of the tabs, hovering over the member's name (1) will display information about the member along with several links to take actions on the member (2): Account Details: Links to the member's Account Details page, which contains an overview of information about the specific member. Quick Edit: Edit several attributes of the member without logging into their account. Send Email: Send an email to the member. Use an existing email template or send a custom email. Change Password: Assign a new password for the member. View Live Profile: View the live profile of the member as seen by visitors to the website. Login as Member: Login to the member's dashboard as if they logged in to their account. Payment History: See the complete billing history of this member. Delete Account: Delete the member's account completely. Billing Email Settings To configure the billing email settings, read this article: Billing Reminder Email Settings Income Reports At the top right is the "Income Reports" button, which has 3 options: Daily Income Report Monthly Income Report Recurring Income Estimator These reports cannot be downloaded. However, the tables can be selected and copied, then the information can be pasted into an Excel sheet. Report Details These reports are an estimate and exact totals may slightly differ based on the timestamp and timezone defined by the payment gateway. This report is generated in the time chosen in the General Settings >> Location Tab >> Hour of Day to Collect Recurring Payments: Settings » General Settings » Localization . Ask BD Butler Section - Revenue Insights & More The BD AI assistant is designed to analyze website financial data and provide quick answers regarding revenue, payments, subscriptions, and general website transaction history. Here's an article with more information about this: BD Butler . Transaction Search Filter Options The Transaction History includes 14 search filter options: Member name or ID# Member email address Product Name (for example; name of the membership plan or digital product purchased) Membership plan name Billing cycles Member Account Status Invoice Status Invoice ID# Subscription ID# Coupon Code name Invoice Date Range Sales Rep Name Sort by Newest or Oldest option Option Show or Hide Billing Emails Sent Billing Cycles When searching by Billing Cycles, the admin can select more than one option here: Within the Billing Cycles drop-down, there are also options to sort by three subscription statuses: Any - This will display the invoices for members that have active and ended (cancelled) subscriptions. Only Active - This will display the invoices for members that have an active subscription. Only Ended - This will display the invoices for members that have an ended (cancelled) subscription Sales Rep The Sales Rep Name option will only display if the settings are enabled. Here's an article with more details about How to Activate Sales Representative Tracking For Members . List Actions Dropdown In this section, called " List Actions ", it is possible to export data, create smart lists, and delete invoices in bulk to help organize and manage information efficiently. Export Transactions Under this dropdown, it is possible to export the currently selected results by clicking on Export Current Results. Clicking this opens the Export Transactions window. Tick the fields to export under Available Export Fields (1); the chosen fields are listed under Selected Fields (2). Then click Continue with Export (3), or Cancel Export to close the window without exporting: Available Transaction History Export Fields Member Account Status ( active ) Company Name ( company ) Credit Value ( credit ) Date Paid ( datepaid ) Email Address ( member_email ) First Name ( first_name ) Invoice ID# ( invoice_id ) Invoice Link ( invoice_link ) Invoice Status ( invoice_status ) Last Name ( last_name ) Notes ( notes ) Phone Number ( phone_number ) Product Name ( product_name ) Subscription Created Date ( subscription_created_date ) Subscription ID# ( subscription_id ) Subscription Name ( subscription_name ) Sub Total ( subtotal ) Total ( total ) User ID# ( user_id ) Billing Address ( billing_address ) For this action to appear, the Export Member Data add-on has to be enabled on the site. Transactions History Smart List It is also possible to create a Smart List of the currently selected results by clicking Create Smart List from Results. Clicking this will display a pop-up where the name of the smart list can be entered (1): The smart list will be created after clicking Yes, continue (2). A confirmation window then shows the smart list name. To open the new smart list right away, click the Go To <name of the smart list> Smart List link (1): Delete Selected Invoices can be deleted in bulk from the tabs that show a checkbox next to each invoice: Past Due , Refunded and Stopped , plus Payments Received and Upcoming Payments when the Billing Reminder Emails add-on is enabled. Deleted invoices cannot be recovered. Tick the checkbox next to each invoice to delete (1). The checkbox in the table header selects every invoice currently loaded on the page (results load 20 at a time). Click List Actions (2), then click Delete Selected (3). If no invoice is selected, the message "No Invoices Selected" appears. In the Confirm Bulk Delete window, choose one of the two options: Yes, delete invoices and subscriptions: deletes the selected invoices and the subscriptions they belong to. A subscription that still has other active invoices is kept, the same as when a single invoice is deleted. No, only delete invoices: deletes only the selected invoices and leaves every subscription untouched. Both options lead to a final Are you sure? window. Click Yes, continue to delete, or No, cancel to stop without deleting anything. When the deletion finishes, the message " Deleted! X invoice(s) deleted successfully." appears and the list reloads. If some invoices could not be deleted, the message reads " Done X of N invoice(s) deleted. Y could not be deleted." and the invoices that were not deleted remain in the list. Send Bulk Email Dropdown If the site has the "Billing Reminder Emails" Add-On , the option to send out certain bulk payment emails appears for 3 tabs: Payments Received Upcoming Payments Past Due Click here to review the emails sent out: Billing Reminder Email Templates Transaction Notes Admins have the ability to add notes to all invoice types, including Received, Upcoming, Past Due, Refunded, and Stopped invoices. Admins can also leave notes when they attempt to contact a member, which helps with tracking billing more efficiently. Click Add Note under the product name, type the note (1) and click Save Note (2). Additional Information Shown The transaction history results will also display additional information depending on the member purchase. Leads If the member purchased a lead, the row shows the lead number (1) and no View Details link. View Details (2) only appears when the payment belongs to a subscription. Pay-Per-Post Purchased Limit If the Vip Add-Ons were installed on the site and a member paid per post, the payment information will appear in the Payments Received tab as "Add a New Name of the Post Type " (1). The "Add a New" wording comes from the purchase_limit_for text label. In the screenshot below the member paid for a Classified. Coupon Codes If a member used a Coupon Code during the sign-up process, the code used in this transaction will display as a clickable Coupon Code: <code> link (1) that opens the coupon in Finance » Coupon Codes : For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . results.title: Toolbox » Form Manager | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: Toolbox » Form Manager Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000046441 The Form Manager is a core module of the Brilliant Directories platform, as it contains all forms used throughout the site. Forms allow members and visitors to submit information, making this the place to create, edit, and customize how data is collected. How to Access the Form Manager To access the Form Manager, navigate to Toolbox >> Form Manager : Default Forms Every Brilliant Directories site includes a set of default forms. These forms are labeled with a DEFAULT FORM tag: To learn more about default form types, see Default Form Types Customized Forms New websites are launched without customized forms: Once a default form is customized, it appears above the Default Forms section: To learn how to customize a form, see How to Customize a Form Bulk Actions Bulk actions are available for custom and newly created forms: To learn more about bulk actions, see Bulk Actions for Forms Form Filters Filters organize forms by status, type, alphabetical order, or last update: Filter by Status View forms that are currently active or disabled. Filter by Type: Member Listings Forms associated with membership listing sections such as Contact Details, Additional Details, or About. Filter by Type: Post Types Forms related to post types such as Classifieds, Albums, or Blog Posts. Filter by Type: General Forms not associated with listings or post types. Allowed Frontend HTML Tags Site owners can control which HTML elements are allowed in front-end forms. This setting is located under Settings >> Advanced Settings >> Allowed Frontend HTML Tags : Note: For security reasons, the following HTML elements are never allowed: <input>, <textarea>, <link>, <form>, <meta>, <applet>, <frame>, <iframe>, <script>, <style>, <base>, <body>, <html>, <object>, <?>, <?php Important Information Forms cannot be imported or exported. Advanced searching and filtering can be performed using SQL queries. The Leads Form is tied directly to the Leads System. Most changes should be made in Lead Settings . Keeping the default Get Matched form and only adding new fields is recommended, to avoid conflicts. For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . Was this article helpful and accurate? results.content: How to Create New Membership Plans - Add Free or Paid Membership Plans Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000046487 This article explains how to set up free membership plans. With a free membership plan, members do not need to pay to join the website.The same process applies to paid membership plans by configuring a sign-up price. To set this up, follow the steps below: 1. Navigate to the admin and click Finance » Membership Plans. Find the membership plan that needs to be set as "Free" and click Edit: 2. Then go to the "Sign Ups & Upgrades" tab and make sure that the "Account Type" is Free . When 'Free' is selected, the pricing options will be hidden. The only pricing option that remains visible is Price to Purchase Leads Usually, free members need to pay for leads and any other paid posts or services offered by the admin. 3. Also in the Sign Ups & Upgrades tab, make sure to select "Sign Up Email Sent" --> "Welcome-basic" and also make sure the "After Sign Up, Set Account Status As:" is set to "Inactive Account, Requires Email Verification". This way, members must verify their email addresses before their accounts become active 4. When everything has been set up, create a test member. To do this, scroll up and click the "Sign Up Page" button: The 'Select a Payment Option' section will no longer appear and the system will display this form where members can add their email and password. Additional documentation for setting up recurring payments is available here: Setting up Recurring Payments To create one-time subscriptions, read this article: Setting up One Time Payments To edit the amounts displayed on the /join page, read these articles: Side-By-Side Pricing Plans: How To Link Membership Plans To The Price Matrix Guide 5. How to Edit Public Pricing Page (the /join page) For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . results.title: 06/22/18 - Software Updates | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: 06/22/18 - Software Updates Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000046490 We made updates to several Default Widgets this week. If you have customized any of these widgets and would like to update your customized widget, you can find the latest code in the corresponding Default Widget. Please remember that if you have a custom version of any of these widgets, our latest updates have not been pushed to your website. Updates: We added a new text label for the Lead Form. Text label name: member_lead_form_send_message Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Module - Member Contact Form We fixed an issue that was causing the billing cycle of new paid members to be "Semiannually". We added support for placeholder text for the Select Dropdown field type in the Form Builder. Now Admins have the ability to delete Subscriptions and Invoices from the Transaction History page in the Admin. In order to use this new feature, navigate to Admin >> Finance >> Transaction History >> Actions. The options to Delete Subscription and Delete Invoice are now available. We fixed an issue with the Member Upgrade module that was causing the Product a member upgraded from to not be cancelled in some cases. We fixed an issue that was causing duplicate results on Search Results pages using the Insta-Load Search Results Add-On. We updated the Text Label for the County location Type in the Multi-Location Listing Add-On. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Account - Select Locations We added the ability to render Menus using a shortcode like is available for Forms and Widgets. E.g: [menu=pricing_menu] We updated the pop-up actions in the Admin. Now all Admin pages are using the most recent version of the Fancybox library, fixing conflicts with some browser extensions and providing a more unified user interface. We added Consent Management (GDPR) support for the Lead, Contact Us, and Newsletter forms. Click here for more information. Widgets Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Function - Save Form Bootstrap Theme - Module - Newsletter Actions We updated the Admin Signature field on the Admin Account Page to use the Froala Editor instead of TinyMCE (deprecated). We fixed an issue with the URL handling of the Image Import Tool in some cases. The Post Settings code boxes now have the ability to render Widgets, Menus, and Forms using shortcodes. EG: [widget=My Custom Widget]. We made a Security Update to one of the core files that loads every time a frontend page of a website is requested We added functionality to automatically terminate all Products and cancel all unpaid and past-due invoices when a member clicks the "Close my Account" button in the Member Dashboard. Also, we added the same functionality when an Admin deletes a member from the Admin are. We fixed an issue that was affecting Member Profile Pages on sites that are running legacy versions of the software. results.title: Free Trial Period | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: Free Trial Period Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000046572 Overview The Free Trial Period add-on allows administrators to offer a specified number of free days on individual paid membership plans. Depending on the website’s payment gateway and selected authorization option, members may be required to enter payment information during signup. If a member does not cancel before the trial ends, the regular membership payment becomes due. How To Get This Add-On Websites with the VIP Add-Ons Club automatically have this add-on available: Join The VIP Add-Ons Club Purchase Individually: Free Trial Period Add-On Features and Benefits : Increase paid membership signups Add a free trial period to individual membership packages. Choose how many days the trial period lasts Trial info is automatically displayed on checkout pages Payment information can be optional or required, depending on the selected authorization option and payment gateway. Members are automatically charged once their trial ends Members are not charged if they cancel before their trial ends How to Enable a Free Trial for a Membership Plan 1. Open the Membership Plan Go to Finance » Membership Plans . Click Edit for the membership plan that will offer the trial. 2. Open the Sign Ups & Upgrades Tab Select the Sign Ups & Upgrades tab. 3. Enable the Free Trial Period Two sets of options are available and can be configured independently: New Signups: For members subscribing to this plan for the first time. Plan Changes: For existing members switching from another plan to this one. For either option, set Enable Free Trial Period to Yes . 4. Specify Number of Trial Days In Number of Free Trial Days , enter the duration of the trial. For example, enter 7 to offer a seven-day free trial. Click Save Changes when the configuration is complete. Credit Card Requirements and Authorization Options Under Free Trial Additional Options , select how payment information will be handled during the free trial. The available options depend on whether the website uses an on-site or off-site payment gateway. Related Article: Supported Payment Gateways: On-Site and Off-Site Payment Gateways Off-Site Payment Gateways No credit card required for free trial: Members can begin the free trial without providing payment information. They must add a valid payment method before paid billing can begin. On-Site Payment Gateways No credit card required for free trial: Members can begin the free trial without providing payment information. They must add a valid payment method before paid billing can begin. Add credit card on file without authorization: Members must provide a credit card during signup. The card is saved but is not charged or authorized until the free trial ends. Authorize a $1.00 charge when card is required: Members must provide a credit card. A $1 authorization is processed to verify that the card is valid and active. Authorize full subscription amount when card is required: Members must provide a credit card. The full subscription amount is authorized to confirm that sufficient funds are available. The regular payment is processed when the free trial ends. What Members See at Checkout When No Credit Card Is Required Credit-card fields are hidden during checkout. The member must add a valid payment method before paid billing begins. If payment cannot be collected when the trial ends, the member is marked as Past Due . When Authorization Is Required When a credit-card authorization option is selected, the checkout form displays an authorization notice explaining how the member’s card will be handled. Customize the Authorization Message To customize the authorization title and message: Go to Settings » Text Labels . Search for Credit Card Authorization . Edit the following labels: Credit Card Authorization Title Credit Card Authorization Message Save the changes. Verify the Free Trial for New Signups After saving the membership plan, open its signup page to confirm that the free-trial information appears correctly. Go to Finance » Membership Plans . Find the configured membership plan and click Edit . Click Sign Up Page at the top of the page. In the Select a Payment Option section, confirm that the trial duration and payment start date are displayed correctly. Verify the Free Trial During a Plan Upgrade Free trials can also apply when an existing member upgrades to an eligible membership plan. The destination plan must have the free trial enabled and must be configured as an available upgrade option. When the member selects the plan from the Upgrade/Downgrade page, the trial duration and payment start date appear with the plan’s payment information: For instructions on making the plan available during an upgrade, see How to Setup Upgrade/Downgrade Options for Membership Plans . Customize the Free Trial Display Text When a free trial is enabled, the trial duration and payment start date appear during checkout: To customize this text: Go to Settings » Text Labels . Search for Free Trial . Edit the applicable labels. Save the changes. The following five labels are available for editing: Label Description Variable Name Default Text Line 1 Before Days free_trial_period_line1_before This plan includes a. Line 1 After Days free_trial_period_line1_after DAY FREE TRIAL. Line 2 Before Start Date free_trial_period_line2_before Your payment will start on.
