results.title: Account Details Section For Members | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: Account Details Section For Members Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000046936 Navigation Path: Admin Dashboard » My Members » Search Members » Actions Dropdown » Account Details The Account Details section provides a comprehensive administrative view of an individual member record. It is organized into seven tabs, each covering a distinct area of member data. The seven tabs are: Overview Transactions Subscriptions Profile Analytics Member Content Activity Member Reviews Overview The Overview tab presents a consolidated summary of the selected member's core account information, organized into the following sections: Contact Information — Displays the member's name, email address, phone number, and address details. Membership Information — Displays the member's assigned plan, account status, join date, and related account-level settings. Lead Activity Stats — Displays an at-a-glance summary of lead-related activity associated with the member's profile. Internal Admin Notes — Displays any notes entered for this member via the Internal Admin Notes field in the Quick Edit Module . These notes are visible only to administrators and are not displayed to the member or site visitors. ⚠ NOTE — Overview Is Read-Only: No fields in the Overview tab are editable from this view. To modify contact or account information, use the Quick Edit module or the member's full Edit Profile section. Transactions The Transactions tab displays the complete payment and transaction history for the selected member. The layout and data format mirrors the global Transaction History view found under Finance , but is filtered to show records belonging to the selected member only. The CC Info button allows the administrator to view and edit the credit card information on file for the selected member. Reference: CC Info The New Order button allows the administrator to create a new order for the selected member directly from within the Transactions tab. ⚠ BEHAVIORAL NOTE — Button Availability Is Conditional: The New Order button is only displayed when no active subscription exists for the member. When an active subscription is present, the transaction history is displayed without the New Order button. If a member's subscription has lapsed or was never created, the New Order button will appear in its place, allowing the administrator to initiate a new subscription for that member. Subscriptions The Subscriptions tab displays the complete subscription history for the selected member, including the active subscription record, billing cycle, next invoice date, and any coupon code applied at the time of signup (if applicable). Selecting a coupon code displayed in this tab opens the coupon's configuration details. The following subscription management actions are available via the Actions dropdown within this tab: Action Description Edit Subscription Allows modification of the member's active subscription settings. Cancel Subscription Initiates the cancellation of the member's active subscription. References: Edit Subscription · Cancel Subscription ⚠ NOTE — Cancellation Date Display: When a subscription is cancelled, the Next Invoice Date field in the subscription record is replaced by the cancellation date. This is the system's indicator that no further billing cycles are scheduled for that subscription. Profile Analytics The Profile Analytics tab displays page visit statistics for the selected member's public profile, including visit counts broken down by month, year, and total cumulative visits. ⚠ ADD-ON REQUIRED — Member Profile Analytics: This tab is only visible when both of the following conditions are met: The Member Profile Analytics add-on is active on the site. The "Enable Profile Statistics" setting is enabled within the member's assigned Membership Plan settings. If either condition is not met, the Profile Analytics tab will not appear in the Account Details section for that member. Member Content The Member Content tab displays all posts created by the selected member, including content that has not yet been published. The layout and available actions mirror the global Manage Posts view found under My Content , but is filtered to show only posts belonging to the selected member. ⚠ NOTE — Unpublished Content Is Visible Here: This tab surfaces all content records for the member regardless of publication status. Unpublished, draft, and pending posts are displayed alongside published content. This is the recommended view for auditing a specific member's full content output Activity The Activity tab displays a chronological log of all recorded activity events for the selected member. The layout mirrors the global Activity Tracker found under Dashboard , but is scoped entirely to the selected member's account. Activity records logged in this tab may include login events, profile updates, content submissions, and other system-tracked interactions associated with the member. Member Reviews The Member Reviews tab displays all reviews that have been submitted by site users for the selected member's profile. The layout mirrors the global Member Reviews view found under My Members , but is filtered to show only reviews associated with the selected member. ⚠ NOTE — Review Management: Reviews can be moderated from this tab in the same manner as the global Member Reviews section. Any moderation actions taken here apply only to reviews associated with the selected member. For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . Was this article helpful and accurate? results.title: Quick Edit Module For Members | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: Quick Edit Module For Members Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000046940 The Quick Edit section for the members can be reached by navigating to: My Members Search Members Quick Edit under Actions dropdown The Quick Edit module provides administrators with direct access to four management tabs for any individual member record without navigating away from the Search Members screen. The four tabs are: Account Details Listing Settings Member Tags Advanced Options Account Details This tab is divided into two sections: Basic Information and Contact Information . Basic Information This section controls core account-level settings for the selected member. Member ID The system displays the member's unique system-assigned ID. This field is read-only and cannot be edited. Account Status The following status values are available for assignment to a member account: Label Description Not Active Manually set by the administrator to deactivate an account. Active Member profile is visible on the front end of the site. Cancelled Applied when a member has cancelled the account. On Hold Used during manual admin approval of new signups. Past Due Applied when the member has an overdue subscription payment. Incomplete Applied when a paid signup encounters an unaccounted error; the account is created but remains unpaid. A member profile is only live and publicly visible on the site when the status is set to Active . ⚠ CRITICAL CAUTION — Status Does Not Control Billing: Changing a member's Account Status does NOT cancel or pause any active billing subscription. Billing management must be handled separately through the subscription and payment system. A member set to "Not Active" or "Cancelled" may still be actively billed if the subscription is not independently cancelled. Membership Plan Displays all Membership Plans currently configured under Finance » Membership Plans . The administrator may reassign a member to a different plan from this field. ⚠ CRITICAL CAUTION — Plan Change Does Not Affect Billing: Changing the Membership Plan assigned to a member does NOT modify or cancel the member's existing subscription. Subscription management must be handled separately. Public Listing Represents (Listing Type) Determines how the member's public profile is displayed. Two options are available: Individual / Person — Profile displays the member's profile photo combined with first and last name. Company / Organization — Profile displays the company logo combined with the company name. Top Level Category Displays all Top-Level Categories configured under My Members » Member Categories . The administrator may reassign the member's primary category from this field. Internal Admin Notes A free-text field for administrator use only. Notes entered here are not visible to the member or to site visitors. This field is intended for internal record-keeping regarding the member account. Contact Information This section contains the member's direct contact and identity information. First, Last, and Company Name Information entered in these fields is displayed directly on the member's public profile. Which fields appear publicly depends on the Listing Type setting (Individual vs. Company) configured in the Basic Information section above. Join Date The member's recorded join date can be reviewed and edited from this field. Phone Number and 2nd Phone Number Primary and secondary phone numbers for the member can be added or updated here. Email Address The member's email address can be added or updated here. ⚠ CRITICAL CAUTION — Email Is the Login Username: The email address entered in this field also serves as the member's login username. Changing this value will change the credentials required for the member to log in to the site. The affected member should be notified of any email address change. Listing Settings This tab contains visibility, location, and lead routing settings for the selected member. Parent ID ADD-ON REQUIRED — Multi-Member Manager: The Parent ID field is only available if the Multi-Member Manager add-on is active on the site. Without this add-on, this setting will not appear. When active, this field allows the administrator to assign, change, or remove a parent member ID. Assigning a parent ID converts the selected member into a sub-account under the designated parent. To assign a parent ID, click the Change Parent Member button. A dropdown search field appears, search by member ID to locate the intended parent. Select the appropriate parent member from the results. ⚠ CRITICAL CAUTION — Eligibility Restriction: Only Active members who share the same Membership Plan AND have the "Sub Accounts" feature enabled within their Membership Plan Settings will appear as assignable parent options. Members not meeting both criteria will not appear in the search results. Stock Image Libraries ⚠ ADD-ON REQUIRED — Stock Photo Library for Posts: This option is only visible if the Stock Photo Library for Posts add-on is active on the site. Homepage Featured Member Order ⚠ ADD-ON REQUIRED — Featured Members On Homepage: This setting is only available if the Featured Members On Homepage add-on is active on the site. When active, this field allows the administrator to specify the display position of the member within the homepage streaming widget. ⚠ CRITICAL CAUTION — Unique Position Enforcement: The system does not permit two members to occupy the same featured position. Verify existing position assignments before making changes. Verified Member? This toggle controls whether the member is displayed with a verified icon badge on their public listing. Setting this to Yes activates the badge display. Full reference: How To Verify A Listing List in All Locations? ⚠ ADD-ON REQUIRED — Multi-Location Listing: This setting is only available if the Multi-Location Listing add-on is active on the site. When active, this toggle determines whether the member's profile is listed across all available site locations. Max. Location Limit ⚠ ADD-ON REQUIRED — Multi-Location Listing: This setting is only available if the Multi-Location Listing add-on is active on the site. When active, this field allows the administrator to override the maximum number of locations this specific member can list, independent of what is defined in the member's Membership Plan settings. CC Lead Emails to Multiple email addresses can be entered in this field. All addresses entered will receive lead notification emails alongside the member. This is intended for use cases where a member represents a company and lead emails need to be routed to additional internal recipients such as sales representatives. Member Tags This tab allows administrators to add or remove tags assigned to the individual member record. Full reference: Member Tags & Tag Groups Advanced Options This tab contains SEO and code injection fields that apply exclusively to the selected member's individual profile page. These settings do not affect site-wide SEO configurations. ⚠ NOTE — SEO Fields Are Optional: All SEO metadata fields in this tab (Meta Title, Meta Keywords, Meta Description, Social Meta Title, Social Meta Description) can be left blank. The platform's existing SEO templates already supply valid metadata to search engines. These fields are intended for profile-specific overrides only. Listing Custom HEAD Code A custom code block that is rendered only within the <head> section of the selected member's profile page. This field does not affect any other pages on the site. Listing Custom FOOTER Code A custom code block rendered in the footer section of the selected member's profile page only. Listing Custom CSS Code Custom CSS entered here applies exclusively to the selected member's profile page. ⚠ NOTE: Do not include <style> tags in this field. The system applies the CSS directly; wrapping tags will cause rendering issues. Customize Listing URL The member's profile URL slug can be edited in this field. URLs entered here should be relative, the full site domain is not required and should not be included. The system also provides an option to fetch the URL from the active SEO template, which resets the slug to match the current SEO template configuration. Fetching the URL also applies the current name-formatting rules: apostrophes are removed, most other punctuation and spaces become hyphens, and underscores are preserved. For example, Ruby’s Clay Studio becomes rubys-clay-studio in the name portion of the URL. This differs from entering a deliberate custom URL. See How To Customize The Member Profile URL Structure for examples and when existing URLs change. ⚠ CRITICAL CAUTION — Dynamic URL Overwrite Risk: If a member later changes their location or categories, the system will automatically update their profile URL, overwriting any custom URL that was previously set. To prevent this automatic override, check the lock checkbox displayed beneath the URL field after entering a custom slug. Listing Meta Title A custom meta title for the selected member's profile page. This field is optional; the platform's SEO templates provide baseline metadata when this field is left blank. Listing Meta Keywords Custom meta keywords for the selected member's profile page. This field is optional. Listing Meta Description A custom meta description for the selected member's profile page. This field is optional. Listing Social Meta Title A custom social media meta title used when the member's profile is shared on social platforms. This field is optional. Listing Social Meta Description A custom social meta description used when the member's profile is shared on social platforms. This field is optional. For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . Was this article helpful and accurate? results.title: My Members » Member Categories | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: My Members » Member Categories Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000046949 An essential part of the directory's search experience is the ability to filter results by categories. Below, we will provide an overview of this module. For a full explanation of how categories behave on the front-end and back-end, see the Member Categories Overview article. To access member categories, navigate to My Members >> Member Categories : This section is divided into three tabs to display Top , Sub , and Sub-Sub Categories on the site: Each of these tabs will have identical functionality, where categories can be searched by keyword or ID: And can be sorted by the following options: Keep in mind that these sort order options will only apply to the Member Categories view in admin, it will not apply to how categories will display in the front-end. Category Image If needed, an image can be uploaded or removed to each category, which will be used on a streaming widget on the homepage. These images are exclusively for the homepage streaming widget and do not affect individual member profile styling. These images are used when the categories are set to display on the homepage: Displaying Top-Level and Sub-Level Categories On The Homepage Manually Add Categories One of the options to add categories is to do it manually via the Add Top Level Categories button: More information about this process: How To Add Categories Manually From The Admin Member Category Actions This dropdown includes actions like importing, exporting, and editing the code used when displaying the categories on the profile pages. Import Categories Another option to add member categories is via importing a CSV file: More information about this process: How To Import Categories Via CSV File Export Categories The existing member categories can be exported via the Member Category Actions dropdown: More information about this process: How To Export Member Categories Edit Specialties Tab Code And the Specialities tab of member profiles can be edited via the Edit Specialities Tab Code: More information about this process: How To Edit Specialities Tab Code in Member Profiles Category Name and URL Each of the category tabs will have the same display, with additional options to further edit them. The category name can be edited under the Name section: Its live URL can be edited under the Link URL section: Keep in mind that if there are two categories with the same name, the system will assign a unique URL to one of them as can be seen in the image below: Tip: While the system automatically prevents URL conflicts, we recommend keeping your category names unique to ensure clean SEO patterns and a better search experience for your visitors. Sort Order The Sort Order option will determine categories' position in the Homepage streaming widget: Displaying Top-Level Categories On The Homepage This category sort order can also be selected for category searches and drop-downs. Settings > General Settings > Search Settings > Default Category Sort Order: Lead Price by Category If the Lead Price By Category add-on is active on-site, the price can be set under the Lead Price section: Category Related Keywords If the Keywords For Categories add-on is active on-site, related keywords can be added under the Related Keywords section: Total Members per Category Under the Actions column, the total number of members in each category can be seen: If clicked on this section, the system will display the members that are in that category under the Search Members section: Category Live Page Under the Actions dropdown, the live page of the selected categories search results can be found: Delete Category The selected category can be deleted if needed. Clicking the Delete option will open a module showing an overview of the category, including any members assigned to it and any child categories it contains. Bulk Delete Categories All category tabs come with the option to delete categories in bulk. Select multiple categories manually or select all at once. Note: Selecting “All” does not select every category in the system, only the categories visible on the current page. For example, if a category list spans 3 pages, using “Select All” and then deleting will only affect the categories shown on the first page, not those on subsequent pages. Parent Category Under the Sub and Sub-Sub Level Categories tab, an additional search filter called Parent Category can be found: Reassigning Structures Currently, admins can’t reassign the category structure directly through the system settings. To make changes, the best approach is to create a CSV file with the new structure and upload it. Members assigned to the old categories will be unassigned after the update and will need to be recategorized. Admins can bulk-assign members to a Top - Level Category, but not to subcategories. For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . Was this article helpful and accurate? Yes No Send feedback Sorry we couldn't be helpful. Help us improve this article with your feedback.

results.title: Interactions » Member Reviews | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: Interactions » Member Reviews Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000046951 Member Reviews in the Admin The Member Reviews module allows administrators to manage reviews submitted through the website. From this section, reviews can be filtered, moderated, edited, and deleted, while also providing access to review settings and notification preferences. Review Filters Use the available filters to quickly locate and manage reviews. • Review Status – Filter reviews by their current status. • Overall Rating – Filter reviews based on star ratings. • Date Range – Filter reviews by submission date. • Keyword – Search reviews containing specific words or phrases. • Email Address – Search by the review submitter's email address or the member who received the review. Bulk Review Options Multiple reviews can be selected and updated at the same time. Available statuses include: Pending Accepted Declined Waiting for Admin Review Status Database Values For Developers: The corresponding values below are how review statuses are saved in the database. Pending = 0 Accepted = 2 Declined = 3 Waiting for Admin = 4 Member Review Settings A shortcut to the Review Settings module is available from the Member Reviews page. This module includes settings related to: General review settings Profile page display Search results design Notification preferences This button will open the review settings module, which is very similar to the Post Settings section of the admin. An in-depth overview of this module can be reviewed at the following link: Edit Post Settings General Settings Here are the general settings for the post type, allowing the admin to configure and customize the reviews. 1. Protect this Post Type? This option will only become available if the Members-Only Content add on is active on the site. 2. URL Permalink If desired, update the URL of the post type search results. 3. Make 'Email' and 'Name' Fields Readonly When a member writes or replies to another member's review, the system automatically fills in the name, last name, company and email fields. These fields are set to “read-only” by default. To make the fields editable, change the setting to "No" Additional Settings This section includes additional settings such as Display Map When Entering Location Information, Enable Results for Global Website Search and Trigger Webhook for Initial Save or Every Save 4 . Type of Post This will display the post type. 5. Enable Results for Global Website Search Allow the reviews to be part of the Global Website Search, Add-on is required. 6. Trigger Webhook for Initial Save or Every Save? Set when a Webhook will be triggered when a review is submitted. Profile Page Design Move to this tab to set up the information regarding how the reviews will be displayed on the member public profile. 1. Profile Page Tab Title Change the title that will be displayed on the front-end tab. 2. Profile Page Tab Order Choose the position of the profile page tab by selecting a number from the dropdown. Each position will show the name of the selected post type. All positions with no post type assigned are available to choose from. 3. Number of Posts Displayed in Tab Set the number of reviews to be displayed in the member's profile. 4. Profile Page Code The header, page loop, and footer codes of the Profile Page design can be edited. However, we do not recommend changing these options unless it's handled by a developer or someone with knowledge of web development. If desired, after updating the code, it can be switched back to default. Click on this article for more information: How to Customize the Default Post Types Code Search Results Design Edit and set up the search results settings for reviews in this section. 1. Search Results Page Title - H1 Edit the text for the post type title. 2. Search Results Page Sub-Title - H2 If desired, add a subtitle. 3. Search Results per Page This controls how many total results will appear on a search results page by default. 4. Search Results Code The option to edit the header, loop, and footer codes of the search results design is available as well. Additional Settings Different options will become available when clicking on the dropdown. 1. Pagination Display Options Select how pagination is displayed on search result pages, either standard, hidden pagination, or Insta-Load pagination using the Add-On. 2. Order Results By It controls the display order of items based on a database field. Please find more information on How To Change Search Results Sorting Options here. 3. Enable Search Results Cache Set to YES (recommended) to cache search results and load subsequent matching search results more quickly. Set to NO to always query the database for all searches. Note: This cannot be enabled if "Order Results By" is set to "Random". 4. Respect Membership Plan Search Priority? Membership Plan Search Results Priority can be set up in the Search Visibility tab on each plan. 5. Sidebar To Use Name of the Sidebar that will be displayed on the search result pages, either custom or default. 6. Sidebar Search Module Choose which search widget you would like to display in the sidebar of search results for this post type. This will only work if in the Sidebar Manager the sidebar has the Bootstrap Theme - Search Module - Dynamic Sidebar Search widget. This widget loads the search widget specified on each post type. 7. Sidebar Position on Mobile Devices Choose to display the sidebar below (Bottom), above (Top) the results on search results pages, or hide it only on mobile devices (phones and tablets). 8. Display Google Map Option on Search Results Pages Selecting "Yes" will display a map icon at the top of search results pages. Clicking on this icon will display the search results as pins on a Google Map. 9. Start Results View In Choose either list view, map view, or grid view if you have the Grid View Search Results Add-On. 10. Display Expired Posts in Search Results If YES, will display expired posts on search results pages. Notifications The main difference from other post type settings is the Notifications tab, where it is possible to enable or disable the following email notifications: Admin Notifications Notify Admin when review submitted? When enabled it will send the admin-review-notification Email Template to the Default Website Email address when a review is submitted. Notify the Admin that a review has been responded to? When enabled, send out a notification to the Admin that a review has been responded to. Member Notifications Notify Member when they receive a review?: Turning on this setting will send the recommendation-member Email Template to the member's email address when they receive a review. Please note this does not apply if admin needs to manually approve review. Submitter Notifications Notify the submitter of a review that it has been received?: Sends the recommendation-visitor Email Template to the submitter of a review after it has been received. Notify the submitter of a review that it has been approved?: Sends the recommendation-accepted Email Template to the submitter of a review after it has been published. Notify the submitter of a review that it has been responded to?: Sends the recommendation-submitter-replied Email Template to the submitter of a review after it has received a reply from the member. Review Module Review ID. Actions drop-down. ( Explained below ) Date the review was submitted. IP Address of the review submitter. It can be blocked if it ends up being a SPAM submission. Quick Edit options for the member: Actions This section will allow the admin edit or delete the review submitted: Edit review: While we do not recommend editing reviews, the option is there for all directory owners to control what gets published on the website. Delete review: One can quickly delete any undesired review on the website. Review Details The last section of this module includes the details of the review: This would include: Status Rating Overview Title Full review Name of the review submitter Email of the review submitter From here the status of the review can be changed manually: If the status is changed manually, 4 new options will show up: Do not send email notifications Email Member about this update Email Reviewer about this update Email Member and Reviewer about this update Member Reviews on the Profiles Members can leave reviews on profiles by clicking the “ Write a Review ” button. This feature allows users to share their experiences and feedback directly on the member’s profile. It will display within their profile and search results page. Leaving a Review To leave a review, visitors can visit the member's profile and click on the "Write a Review" button. Which will open up the Reviews form: Update Reviews URL By default, the slug URL of the reviews is /writeareview but if the admin wishes to update this they can follow the instructions below. To change this default URL go to: Settings > Advanced Settings > Default Member Review URL The admin can provide a new slug for the reviews. Uploading Images to a Review If the option for Image Upload With Reviews is enabled in the Membership Plan > Profile Page : The user will get to a second screen that allows them to upload images: How the Reviews will Display on Member's Profile All reviews are then shown in the "Reviews" tab and the star rating is shown above the "Write a Review" button. Reviews are displayed allowing one decimal place for review totals: Reviews will have their designated search results page /reviews where visitors can check all the reviews that have been submitted to the site: Click to View Reviews for a Specific Member As well, visitors can click directly on the overall rating to view all the reviews for a member, this can be in the Search Results or in their profiles: It will open a new page where it will display all the reviews for the member selected. Time Format of the Review The date format showing on the reviews search results page will correspond to the one selected under Settings » General Settings » Localization : For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . Was this article helpful and accurate? Yes No Send feedback Sorry we couldn't be helpful. Help us improve this article with your feedback.

results.title: Member Images: Importing Members with Profile Photos, Logos & Cover Photos | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: Member Images: Importing Members with Profile Photos, Logos & Cover Photos Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000046959 Importing members requires clean, unformatted text data (no line breaks or styling) mapping to the proper columns to ensure a successful upload. How To Import Members Via CSV File This includes the links for the images that will be uploaded with the file. Add Image URL to Import File Insert the URL for the image into the corresponding field: logo profile_photo cover_photo Currently, the import tool supports the following image formats: webp jpg / jpeg png gif Cover Photo The Profile Cover Photo add-on must be active on the website for imported cover photos to display on member profiles. Hosting Images These images can be uploaded to the Media Manager in order to guarantee a successful upload. Once the images are uploaded to the Media Manager, their URL can be grabbed by clicking on the Copy URL option: The images can also be hosted on external platforms, however, t his tool is meant to help in migrating a site from one platform to another, not to copy images from a 3rd party source without their consent. For in-depth information about the Media Manager check out this link: >> Media Manager Folder Importing Member Images Please follow these steps to import all of the images to the members that were just imported: Navigate to the Members >> Member Images: ** Important Note: This tab will only display if the system identifies recently imported images through the member import template. ** Choose an appropriate number of members to import the images of at a time in the dropdown below: Click on " Update Results ": Use the Bulk Actions checkbox to select all of the members on the page, then select Fetch from Source and Resize Photos from the dropdown menu. If prompted, check the Select All option to include all remaining records. Click the " Apply Action " button. There will be a notification that the images are being processed: Do not close the window or navigate away from the page during this process. Repeat the steps above for each page until all images have been fetched and resized. For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . Was this article helpful and accurate? results.title: 07/06/18 - Software Updates | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: 07/06/18 - Software Updates Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000047004 We made updates to several Default Widgets this week. If you have customized any of these widgets and would like to update your customized widget, you can find the latest code in the corresponding Default Widget. Please remember that if you have a custom version of any of these widgets, our latest updates have not been pushed to your website. Updates: We applied a UI update to show the "Past Due" status on the Member Dashboard when the member has a Past Due invoice and the auto_suspend_accounts advanced setting is set to 1. Widgets Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Account - Member Dashboard Bootstrap Theme - Header - Member Links Now the two buttons at the bottom of the Login Form can be controlled through a menu. You can find the new menu with the name "Login Page Links" on the Menu Manager page in the Admin area. We fixed an issue which was not allowing for an Admin to login to a member's account from the Admin area when the auto_suspend_accounts advanced setting was set to 1. We updated the Post Categories field validation in order to support the "&" symbol. We removed the ability to Clone/Delete the homepage Static Page through the Admin area to makes sites more stables and avoid user error. We also removed the "Home" option from the "Page Type" dropdown when editing a static page and made this a protected Page Type only used for the site's homepage. We removed the additional "Purchase Lead" and "Accept Lead" buttons from the Lead Preview page in the Member Dashboard to de-clutter the design.. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Account - Leads Details Page - New Lead System We added the ability to set a unique image URL to be used for the logo on PDF invoices produced by the system through the billing_logo_url Advanced Setting. This is useful for sites that need to use a logo in PDF invoices that is different from the website's logo. We fixed an issue which was affecting the normal behavior of the Google Map on the Member Profile Page when the Overview tab's "Tab Order" is set to something other than 1. For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . Was this article helpful and accurate? results.title: Content » Web Page Builder | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: Content » Web Page Builder Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000047120 A Static Page is a page that does not have any dynamic content. The website only comes with a few default static pages since the majority of the web pages are Dynamic Pages (search result pages, profile pages, and post content). Some of the most common default Static Pages include: Homepage - Can only be one Homepage Login Page Pricing Page How It Works Contact Us Page Privacy Policy Terms of Use Search By Location Search By Category Get Matched Password Retrieval It is possible to locate the existing Static Pages by going to Content > Web Page Builder: Edit Existing Pages To edit the pages, click the Edit button. Edit the Homepage The Homepage cannot be edited through the WebPage Builder; instead, it has a specific section in the Design Settings where it can be managed. To learn how to edit the Homepage, refer to this article: Homepage » Front & Back End Overview Actions Dropdown To view, clone, or delete an existing static page, hover over Actions and select accordingly: View Page Redirects the admin to the page on the front end. It shows how members and visitors see the page. Clone Page This action will clone the page exactly how it is. The admin will be required to change the Permalink since two pages cannot have the same one. Delete Click here to permanently delete the page, it cannot be recovered unless a backup is done to the site. Keyword Search Use the search field to search all web pages by keyword. Sort Options The Web Page Builder comes with a set of sort options to arrange the pages according to the selected filter. Sort by: Page ID Low - High Page ID High - Low Name A - Z Name Z - A Last Update - Ascending Last Update - Descending URL A - Z URL Z -A Filter by Access The Web Page Builder comes with a set of filter by Access options to arrange the pages according to the selected filter. Filter by Access: Any Access Level Public For Everyone Only Allow Members Digital Products Buyers Filter by Type The Web Page Builder comes with a set of filter by Type options to arrange the pages according to the selected filter. Filter by Type: Any Page Type Home Page Single Web Page Post Search Results Member Search Results Custom Widget as Web Page Password Retrieval Page Unsubscribed Page Create a New Web Page To learn how to create a new Static Page, click the link below: How to Create a New Static Page Hide Web Pages To hide a web page, change the URL to something only the site administrator would know to visit: /join_DRAFT This essentially marks the page as " unpublished " from the website. results.title: How to Create a New Static Page | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: How to Create a New Static Page Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000047125 To create a new static page for the website so the admin can add their own personal content, follow the steps below: In the Admin area go to: My Content Web Page Builder Click on" New Web Page+ ": When adding the content to this page, make sure to also set the permalink (the URL name option. e.g.: family, meet-the-team, franchise, etc.) apart from any other content. The most common areas used in this section of the admin are described in the images and points below. 1. Permalink Add a unique value with no spaces or special characters. It is important not to use the same URL structure used by the membership features as this will be a conflict in the system. Once the page has been saved, click on the "View Page" button to visit it. 2. H1 The primary title for the webpage. The size of the H1 is controlled in Design Settings in the "Search Results Design" tab. 3. H2 Subtitle for the webpage. This is also controlled in Design Settings in the "Search Results Design" tab. 4. Page Content Use the Froala Editor and its different available options to add content to the page. Use the BD Butler to design a unique page with AI. 5. Hero Section This tab enables the Hero Section. How to add a Hero Section on Static Pages 6. SEO Settings Here the SEO & Social Media settings can be configured. How To Edit The SEO & Social Media Elements Of A Static Web Page 7. Advanced These are the advanced settings used to edit further the webpage. 8. Internal Name Include the name of the page to recognize it easily in the Web Page Builder. Customize Page Level CSS Style Add custom CSS to this specific page. Customize the Page Level HEAD Tags Add custom HEAD tags to work only on this page. C ustomize Page Level Footer Javascript Add a custom footer code that will only work on this page. 9. Save Web Page When the work on the page has been completed, click on "Save Web Page" To make the new web page visible to others either add it to the main menu or add a link to an existing page that points to the new page that has been created. 9. Load Previous Versions Each time a static page is saved, a backup version is stored automatically. Brilliant Directories saves up to 10 previous versions of each page. To retrieve a previous version click on Select Revisions and a dropdown menu will appear showing all saved versions, labeled with the date and time they were saved. This will also show the email of the admin that saved this version. Select the version to be reviewed, then click Load Version to replace the current content with that version: Back to Current Once a previous version is loaded, an additional option appears, allowing the user to return to the most recent version of the page if needed. Click on " Back to Current " to revert to the current or most recent version if needed. results.title: Webpage Builder: Page Details Tab & Page Options Tab | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: Webpage Builder: Page Details Tab & Page Options Tab Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000047142 Navigate to My Content >> Web Page Builder >> then click " Edit " for the existing page or click the New Web Page button to create a new web page: Within the web page editor, the following options will be available in the sidebar: Page Details Tab This section allows users to control key attributes of a page and update its accessibility or structure. 1. Internal Nickname This is an internal reference name for the page. It is not visible to users on the front end, but it helps with organization and searchability. 2. Page Type Select the type of page you are creating. Learn more about page types here: What Page Types Can I Use? 3. Protect This Page? Enable this setting to restrict access to members only. This requires the Members-Only add-on. Page Options Tab Use this tab to customize the layout, visibility, and structure of the page using the following options. 1. Show Sidebar Choose which sidebar to display on the page. 2. Sidebar Position Set whether the sidebar appears on the left or right side of the page. 3. Sidebar Position on Mobile Devices Set where the sidebar appears when the page is viewed on a phone: Top : the sidebar is shown above the page content. Bottom : the sidebar is shown below the page content. This is the default. Hide : the sidebar is not shown on phones. This setting applies to screens narrower than 768 pixels. Tablets and phones turned sideways are usually wider than that, so they keep the desktop layout. Desktop screens are not affected. 4. Display Settings Customize the page’s appearance with these options: Full Screen Page Width Expands the page content to fill the entire width of the browser window, removing any margins. Hide Banner Ad Modules Removes any banner advertisements that would normally display on the page. Hide Header Hides the entire header section of the website on this specific page. Hide Footer Prevents the footer from appearing at the bottom of the page. Hide Top Header Menu Removes the top navigation menu from the page. Hide Main Menu Hides the main navigation menu that is typically displayed at the top of the site. Click-Enlarge Images Allows users to click images to view a larger version in a pop-up window. 5. Advanced Options These options provide more advanced control of the web page, such as search engine indexing and stylesheet behavior. Apply NoIndex, NoFollow This setting prevents the page from appearing in the sitemap and stops search engines from indexing it. If the page is set to Members Only, this option is enabled by default. More information: Members-Only Pages Disable Default CSS Stylesheets Prevents the page from inheriting the default CSS styles. Learn more: How to Override and Edit Default CSS Stylesheets Disable Screenshot Preview Prevents a screenshot preview of the page from appearing in the Web Page Builder. 6. Breadcrumbs Enable breadcrumb navigation to improve user experience. Learn more here: Common Breadcrumb Variables . The accepted format for custom breadcrumbs is: Blog | /blog > Partner | https://example.com > My Page Format rules: > — Separates each breadcrumb level. | — Assigns a URL to the breadcrumb immediately before it. Both relative URLs (such as /blog ) and absolute URLs (such as https://example.com ) are supported. How it works: The text before the | is the breadcrumb label that will be displayed. The URL after the | is the destination for that breadcrumb. Each > creates the next level in the breadcrumb trail. The final breadcrumb can be plain text without a URL if it represents the current page. Example: Blog | /blog > Partner | https://example.com > My Page This will generate the following breadcrumb trail: Home > Blog > Partner > My Page Where: Blog links to /blog Partner links to https://example.com My Page is the current page and is not linked. Note: Do not include Home in your custom breadcrumb string, as it is added automatically by the system. Pre-Made Elements Pre-built content elements are available for use in custom web pages and landing pages. They can be used to create a wide variety of custom landing pages. More info: Web Page Builder » Pre-Made Elements Additional Information Web pages can include sidebars. See: How to Create a Sidebar For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . Was this article helpful and accurate? results.title: My Members »  Search Members »  Actions Dropdown | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: My Members » Search Members » Actions Dropdown Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000047561 Navigation Path Admin Dashboard » My Members » Search Members The Actions dropdown is accessible from the Search Members results table. Each member record includes an Actions menu that provides direct access to essential account management functions. Actions Dropdown - Available Options The Actions menu contains the following options for each member record: Account Details View Live Profile Quick Edit Login as Member Compose Email Payment History Change Password Delete Account Clone Account Account Details Selecting this option displays a structured account overview for the selected member, including key profile and account-level information. Full reference: Account Details View Live Profile Selecting this option opens the member's live public-facing profile as it appears on the front end of the site. This allows administrators to verify how the profile is currently rendered for visitors. Quick Edit Selecting this option opens the Quick Edit module, which allows direct updates to member information without navigating away from the Search Members screen. Full reference: Quick Edit Login as Member Selecting this option allows the site administrator to access the selected member's dashboard view by logging in as that member. This is used for troubleshooting or verification of member-level permissions and visibility. Compose Email Selecting this option opens the Compose Email module. The selected member's email address is auto-populated in the recipient field. A message can then be drafted and sent directly from within the dashboard. Full reference: Compose Email Payment History Selecting this option opens the Payment/Transaction History view for the selected member, displaying a record of financial activity associated with that account. Full reference: Transactions Change Password Selecting this option opens the Change Password module, where a new password can be assigned to the selected member account. Delete Account Selecting this option initiates the member deletion workflow. A confirmation module appears before any data is removed, presenting the following configuration options that must be set prior to finalizing the deletion: There are a few options that need to be set before a member is deleted from the site: Delete Member - Confirms the permanent removal of the member account. Delete Profile Images and Files - Determines whether all images and files attached to the member record are also removed. Delete Member Posts - Removes all content posts published by the member. Re-assign Posts to another Member - If posts are not being deleted, this option transfers them to a designated existing member. ⚠ CRITICAL CAUTION — Irreversible Action: Member deletion is permanent. All four configuration options in the confirmation module must be deliberately reviewed before proceeding. Failure to configure the post re-assignment option when posts are retained may result in orphaned content. Clone Account Selecting this option creates a duplicate of the selected member account. The following profile data is carried over to the cloned account: Contact Details Additional Details Profile Photo, Logo, and Cover Photo About Me ⚠ CRITICAL CAUTION — Billing Data Is Not Cloned: Billing information is excluded from the cloning process. Each cloned member account requires a new subscription to be created separately in order to properly associate credit card and payment details with the new account. For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . Was this article helpful and accurate? results.content: Downloadable PDF Invoices Add-On Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000047892 Overview Invoicing can be time-consuming, but not anymore! The Downloadable PDF Invoices add-on automates the invoicing process by generating PDF invoices for the members. This add-on generates PDF invoices that the website admin and member can download. Admins and members can download invoices for offline bookkeeping, requests for payment, and more. How To Get This Add-On Websites with the VIP Add-Ons Club automatically have this add-on available: Join The VIP Add-Ons Club Purchase Individually: Downloadable PDF Invoices Add-On Features and Benefits Automatic PDF invoice generation Branded invoices with the website logo Easily download PDF invoices for offline use Automatic sequential invoice numbering Invoice status dependent on transaction status (Paid, Unpaid, Refunded or Cancelled) Using the Add-On Once the add-on is active on the site, the admin will have the option to set an Invoice Logo in General Settings > Brand Images Downloading Invoices - Admin Perspective There are 2 options to download invoices from the admin: Transaction History section The third option in the Payment History section. Transaction History In the transaction history download the invoices in the Actions dropdown: On the right side, there is the Actions button, clicking on it, and then clicking on "Download Invoice", will open a new tab and the invoice will appear as well. Member Payment History This section can be found under Members, then find the member and click on Actions >> Payment History: Downloading Invoices - Members Perspective When they login in their account, they can go to the "Billing Details" Section: In this section, they will find the Credit Card on file, the subscription History and the Payment History. In this last section they can hover over the Actions button and click on "Download Invoice": PDF Invoice Language If the language of the PDF Invoice needs to be changed, please go to Settings - General Settings - Localization and set the Default Website Language. Deactivated PDF Invoices If this add-on is deactivated this option will look like this: For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard .
