results.title: Admin Dashboard Modules | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: Admin Dashboard Modules Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000049125 This article goes over the different modules available in the Admin Dashboard. The numbers in the screenshot below match the sections of this article. Sections 11 to 13 are hidden by default (see Modules Organization), and sections 19 to 21 share the Support & Help module. 1. Setup Wizard The Start Here module lists the essential setup steps every directory website should complete for its basic configuration. Click Begin Setup Wizard to work through them. This module will remain visible until all steps are finished. Once completed, it will automatically disappear. Watching the videos provided is also a great way to get the website up and running smoothly. 2. Modules Organization The admin is able to reorganize the modules from the Admin Dashboard by clicking the Order button, dragging the modules into place, and clicking Save Changes : The admin is also able to select which modules to display by ticking them in the Modules menu. Restore Default at the bottom of the menu puts back the original modules and order: 3. Information Bar The information bar will display basic member information from the site. Member Snapshot The Member Snapshot displays the total members and the recently registered members for today, the past 7 days, and the past 30 days. Financial Snapshot The Financial Snapshot shows a summary of the Finance section, including received, upcoming, past due, and refunded payments. Moderation Tasks The New Moderation Tasks section displays a list of pending inquiries, leads, reviews, comments, posts, past-due members, and the total count of pending items. 4. Quick Links Find highly used sections of the software in the What Do You Want to Do Today? module. From here, the Admin will be able to: Add New Member / View All Members Create Newsletter / View All Newsletters Create Invoice / View All Transactions Create Post / View All Posts Create Web Page / View All Web Pages 5. My Web Pages In this section, the admin will be able to see the most recently updated Static Pages. From here the admin can decide to edit or view the web page. 6. My Post Types In this section, the admin will the the post types available on their site . From here the admin can create a new post or view the search results page of each post type. 7. My Smart Lists In this section, the admin will be able to see the Smart Lists organized by most contacts . From here the admin will be able to send a newsletter to the selected Smart list and also view the list of member in the Smart list. 8. Recent Logins / New Members Find out which members have accessed the site recently by choosing Recent Logins from the menu at the top right of the New Members module. The same menu switches back to the newest members on the site: 9. New Payments In this section, the admin will be able to see the most recent payments. This will show the latest 10 payments received. 10. New Posts In this section the admin will be able to see the latest posts that have been created by members of the site. Each item will show which post type it is, the published status and it will display the last 10 posts created on the site. 11. New Form Inquiries In this section the admin will be able to see the latest messages received via the forms on the site. New Form Inquiries , Top Revenue Contributors and Top Publishers belong to the Top Contributors group of modules, which is hidden by default. Tick Top Contributors in the Modules menu to show them. Each item will have the details of the form that was filled: 12. Top Revenue Contributors In this section, the admin will be able to see which members have generated the most revenue. It displays for each member how many payments they have made. The sorting is done by the amount of total revenue received and the admin has the ability to choose the date range. 13. Top Publishers In this section, the admin will be able to see who are the members that are creating the most posts. The admin can filter by different timeframes. 14. Most Viewed Profiles In order for these stats to show, the site will need to have the Member Profile Analytics add-on . In this section, the admin will be able to see which members have the most profile views on the site and will have the ability to filter by different timeframes. This section will display the 10 most viewed profiles. 15. Most Viewed Posts In order for these stats to show, the site will need to have the Member Profile Analytics add-on . In this section, the admin will be able to see which posts have the most views on the site and will have the ability to filter by different timeframes. This section will display the 10 most viewed posts. 16. Visitor Activity In order for these stats to show, the site will need to have the Member Profile Analytics add-on . In this section, the admin will be able to see the top 10 ways visitors engage with members who have Profile Statistics enabled, with the total number of interactions, and will have the ability to filter by different timeframes. 17. Website Analytics The website analytics section will display analytics such as signups, logins, leads, reviews, posts, and comments. The admin will be able to select a timeframe and whether the results should be displayed daily, weekly, or monthly. The admin will be able to choose between the Website Analytics and the Financial Analytics. The Financial Analytics includes information such as Payments , Refunds , Upcoming , Past Due and Stopped . The Top Membership Plans section shows all the membership plans and how many members are in each membership plans: 18. My Website Resources This section keeps track of the website resources such as storage, bandwidth, email limits, and much more! Member Count Indicates the number of members in the directory. Available Storage Space The website includes 5GB–10GB of free storage space and monthly bandwidth, depending on the plan selected. The Disk space is the data stored in the site which includes images, files, database, etc. Adding more images or data takes space in your disk usage so deleting some of these, can make the usage go down. If the website is reaching the monthly bandwidth and/or storage limits, this add-on will increase both by 10GB: Website Storage Boost . Monthly Bandwidth Usage This is the total amount of data – such as images, movies, photos, videos and other files – that are sent (upload) or received (download) over a specific period of time. For further information please see: How Bandwidth And Storage Usage Is Calculated . If the website is reaching its monthly bandwidth and/or storage limits, this add-on will increase both by 10GB: Bandwidth Boost Add-on . Daily Emails Sent All Website Plans are allocated 1,500 daily email sends (45,000 free emails each month – for life). If the website is easily reaching the daily limit, this can be increased by acquiring the Email Limit Boost service. Email Unblock Tool This message will only display if the default email is blocked. If this message displays, click Click to Unblock Email Address . Make sure that the email account exists as this is the most common reason emails get blocked. When using our default setup if an error message response displays after attempting to unblock, make sure to contact support. Google Map API Status This card checks the Google Maps keys and has two rows. Website key covers maps and location search on the website. It is tested with Google from the admin first; when the key is restricted to the website's own domain, the test runs again on the site's live domain, the way visitors use the key, and that result is the one shown. Server key covers member geocoding and imports and is tested from the server. Each row shows its own result: green when Google accepts the key, or a specific problem such as Billing problem on your Google project , Google does not recognise this key , Maps JavaScript API is not enabled , or a domain restriction problem. Red means Google reported a real problem with the key. Amber ( Maps blocked on this admin page ) appears only when Google refused the key on the admin address and the live-domain test could not run, because the site has no connected live domain or the domain could not be reached; check the website's own maps directly in that case. Otherwise a restricted key shows a definite green ( Maps work on your website ) or red (such as Google refuses your key on your website ). Clicking a row opens a details window with the explanation, numbered fix steps, and Google Cloud Console and Test key buttons. The keys and the Use Places API (New) switch can also be edited there and are tested with Google before saving. A red result also shows a Google Maps Error button at the top of every admin page, which clears itself once the key works. For the full list of results and fixes, see Google Maps Issues: Index and the Google Maps Troubleshooting folder. Cleanup Tools The Cleanup Tools menu at the top of the My Website Resources module helps reduce disk and bandwidth usage as well as optimize the website's performance. Delete Unused Images If there are any temporary image files stored on the site that are using up disk space that are no longer needed, clicking this button will remove them. Delete Temporary Files If there are any temporary files stored on the site that are using up disk space that are no longer needed, clicking this button will remove them. Delete Old Export Files This option appears only when the Export Tool Add-On is active. The tool removes the Exports that the Export Tool Add-On creates. Delete Backup Files The tool removes the backups created in cPanel to clean up some space. 19. Software Updates We are updating the platform every day, make sure to update the site frequently. Click on the g reen "Check For Updates" button to see if there are any updates available to install. 20. Other Help Resources Quickly access the Solutions Center to find documentation articles that explain how to use the different sections of the software. Support Documents Search the BD knowledge base to quickly find answers. To get the full list of articles visit the Documentation Center . Create Support Tickets Our Support Team is here to help, submit a ticket , and get assistance within 24 hours. Get Immediate Help in the Admin Account Dashboard Facebook Group The Community Forums and Facebook Group are also a great way to connect with other directory owners, get tips, recommendations and workarounds. 21. Facebook Group Access Join Our Community Experts for Help & Advice. We highly recommend joining our Facebook Group . Connect and talk with different website owners and get their recommendations and help with all sorts of questions, from strategy to marketing and more. Take advantage of our Free Training Workshops to learn lots of great tips. For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . results.title: 09/07/18 - Software Updates | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: 09/07/18 - Software Updates Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000049152 We made updates to several Default Widgets this week. If you have customized any of these widgets and would like to update your customized widget, you can find the latest code in the corresponding Default Widget. Please remember that if you have a custom version of any of these widgets, our latest updates have not been pushed to your website. Updates: We updated the UI of viewing a lead as a member so that free leads show the cost as "Free" rather than "$0". Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Account - Leads Details Page - New Lead System We updated the Post Settings >> Type of Data field in order to reduce the number of options available there. We made an update so that the "Reviews" feature Search Results URL will now be included in sitemap files generated by the Sitemap Generator Add-On. We fixed an issue which was affecting the "Posted by" Member link on Post Search Results pages when the Insta-Load Search Results Add-On is active. We created a new Setting in order to control the list of pages that should be "public" when the Members Only Content Add-On is active on a Site. To use this new feature, navigate to Admin >> Settings >> General Settings under the Members Only setting. Widgets Involved: Bootstrap Theme - HEAD We fixed an issue which was affecting the Login functionality of the One-Click Social Login Add-On when the Login Form is set to be displayed on the Homepage. We fixed an issue that was affecting the Sync Button in the Member Dashboard when the One-Click Social Login Add-On is active. We fixed an issue which was causing the Admin Only option for the Monthly Price set in the Product Settings to not work correctly for upgrades in some cases. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Account - Upgrade Page 1 We updated the functionality of editing Email Templates so that it is impossible to create 2 custom templates with the same name, which can cause a conflict when the template is referenced by the system. results.content: Finance » Membership Plans - Search Visibility Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000049274 In this article, we will go over all the settings available in the "Search Visibility" tab: Set Visibility Rules Section 1. Are These Members Searchable on the Website? This setting determines whether these members are searchable (appear on search result pages) on the website If YES, these members will display in search results for users that are permitted to view them. If NO, these members will not appear in any search results. 2. Can Unregistered Visitors View These Members? This setting is used when the site is "Members Only" and unregistered visitors can or can't view these listings on search results pages. If YES, these members will display on search result pages for users that are not logged in. If the site needs to be members only, please refer to this article: Members-Only Content 3. Members-Only Access This setting provides more granular control over member profile pages where site owners can hide individual pages of a member profile. This setting will only be available if the Members-Only Content add-on is active on a site. If there is a custom widget preventing this setting from working properly, the system will display the name of the custom widget: 4. Hide Member Profile from Search Engine s? If YES, the system adds a 'nofollow, noindex' directive to the member's listing page. Keep in mind that this is only for search engines. 5. Add "NOFOLLOW" to Member Web Links? If set to YES, web links on member profile pages will have the "NOFOLLOW" attribute. Keep in mind that this is only for search engines. The nofollow tag tells search engines to not follow that link. So search engine bots will skip those links when they crawl the site. 6. Search Results Priority Order in which members with this account level will appear in search results. 0 is the highest priority. For example: If this is the most expensive membership, it is recommended setting this to "0". This way this membership plan appears first on search result pages. 7. Max. Sub-Level Categories Member Can Select This setting defines the maximum number of categories a member can be listed in. This will include top-level, sub-level, and sub-sub level categories. For example: If this value is set to 10. Members in this membership will only select up to 10 categories total, including top-level, sub-level, and sub-sub-level categories. Enter 'all' to automatically list members in all the available sub-categories. Enter ' unlimited' to allow members to select as many categories as they wish. 8. Membership Plan Search Results URL This option allows a unique URL to be assigned to this membership plan.. Each URL needs to be unique and cannot be repeated across plans. If a URL is already specified and saved, a quick link will appear to visit the page while logged in as an administrator: It is NOT possible to use the slug "pro" as it will break this feature. If the word "pro" needs to be used, please enter "pro-plan" to resolve this issue. Multi-Location / Service Area Settings 1. Location Types Member Can Select Select the types of locations this member can be listed in. The options are: Country, State, County, City, and Zip Code. These options are available only if this an add-on Multi-Location Listings is active. 2. Maximum Number of Locations Maximum geographic locations a member can list in. Type 'all' to auto list members in all locations. NOTE: If this field is not available on the site, it is because this is an add-on called: Multi-Location Listings . Highlight Member Profiles Important Note: This is an add-on must first be activated on the site. More information about this add-on can be found here . Enable Search Results Highlight? This add-on highlights members of specific membership plans within the member search result pages of the website. It changes the design such as the border, the border color, text color, border width, the displayed text, the font size, text position, and the border radius. Example: Hidden Member Profile Settings Important Note: This is an add-on that needs to be activated first on-site. More information about this add-on can be found here . Select which other members these members can search for: The easiest way to determine which options to select is to answer the following question: "Who can these members search for?" Select the checkboxes that answer this question. If all options are selected or all options are deselected, these members can search for all valid listings. results.content: How to Remove the Leads/Send Message Links from the Website Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000049682 This guide explains how to disable member-to-member messaging and remove lead generation forms from your website. Disable the "Send Message" Feature: The first step is to prevent members from receiving messages and leads through their profile pages. Navigate to Membership Plans: Go to Finance → Membership Plans . Locate the membership plan you want to edit. Click Edit . Disable the Send Message Form: Open the Profile tab. Locate the setting Show "Send Message" Buttons & Forms . Set this option to No . Do the same on all of the Membership Plans. Then go to the Profile tab, find "Make a Connection" / "Claim Listing" Banner Position . Select " Hide - Do Not Display " to hide the send message link. Do the same on all of the Membership Plans. After updating these settings, the messaging forms and buttons will no longer appear on member profile pages. Important: Repeat this step for every membership plan that should not allow messaging. Remove the "Get Matched" Page Lastly, it is also important to remove the Getmatched Page. Go to My Content >> Web Page Builder >> Locate the " Get Matched " page and click on Delete . Once deleted, visitors will no longer be able to access the Get Matched page on the website. results.title: Changing a Members Password | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: Changing a Members Password Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000049987 There are four methods through which a member's password can be changed or reset on a Brilliant Directories site: Via the Admin Dashboard — the administrator sets a new password directly on the member record. Via the Member Dashboard — the member changes their own password from their front-end account area. Via the Password Retrieval Link — the member requests a reset email from the /login/retrieval page. Method 1 — Via the Admin Dashboard The administrator can manually set a new password for any member from within the Search Members section of the admin dashboard. To change a member's password via the admin dashboard: Navigate to My Members » Search Members . Locate the target member in the results table. Click the Actions dropdown for that member's record. Select Change Password from the dropdown options. The Change Password module will appear. Enter the new password in the module. Save the change. Method 2 — Via the Member Dashboard Members can change their own password independently from within their front-end member dashboard. No administrator action is required for this method. To change a password via the member dashboard: The member logs in to the site and accesses their member dashboard. The member navigates to the password change area within the dashboard. The member enters and saves a new password. Method 3 — Via the Password Retrieval Page Every Brilliant Directories website includes a default password retrieval page accessible at /login/retrieval . Members can use this page to request a password reset email if their current password has been forgotten. To reset a password via the retrieval page: The member navigates to the site's /login/retrieval page. The member enters their registered login email address in the field provided. The member clicks "Get My Password" . The system sends a password reset email to that address. The member opens the email and clicks the reset link. The reset link redirects the member to a page where a new password can be set. The /login/retrieval Page in the Web Page Builder The /login/retrieval retrieval page is a standard web page managed through the Web Page Builder, and is editable in the same way as all other site pages. Navigation Path: Admin Dashboard » My Content » Web Page Builder ⚠ NOTE — Page Not Appearing in Web Page Builder: If the /login/retrieval page does not appear in the Web Page Builder, an installer is available to restore it. The installer option will be visible within the Web Page Builder interface. The retrieval page contains the [widget=Bootstrap Theme - Member Login Page] widget, which controls the password retrieval functionality on the page. This widget can be reviewed and configured from within the Web Page Builder like any other page widget. Reference: Content » Web Page Builder Customizing the Password Retrieval URL The default /login/retrieval URL can be changed to a custom path if needed. This setting is managed from within Advanced Settings. Navigation Path: Admin Dashboard » Settings » Advanced Settings Reference: Settings » Advanced Settings For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . results.title: Managed SSL/HTTPS Security Certificate | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: Managed SSL/HTTPS Security Certificate Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000050089 Managed SSL/HTTPS Security Certificate SSL encrypts traffic between the website and its visitors and allows the public website and payment pages to use HTTPS on the connected domain. How to Get Managed SSL Managed SSL is included with qualifying add-on packages and can also be purchased as the Managed SSL Security Add-On . Connect the Domain First The live domain must point to the website before a certificate can be issued. See How to Connect a Domain to a Brilliant Directories Website . Installation and Status When managed SSL is already active, Domain Manager requests a new certificate as part of Switch Over . Open Settings > Domain Manager > SSL to review its status and select Check again after DNS changes. If managed SSL is purchased after the domain is connected, open the SSL tab and use the installation action shown there. Issuance can take time while the domain and DNS are verified. Example certificate status on a directoryup.com website. Custom-domain certificate details and available actions depend on the website configuration. Custom HTAccess rules: SSL activation can regenerate the HTAccess file. Back up any custom rules before installation and confirm them afterward. A manually installed third-party certificate follows a different renewal process. See Install 3rd Party SSL . results.content: Everything About Froala WYSIWYG Text Editor Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000050711 WYSIWYG is an acronym for "what you see is what you get". In computing, a WYSIWYG editor is a system in which content can be edited in a form closely resembling its appearance when printed or displayed as a finished product, such as a printed document, web page, or slide presentation. WYSIWYG editors can be found in multiple locations both on the admin side and on the front end throughout the BD platform. Admin Section Froala These are the areas of the admin dashboard that contain Froala editors. Web Page Builder My Content --> Web Page Builder --> Click “New Webpage” OR “Edit” on the preferred webpage WYSIWYG editor options are highlighted below: Forms Inbox Emails → Forms Inbox → Click on “Reply” WYSIWYG editor is highlighted down below Compose Emails Emails → Compose Emails WYSIWYG editor is highlighted down below Email Templates Emails → Email Templates → Click “New Email Template” OR “Edit” OR “Customize” WYSIWYG editor is highlighted down below: Note: Use BD Butler to create a distinctive email design with AI. Front-end Froala The only access website members have to the WYSIWYG editor is through website Posts . * Posts are anything that members can post via their member dashboard. Click HERE for additional information. On the image below there is an example of how the editor displays to members when creating a Product post. In-depth Look & Features All the sections of the software mentioned above have a WYSIWYG editor. As per default settings, the posts use a Public Version Froala, which means some features will be different from the Admin Froala. To learn more about the different Froala versions, click on this article FROALA Text Editor: Versions and their Upload Functionalities HTML 5: The Froala Rich Text Editor is built respecting and taking advantage of HTML 5 standards. CSS 3: What better way to improve user experience than using CSS 3? Subtle effects make the editor even greater. Keyboard Shortcuts Shortcuts enable users to activate specific commands using only the keyboard. Bold : Ctrl + B Italic : Ctrl + I Underline : Ctrl + U Strikethrough : Ctrl + S Increase Indent: Ctrl + ] Insert Link : Ctrl + K Insert Image : Ctrl + P Undo : Ctrl + Z Responsive Design Content will be responsive. Easily upload images and edit them using the additional Image Options. Click on the following article for more details and information on How to Post Images On WYSIWYG Editors Font Family Select the desired font family. This option will only be available in the admin Froala editor. Learn more here: FROALA Text Editor: Versions and their Upload Functionalities Basic Styling Basic styling, such as bold and italic are built-in in the main code. Perfect for a simple WYSIWYG HTML editor. Font Size Change the font size with pixel precision. No more "small", "medium", "large" and nothing between them. Color Picker Change the text or background color as desired by selecting from the color palette. The color palette will also have up to 9 custom colors pre-selected to match the Main Website Colors selected through the Color Sets or Design Settings. Code View This option will allow users that have knowledge about HTML more control when it comes to creating content. Table This functionality allows adding tables to the content of a web page. Each cell has its own FROALA editor options: Click on these helpful articles for more information on Tables: Froala Editor - Tables Web Page Builder: How Tables, Columns and Rows Behave on Mobile Devices Line Height This option is available to change the spacing between lines of text. Clear Format This option removes styles and formatting when pasting text from another source. After pasting the text highlight it and click on the "Clear Formatting" button to remove styles. Icon Picker Add different icons using this Froala option. This is only available on the admin Froala, click here to learn more: FROALA Text Editor: Versions and their Upload Functionalities Insert Link & Button To add a link select the "insert a link" option and add the information as needed. Once the link has been added, it's possible to make it a button. Click on the style option and choose the preferred button: To learn more about the color of the buttons, click on the following article: Default Button Link Colors Example For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . results.content: Settings » General Settings » Integrations Tab Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000050980 This article explains the Integrations Tab in the General Settings Tab and all the settings within this tab. This section of the admin area is used to set up different API keys and add-ons. Important: A live domain needs to be connected before editing this section of the admin. Notes For new sites launched using a directoryup.com subdomain, test mode credentials for the ReCaptcha and Google Maps API are already active. Once the site is switched to a real domain, these test credentials will stop working, and new credentials will need to be configured. To learn more about this, please follow this link: directoryup.com Subdomain Test Credentials There is an option to VIEW these settings, but in order to edit the settings, a domain must be connected. To learn how to set the domain live, please follow this link: How To Move The Site To A Live Domain Visual Guide of the Integrations Tab Integrations Once the site is connected to a live domain, the following can be edited: 1. Block Spam Keywords This is a comma separated list of keywords to block form submissions on sign up pages and public forms. To learn more about this click here: Spam Form Protector Add-On TIP : Add keywords in "quotes" to target exact matches rather than any partial match (more specific targeting) 2. Google Analytics Google Analytics ID Enter Google Analytics 4 ID. Format G-XXXXXXX. To learn more about Google Analytics, click here: Installing Google Analytics Tracking Code (easy method) 3. Google Maps JavaScript API Key This is the field where the Google Maps API Key should be added. To learn more about this click here: How to Enable Maps with Google Maps API 4. Google ReCaptcha Site key This is the field where the Google ReCaptcha Site Key should be added. To learn more about this, click here: How to Enable Form Security with Google reCaptcha 5. Google ReCaptcha Secret Key This is the field where the Google ReCaptcha Secret Key should be added. 6. Google Developer Client ID (for social login add-on) This is the field where the Google Developer Client ID (for social login) should be entered. To learn more this, click here: Google Login Add-On 7. Enable Google Login? Allow members to login with their Google account. Allow members to sign up with their Google Account in the Product Settings 8. Facebook App ID (for social login add-on) This field is where the Facebook App ID (for social login) should be entered . To learn more about this, click here: Facebook Login Add-On 9. Enable Facebook Login? Allow members to login with their Facebook account. Allow members to sign up with their Facebook Account in the Product Settings 10. Facebook App Secret ID (for social login add-on callback delete) Enter Secret ID for Facebook App (for Social Login delete) 11. Enable Private Chat Messages for Members? If YES, this will also need to be activated to each specific membership plans. To learn more about this, click here: Private Member Chat 12. Send Email Notifications to Members Send Email Notifications when Chat Messages are Sent 13. Send Email Notification to Admin When Private Chat Reported? Send an email notification to the Admin of the site when a member flags / reports a private chat message. 14. Select Transaction Types to Track This setting will control when the affiliate tracking code will be triggered. The options are: Member Sign Ups Member Upgrades Member Lead Purchases Digital Product Purchases Pay-Per-Post Purchase To learn more about this, click here: Affiliate Program Integrations 15. PostAffiliatePro URL This setting will include the PostAffiliatePro tracking code to successful signups. IMPORTANT: Do not include http or www. 16. ChatGPT API Key Enter the ChatGPT API Key. Click here to learn more about ChatGPT For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . Was this article helpful and accurate? results.content: Setup Essentials - Required Steps to Setup the Directory Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000051027 After accessing the admin back-end, the first page that displays is the Admin Dashboard. Below is a guide with the essential steps to start setting up the new directory.. These boxes are linked to the different parts of the system that need to be set up on the site. These are the basic steps to be completed: 1. Website Basics Learn more about the Website Basics set up that includes: Setting Up General Settings Setting Up "Staging Mode" Uploading Your Logo & Favicon Adding Company Email Adding Google Analytics General Settings Documentation 2. Add Business Listings To rapidly populate the directory with relevant, up-to-date business records. The Instant Business Data service enables the ability to search for businesses by industry, location, and other criteria, then instantly import them to the website as listings. Read the following article to access more information on what can be done in this section: Instant Business Data 3. Connect Domain All new Brilliant Directories websites will be connected to a "Staging URL", which is a temporary URL that can be used while the site is being built. One of the advantages of having a staging URL is that the site can be worked on without impacting the eventual domain. Some users prefer to wait until their website has all of the proper keywords and settings configured to avoid having their websites indexed before it is ready. Once the site is ready, follow the steps to connect the domain here: Connecting a Domain with the Domain Manager After completing Phase 1 of 2 with the 3 setups shown above, the last 3 will show like below as Phase 2 of 2 to complete the full setup. 4. Payment Gateway By connecting the payment gateway, any money received will be deposited directly into the account linked to the payment gateway. There, the country's currency can be selected if the country is included on the list of countries serviced by the chosen payment gateway and if the payment gateway supports that currency. Below is a list of all the currently supported payment gateways with links to more information about the countries and currencies supported by each. To get more info about each specific payment gateway, check out the link below S upported Payment Gateways Here is a guide on how to set up the Payment Gateway. Setting Up the Payment Gateway 5. Spam Form Protection In order to have the public forms protected from spam, a reCAPTCHA key must be added to the site. As Google describes it, "reCAPTCHA is a free service that protects the website from spam and abuse. reCAPTCHA uses an advanced risk analysis engine and adaptive CAPTCHAs to keep automated software from engaging in abusive activities on the site. It does this while letting the valid users pass through with ease." Read more about reCAPTCHA here. Set Up Google reCAPTCHA Key NOTE: Before completing this step, a live domain name must be connected first. Please see: How To Move The Site To A Live Domain. 6. Google Maps In order to use the location search on the site, a Google Maps JavaScript API key needs to be created and added to the Admin area of the site. This will enable Google Maps to work on the site's domain name. Find a complete, step-by-step guide on how to set this up and get this tool working. Set Up Google Maps API NOTE : Before completing this step, first connect the live domain name. Please see: How To Move The Site To A Live Domain. results.title: How To Call a Widget On a Custom Page | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: How To Call a Widget On a Custom Page Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000051582 This article explains how to display a widget on a custom static page using a widget shortcode. Widgets are reusable blocks of code that can display content, features, forms, menus, search tools, member data, and other website elements. A widget can be added to a custom page by copying and pasting its shortcode into the page content area. Widget Shortcode Format Widget shortcodes use the following format: [widget=Widget Name Here] Example: [widget=Bootstrap Theme - Module - Newsletter Sign Up Form] Important: The widget name in the shortcode must match the widget name exactly. How to Copy a Widget Shortcode The widget shortcode can be copied from the Widget Manager. Go to Toolbox >> Widget Manager . Find the widget that should be added to the custom page. Click the Actions dropdown for the widget. Select Copy Shortcode . The widget shortcode will be copied and can now be added to a custom page. Alternative: Copy the Shortcode From Inside the Widget The shortcode can also be copied from inside the widget details. Go to Toolbox >> Widget Manager . Open the widget that should be added to the custom page. Find the widget shortcode near the bottom of the widget details. Copy the shortcode. How to Add the Widget to a Custom Page After copying the widget shortcode, add it to a custom static page. Go to Content >> Web Page Builder . Create a new web page or edit an existing custom page. Paste the widget shortcode into the page content area where the widget should display. Click Save Web Page . The widget will display on the custom page where the shortcode was added. Where Widgets Can Be Added Widget shortcodes can be added to custom static pages and other content areas that support shortcodes. Common examples include: Static web pages Custom landing pages Custom homepage sections Custom widgets Content areas inside the Web Page Builder Important Notes The widget name must match exactly inside the shortcode. If the widget name is changed, the shortcode may also need to be updated. Some widgets are designed for specific page types and may not display correctly on every custom page. Custom widgets can also be called using the same shortcode format. After saving the page, view the page on the front end to confirm the widget displays correctly. For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . Was this article helpful and accurate? results.title: RSS Feed for Posts | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: RSS Feed for Posts Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000051938 The RSS Feed for Posts add-on will automatically generate and dynamically update RSS feeds for all post types on the website. Posts types (articles, classifieds, events, properties, etc.) will have their own RSS feeds that will always be kept up to date in real-time as content is published to the website. This add-on will also have an all-inclusive RSS feed which aggregates all published posts. How To Get This Add-On Websites with the VIP Add-Ons Club automatically have this add-on available: Join The VIP Add-Ons Club Purchase Individually: RSS Feed For Posts Add-On Using the Add-On To see ALL of the website posts in an RSS feed add /rss to the end of the website URL: e.g., yourdomain123.com/rss The RSS feed for a specific post type, is done by adding /rss at the end of the post type link: e.g., yourdomain123.com/articles/rss The admin can grab the URL directly by going to My Content - Edit Post Settings and copying the URL from here: The admin can also get as specific as possible with the RSS feed as long as that result is available within the website for that post type. If the admin wanted to show all the articles with the word "sample" in the title, add the URL like this: e.g., yourdomain123.com/articles/rss?q=Sample Or for the articles that belong in a certain category: e.g., yourdomain123.com/articles/rss?q=&category[]=Category+1 The admin can simply go into the website, do a quick search within the feature and grab the URL that is given, simply copy from the ?q and add it to the end of the /rss to make it more detailed. To learn more about this, please read this great third party article: https://www.w3schools.com/xml/xml_rss.asp By default, this RSS feed will show 10 posts , to increase the limit add this parameter at the end of the URL. e.g., yourdomain123.com/articles/rss?limit=50 The ?limit= will tell the RSS feed how many posts to show at a time. RSS Feed Title The title of the RSS Feed will render the text from the RSS Feed Title text label : RSS Feed Title System Variable: rss_feed However, if this label is empty the RSS Feed will render the Website Name from the General Settings : RSS Images The post images from our default RSS feeds are not included by default because they are not compatible with some readers. As a solution to this, we created an alternate RSS feed URL /rss-image The includes the post image in the feed data. This way website owners who rely on the feed to also fetch the post image will have a method to do this. There are 2 feed URLS: Default : without post image data /rss domain.com/rss domain.com/post/rss Images : with post image data /rss-image domain.com/rss-image domain.com/post/rss-image Once this add-on is installed the Meta Tag for the RSS feed will add this automatically, letting Google know that the site has an RSS. <link rel="alternate" type="application/rss+xml" title="My New Website RSS Feed" href="http://www.YOURDOMAIN123.com/rss" /> The admin can change the Title of the RSS by editing the text label rss_field as shown below, by default the title will be 'RSS Feed': RSS Excluded Content The RSS Feed will include the same posts that appear in the search results. This means that only the Published posts will be added, Unpublished posts will not be included. Posts that are publicly accesible and not restricted by the Members-Only Content functionality will appear in the RSS Feed. P rotected posts will not be included. XML File Tags < title > (post tite-le) < description > the tag is stripped at 250 characters (post snippet) < content > (full post) < media > (repeats the post image URL data) Post RSS Notes The RSS feed follows specific rules based on the functionality of different post types. These rules are designed to ensure that each post type displays information as expected when included in the feed. Events The start date/time is included for Event posts. [Date in Website's Date format], [Time in website's time format], [UTC Timezone] -- [Rest of the post content] Blog Post When the RSS feed is created for blog posts it will use the published date. In the system, that is the form variable: post_start_date For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . results.title: Manual Billing Management - Accept Cash, Bank Transfers, or Unsupported Payment Gateways | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: Manual Billing Management - Accept Cash, Bank Transfers, or Unsupported Payment Gateways Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000051955 Some site owners prefer to receive member payments directly through checks, bank transfers, or other offline payment methods. Other site owners want to use a third-party payment gateway and track these payments in the admin. This article explains how to create invoices manually and record offline payments in the BD Admin. Follow the steps below: 1. Log in to the Admin area and navigate to Members » Search Members: 2. Locate the member for whom the subscription will be created and click Actions » Payment History: 3. At the top-right corner of the screen, click New Order : 4. On the left side, configure the following settings: Membership Plan: Select the membership plan this member will be under. Billing Cycle: Monthly, Semi-Yearly, and Yearly (depending on the chosen membership plan configuration). Price Override: Add a different amount if offered a special discount. If the amount does not need to be modified, leave this option blank. Start Billing On: If the subscription needs to start in the future, then select the new date here. 5. Verify that the selected information appears on the right side. When everything has been set up correctly, click "Create Order" button and wait less than 10 seconds. 6. The page will load automatically and this message will appear: 7. Since the member doesn't have a credit card on file, the system will mark the invoice as "Unpaid". In order to mark it as paid, go to the "Past Due" tab and click Actions » Mark as Paid: 8. The system displays a confirmation pop-up asking to continue, click "Yes, Continue": 9. The system then asks whether to generate the next invoice for the subscription. IMPORTANT NOTE: The recommended option is 'No, Cancel '. Why? Because when clicking NO, the system won't generate the invoice now, it will generate it 14 days before the next due date (This is the regular invoices generation procedure). When clicking "Yes, continue" it will generate the next invoice immediately. So if today is 11/29/2020 and the next invoice should be paid on 11/29/2021 (a year later ) that unpaid invoice will appear in the "Upcoming Payments" section of the Transaction History for a whole year and this might be confusing for the owner of the site, especially when there are a lot of upcoming payments. In summary, selecting No preserves the normal billing scheduler and it will be easier for the admin to handle the next payments. 10. Regardless of choosing "Yes or No" in the step above, the system will mark the invoice as "Paid": To learn how to cancel/stop orders (Subscriptions) read this article: How Do I Cancel Payment Subscriptions - Orders For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . This article provides examples of how to style menu items and related options. How Can These Options Be Accessed? In the Edit view for any menu, a Settings button is attached to every menu link: Clicking this option opens additional editing settings: Format to Use: Link Title Text This setting can be used to add an additional SEO boost to the link by defining its meta title . Input: Additional Information: >> HTML title attribute (W3Schools) Menu Item Inline Attribute This setting can be used to add preferred style attributes to the <li> element. Input: Front-end view: Outer <li> Inline Attribute This setting can be used to add preferred style attributes to the <a> element. Input: Front-end view: Additional Information: >> HTML inline CSS (W3Schools) Menu Item CSS Class This setting can be used to add a preferred CSS class to the <a> element. Input: Front-end view: Outer <li> CSS Class This setting can be used to add a preferred CSS class to the <li> element. Input: Front-end and HTML view: Additional Checkboxes Open in a new window – Indicates whether the link opens in a new browser tab. Add rel="nofollow" – Indicates whether search engines should follow the link. This option is useful when the linked page is not ready or is in a staging environment. results.content: Grid View Search Results Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000052777 Overview The Grid View Search Results add-on will allow the admin to have search results on the front-end of the website be displayed in a mobile-responsive, mosaic grid view. By default the website displays search results for members, posts and more in a list layout. With this add-on the admin can choose to display these search results as a grid instead of as a list. How To Get This Add-On Websites with the VIP Add-Ons Club automatically have this add-on available: Join The VIP Add-Ons Club Purchase Individually: Grid View Search Results Add-On Enabling the Add-On Go to Settings - Design Settings. Within the General tab, scroll down until the Search Results Pages option shows up. Expand the Search Results Pages and scroll down for 2 options. Member Search Layout & Post Search Layout The search results display can be set sitewide for members and posts with these two options: Member Search Layout Post Search Layout Individual Post Type Grid View The admin will be able to fully control from each post type as well how they wish for the results to show, please follow these steps: Go to My Content - Edit Post Settings: Select the feature you wish to change the results view to: Go to the Search Results tab: Scroll down until you see the Additional Settings : Keep scrolling down until you select a new option here: Grid View Layout There are 2 options to select how the Grid View will display: Masonry View Structured View Sidebar Grid View Layout Sidebars will also affect the way the grid is laid out in the search results. Sidebar on Page This will display 3 in a row if a sidebar is present: No Sidebar on Page If no sidebar is present it will display 4 in a row: For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . results.title: Creating a Folder in Media Manager | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: Creating a Folder in Media Manager Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000052779 Creating folders within the Media Manager keeps images organized by page or event. The process takes two steps. 1. Open My Content > Media Manager and click +New Folder . 2. Enter a name in the Insert Folder Name field. IMPORTANT: As a best practice, avoid spaces in folder or file names. Use dashes or underscores instead (for example, event-photos or event_photos ) to prevent broken paths. The folder is created immediately. Uploading an image inside a folder follows the same process as uploading an image into the Media Manager. Additional Information » Content » Media Manager Upload Image For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . results.title: How To Add Categories Manually From The Admin | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: How To Add Categories Manually From The Admin Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000052823 In this article, we will show how to add Top, Sub and Sub-Sub Level categories manually via the admin. If the preference is to import categories via a CSV file, please refer to the article below: How To Import A Top-Level & Sub-Level Category Structure Via CSV File ** For information about all of the fields within the Member Categories, refer to this article: How To Add & Edit Member Categories How To Add Top-Level Categories To add a top-level category, navigate to the Members --> Member Categories --> Click on the " Add Top-Level Categories " button: A module will appear, add the top-level categories in the text area: ⚠️ Entry Requirement: Enter only one category per line inside the text area. Click on the " Save Top-Level Categories " button, and the new top-level categories will be created on the fly. How To Add Sub & Sub-Sub Level Categories To add a sub or sub-sub level category, navigate to Members --> Member Categories --> Click on the " Add Sub-Level Categories " button: The "Add Sub-Level Categories" screen will pop up. It is important to specify a parent element when adding a Sub-Level Category: ⚠️ Entry Requirement: Enter only one category per line inside the text area. When adding a Sub-Sub Level Category - specify a sub-parent element as highlighted below: The "Add Sub-Sub Level Categories" screen will pop up. It is important to specify a parent element when adding a Sub-Sub Level Category: As the text above indicates, only put one category per line. Deleting Categories Deleting Top or Sub Level categories can have unforeseen consequences if the Top-Level category has Sub Level categories associated with it, or if members have already selected this Top-Level category on their profile. The same would apply to Sub Level categories that are being deleted. To avoid these potential issues, our team has implemented a fail-safe that will check for these potential circumstances and will alert the admin. System Behavior When Deleting Categories When deleting a category that contains active data, the admin panel will display specific prompts to protect the directory structure: Top-Level with Members & Sub-Categories: A prompt will appear to move both the active members and the sub-categories to an alternate Top-Level destination. Top-Level with Sub-Categories: A prompt will appear to move the associated sub-level categories to a different Top-Level category. Sub-Sub Level Category: An option will be provided to move the sub-sub category under a completely new parent Sub-level category. For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . Was this article helpful and accurate? results.title: How To Display Custom Social Media Icons On Member Profiles | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: How To Display Custom Social Media Icons On Member Profiles Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000052828 Every Brilliant Directories website includes a default contact details form where members can add social media links and display them on their profiles. When these fields are completed, the social media icons display on the member profile. This article explains how to create additional social media fields for members and display them on their profiles. Adding a New Field to the Form Identify the contact form that needs to be edited. Go to Toolbox → Form Manager , then click Customize for the preferred form. In the edit view, click New Field and complete the required field settings as shown below. Make sure the new social media field uses the same Display Options as the default social media fields. The Field Label Name and Database Variable Name can be changed as needed. In this example, Snapchat is used. The Field Type must be set to Website URL for the field to work like the default social media fields. This is the Font Awesome icon code used in this example: Copy The full list of available Font Awesome 4.7 icons can be found here: https://fontawesome.com/v4.7.0/icons/ For display purposes, drag the new field below the Instagram option. Click Save Changes . The custom form can now be selected in the Membership Plan settings. For more information about creating a new form and assigning it to Membership Plans, please refer to this article: How To Assign Different Member Forms To Various Membership Levels The new field will now display properly on the member form inside the Member Dashboard. Displaying the New Field on Member Profiles To display the new social media field on member profiles, the new variable must be added to the widget that controls the social media icons. First, identify which widget is being used to display the existing social media icons. For more information about locating widgets from the front end using the Admin Bar, please refer to this article: https://bootstrap.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000051553 Clicking the widget name will open the Widget Manager. Click Customize to view the widget code. In the code view, scroll down to the area between the last closing anchor tag and the opening PHP tag. Add the following code, then click Save : Copy rel = "nofollow" href = " " target = "_blank" title = "Snapchat" > Once the widget has been customized and the new link has been added to the contact details form, the custom social media icon will display on the member profile. [Keep existing screenshot] For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . Was this article helpful and accurate? results.title: Content » Edit Post Settings | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: Content » Edit Post Settings Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000053202 The Edit Post Settings folder is where post types can be edited, deleted, and cloned. There are 13 default post types included with the website: Community Article Website Blog Article Video Property Product Photo Album Job Listing Event Coupon Classified Soundcloud Member Listings Discussions The main Edit Post Settings page features four clickable elements: 1. Preview: Redirects to the post search results page. 2. Number of created posts: Redirects to the Manage Posts section for the specific post type. Refer to this article for more information: Content » Manage Post 3. URL Permalink: Redirects to the post search results page. 4. Form to Use: Opens the specific form associated with the post type for editing. To learn more about the Form Manager, click the following article: Toolbox » Form Manager Upon clicking "Edit" for a post type, four tabs are available with distinct settings: General Settings, Profile Page Design, Search Results Design, and Detail Page Design. General Settings Tab The general settings for the post type are as follows: 1. Protect this Post Type? This option is only available if the Members-Only Content add-on is active on the site. 2. URL Permalink Updates the URL of the post type search results. Refer to this article for details on How To Change The Name, Title & URL Of A Post Type . 3. Post Sidebar Icon Selects the icon used to represent this post type in the member dashboard sidebar menu. 4. Select Form to Use Determines the form used when publishing a post. Click the hyperlink to access and edit the form. 5. Post Categories Certain post types, such as properties, coupons, and events, include pre-set categories. Refer to this article for more details on How To Add Or Edit Categories For Post Types (Events, Coupons, Properties, Etc) . 6. Additional Settings Settings vary by post type. The following are available for the "Classifieds" post type: 7. Post Approval Requires the Advanced Post Moderation add-on. Note that "Post Publishing" settings within each Membership Plan will override the selected option. 8. Price Slider Min + Max Value Certain post types, such as Classifieds, include sliders in search widgets to allow price range selection. Refer to this link to learn how to Edit The Min & Max Value of Price Sliders . 9. Enable Price Slider Activates the price slider for relevant post types. 10. Enable Photo Gallery Videos Enables video integration for multi-photo albums. Refer to the following article for more information: How to Add Videos to Multi-Photo Post Types . 11. Display Map When Entering Location Information? This setting controls the display of the map. Helpful information can be found in this article: Google Maps: Reducing Usage and Costs . 12. Enable Results for Global Website Search Requires the Global Website Search add-on. 13. Trigger Webhook for Initial Save or Every Save? Determines when a Webhook is triggered upon post creation by a member. Profile Page Design Tab Use this tab to configure how posts are displayed on public member profiles. 1. Profile Page Tab Title Modifies the title displayed on the front-end tab. 2. Profile Page Tab Order Sets the position of the profile page tab via the dropdown menu. Each position displays the name of the assigned post type. Available positions are those with no assigned post type. 3. Number of Posts Displayed in Tab Sets the quantity of posts to be displayed. Information is displayed on the live member profile as follows: 4. Profile Page Code The header, page loop, and footer codes for the Profile Page design can be modified. However, changes are only recommended for developers or individuals with web development expertise. Codes can be restored to default if necessary. Refer to this article for further information: How to Customize the Default Post Types Code . Search Results Design Tab Configure search results settings for a specific post type within this section. 1. Search Results Page Title - H1 Edits the text for the post type title. 2. Search Results Page Sub-Title - H2 Adds an optional subtitle. 3. Search Results per Page Controls the default number of results appearing on a search results page. 4. Search Results Code Allows for editing the header, loop, and footer codes of the search results design. Refer to this article for more information: How to Customize the Default Post Types Code . 5. Additional settings Various options are available within the dropdown menu for further customization: 6. Post Keyword Search Options Advanced settings to control keyword search functionality. The "Search Default Fields" option also includes post description fields. Refer to this article regarding the Expanded Keyword Search add-on. 7. Pagination Display Options Selects the pagination style for search results: standard, hidden, or Insta-Load pagination (requires add-on). 8. Order Results By Controls the display order of items based on a specific database field. Further information is available here: How To Change Search Results Sorting Options . 9. Enable Search Results Cache Setting this to YES (recommended) caches search results to improve load times for subsequent matching searches. Setting this to NO ensures the database is queried for every search. Note: This cannot be enabled if "Order Results By" is set to "Random." 10. Respect Membership Plan Search Priority? Membership Plan Search Results Priority is configured within the Search Visibility tab of each plan. 11. Sidebar To Use Specifies the sidebar (custom or default) to be displayed on search results pages. 12. Sidebar Search Module Selects the search widget to display in the search results sidebar. This requires the sidebar in the Sidebar Manager to utilize the Bootstrap Theme - Search Module - Dynamic Sidebar Search widget. This widget loads the search module specified for each post type. 13. Sidebar Position on Mobile Device Determines the sidebar's position on mobile devices (phones and tablets): Bottom (below results), Top (above results), or Hidden. 14. Enable Search Results Photo Album Slider If set to YES, search results for this feature will include a carousel displaying post photos. 15. Display Google Map Option on Search Results Pages Selecting "Yes" displays a map icon at the top of search results pages. Clicking this icon displays results as pins on a Google Map. 16. Custom Search Engine Widget Name Adds a widget to utilize a custom search engine. 17. Start Results View In Select list view, map view, or grid view (requires the Grid View Search Results add-on). 1 8. Display Expired Posts in Search Results If set to YES, expired posts will be displayed on search results pages. Detail Page Design Tab This section allows for the configuration of various settings for the post detail page. 1. Detail Page Code Additional custom codes can be added to this field. Code modification is not recommended unless a developer is managing the site. Refer to this article for more information: How to Customize the Default Post Types Code . 2. Allow Live Links In The Post Body If set to ON, members are permitted to include links within the post body. This can be toggled for each post type. 3. Sidebar to Use Specifies the sidebar to be displayed on search results pages. 4. Insert Additional Code for Embeds, Schema Markup, etc. (will render directly after page template code) Any additional code required for the comments section should be pasted here. Additional Actions Hover over specific items to reveal further actions: 1. Clone Selecting this option creates a duplicate of the post type. In the example below, the Discussion post type has been cloned. 2. Copy RSS Link This option is only visible if the RSS Feed for Posts add-on is active. 3. Delete Prior to deleting a post type that contains existing posts, an option to transfer those posts to another post type will be presented. Once the destination post type is selected, all posts will be transferred. For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . results.title: Require Complete Profiles - How To Hide Incomplete Profiles | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: Require Complete Profiles - How To Hide Incomplete Profiles Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000053996 What are Incomplete Profiles? Incomplete profiles on search results, like shown down below, might have a negative effect on the users experience: Having relevant content and search results plays a big part in increasing the website credibility. With the Require Complete Profiles setting (shown down below), prevent incomplete profiles from populating the search results: Changing the setting to " Require Complete Profiles to display in search results " will activate these criteria for both the admin backend filters and the frontend search results. When activating, the member search results will only display members who at least have: First Name Top-Level Category selected Profile Photo OR Logo uploaded Company Name This is how the search results look after activating this advance setting: Changing the setting to " Allow searching for complete profiles from the Admin only " will activate these criteria only in the admin backend to display the corresponding search filters, bu it won't apply to the website member search: These are the filters that will get activated in the backend: Changing the Requirements By default the system will only require the following 4 fields: First Name Top-Level Category selected Profile Photo OR Logo uploaded Company Name This criteria can be changed through an advanced setting, Complete Profile Fields : System Variable: complete_profile_fields The variables used are: company = Company first_name = Name file = Profile Photo or Logo cover_photo = Cover Photo profession_id = Top Category service = Sub Categories These variables can be removed or more can be added. When adding more variables, it is important that they match what is in the database table users_data , which is where all the default fields are stored. For example, if the Phone Number is added to this list, the database variable needs to be included. This variable is phone_number : Important Note Custom fields can also be added to the setting, however to make it work with users_meta fields, which is where custom fields are stored, the site needs the Expanded Keyword Search add-on. For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . Was this article helpful and accurate? results.content: Adding Dashboard Header-Footer Custom HTML Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000054643 This article explains how to add Custom Header and Footer content to the Member's Dashboard. The system allows different header and footer widgets to be assigned to each membership plan. The final result will look like this: By default, this section can be activated by using the Froala Editor or selecting a custom widget. It is best to use the Froala Editor, which fully supports rich content like links, media embeds, custom colors, and different fonts. This article explains how to use both the custom widget and the Froala Editor. Using the Froala Editor 1. Go to Finance » Membership Plans » Member's Dashboard tab. Scroll down to the "Custom Dashboard Content" section and select "Use text Editor" in the Dashboard Header Content option. 2. Add the desired content, such as images, videos, or links. 3. Save the changes. Follow the same steps if additional content needs to be added to the Dashboard Footer Content. Using a Custom Widget Follow these steps: 1. Go to Toolbox » Widget Manager. 2. Click "New Widget + " 3. Add the Widget's Name. Use a widget name that reflects its purpose, making it easier to remember what the widget is for . In this example, the widget is titled 'Custom Header - Dashboard' to clearly identify its function. 4. Add the Widget Code. 5. Make sure the Type of Widget is a "Widget". 6. Save the changes. 7. Then go to Finance » Membership Plans » Member's Dashboard tab. Scroll down to the "Custom Dashboard Content" section and select the custom widget created. Save the changes: In the member's dashboard the widget will appear at the top because we created a widget for the header section: Follow the same steps to add a footer widget, but select 'Dashboard Footer Custom HTML' in Step 7. For additional questions or help setting this up, submit a ticket to support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket HERE . results.content: Private Member Chat Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000055517 Private Member Chat allows members to chat back and forth through the website. Keep members coming back to the site when replying to their chat messages. By default, members receive an email notification when they get a message. With this add-on they can respond back to messages directly from within their member dashboard area. IMPORTANT: Private Member Chat is exclusively for member-to-member communication. Unregistered users will be prompted to log in or create an account to access this feature. How To Get This Add-On Websites with the VIP Add-Ons Club automatically have this add-on available: Join The VIP Add-Ons Club Purchase Individually: Private Member Chat Add-On Enabling the Add-On Go to Settings - General Settings: Click on Integrations Tab: Scroll down until the option to Enable Private Chat Messages for Members appears and select Yes . Private Chat Email Notifications and Templates The notifications to the user can be turned on or off here: Only send notifications to the message receiver. (all messages) Only send notifications to the message sender. (first message only) Send all notifications to the message receiver and sender (selected by default). No email notifications sent. Select if the admin should receive a email notification by checking the box at the bottom. In the post pages a modal will appear prompting the user to log in or create an account: However, the general get-matched form will still be available in the default Member Profile Pag e sidebar for non-members: If a member is logged in but is not active they won't have access to the private chat and will get this message: If a member is logged in and his account is active and he searches for another member's profile, he can now send him a direct message: As shown below, the regular contact form won't appear, instead, this other message field will appear: Spam Submission If a word identified as spam is submitted, the message will be blocked based on the Spam Form Protector Add-On . results.title: Google Maps: Add APIs | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: Google Maps: Add APIs Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000055835 If Google Maps or location search is not working, one of the required Google Maps APIs may not be enabled in Google Cloud. This can happen even if the API key was already created and added to the Brilliant Directories website. Required APIs The Google Cloud project connected to the API key should have these APIs enabled: Maps JavaScript API Places API (New) Geocoding API Places API (New) and the admin switch. Location search uses Places API (New) when Use Places API (New) is turned on. That switch is in the details window of the red Google Maps Error alert, and it is the same setting as Enable New Google Maps Places API in Advanced Settings. The key is tested for Places API (New) before the switch is saved. If the switch will not turn on, the key most likely does not have Places API (New) enabled: enable it in Step 1 below, wait a few minutes, and turn the switch on again. Step 1 - Enable the Missing APIs Use the search bar to find the API that needs to be enabled. Open each API link below and enable it for the Google Cloud project being used for the website. Enable Maps JavaScript API Enable Places API (New) Enable Geocoding API If the API is not enabled, click Enable . Make sure the correct Google Cloud project is selected at the top of the Google Cloud Console before enabling each API. Repeat this step until all required APIs are enabled for the same Google Cloud project. Step 2 - Check API Restrictions If the API key has API restrictions, make sure the required APIs are also selected in the key settings. If an enabled API is not selected under the API key restrictions, Google may still block the key from using it. Open the API key from the Google Cloud Credentials page: Open Google Cloud Credentials Inside the API key settings, look for the API restrictions section. Select the option to restrict the key, then choose the APIs used by the website: Maps JavaScript API Places API (New) Geocoding API If one of these APIs does not appear in the list, return to Step 2 and confirm that the API was enabled for the same Google Cloud project. For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . Was this article helpful and accurate? results.title: Google Maps: Edit HTTP Referrers | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: Google Maps: Edit HTTP Referrers Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000057655 If Google Maps is not loading after the API key was added, the website domain may be missing from the key’s HTTP referrers. HTTP referrers tell Google which websites are allowed to use the API key. If the website domain is not listed, Google may block the key from working on the site. Step 1 - Open Google Cloud Credentials Log in to the Google account connected to Google Cloud and open the Credentials page: Open Google Cloud Credentials Make sure the correct Google Cloud project is selected at the top of the page. Step 2 - Open the API Key Find the Google Maps API key and click on it to open the key settings. Step 3 - Edit the Website Restrictions In the application restrictions section, select: Websites Add each approved referrer one at a time. Required Referrers Add the following referrers. Replace example.com with the website’s live domain. *.directoryup.com/* *.managemydirectory.com/* managemydirectory.com *.example.com/* example.com The directoryup.com referrer is useful if the site is not live yet. The managemydirectory.com referrers are needed so map-related features can work inside the Brilliant Directories admin area. The custom domain referrers allow the API key to work on the live website. Step 4 - Save the Changes After all referrers have been added, save the API key settings in Google Cloud. Once saved, refresh the Brilliant Directories website and test the map again. For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . Was this article helpful and accurate?
