The View Details link (shows the details of the product associated with the invoice) on the Transaction History page in the Admin Area will now only display if there is a product linked to the invoice. Invoices for leads will not display this link as there is no associated product. We fixed an issue which was preventing the system from showing the correct image for the Posted by Author Snapshot widget used on Feature Details pages. We fixed an issue with the allow_duplicate_member_emails Advanced Setting which was allowing members to signup with the same email account when they should be prevented from doing so in some cases. We fixed an issue which was preventing Admins from entering Payment Gateway credentials for BluePay if the credentials contained certain characters. We released a Security Update that will make sure unsecure default Admin passwords are changed the next time an Admin logs into their account. We updated the Froala WYSIWYG for the Blog Article Form in order add the ability to upload images directly through the Froala Editor. In all, over 80 feature enhancements and software updates were released this month. For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . Was this article helpful and accurate? Yes No Send feedback Sorry we couldn't be helpful. Help us improve this article with your feedback.

results.title: Changelog - October 2018 | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: Changelog - October 2018 Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000093681 New Features: Now sites that use an external payment gateway (PayPal Standard, Payfast, 2Checkout) can give members the option to signup with the One-Click Social Login Add-On. Admins now have the ability to independently install an SSL certificate through the Admin of their site once they have purchased the Add-On. We created a new setting which will Enable/Disable the Auto-Recurring Events Add-On. In order to use this new setting, navigate to Admin >> Content >> Edit Post Settings >> Events >> Edit >> General Settings tab . We made an update to the Reviews Module in the Member Dashboard Area. We added the ability to hide/show the Member Rating Options to the member review form, and each individual Rating Option can now be hidden by deleting the content of the corresponding Text label. The Member Results Sorting Options widget is now fully based on Text Labels. We released a major update to the Form Manager System. These updates will help prevent a website owner from accidentally creating unnecessary custom copies of forms, which will help ensure all websites are using the most up-to-date forms at all times. For more information click here . We added the Ghana Cedi as a supported currency. We created two new Product Level settings: the Pre-Select Top-Level Category and Listing Type settings. These settings will allow Admins to Pre-select a Top-Level category and Listing Type that will be automatically applied to a member when they sign up. All of the text in the Claim Listing Offer widget is now fully based on Text Labels. New labels: create_non_claim_label, select_option_claim_listing,dont_claim_label. All of the text in the Title Signup Free Form widget is now fully based on Text Labels. New labels: or_enter_email_create_pw, enter_email_and_pw. We updated the General Settings >> Integrations tab to require the website be connected to a live domain before completing the integration steps. This will help prevent user errors when setting up integrations for their site and provides a smoother workflow for launching a new site. We added the ability to check and run Software Updates from the Dashboard page on the Admin Area. With this update, Admins now have the ability to automatically install updates that are required to be run on a per-site basis. This includes updates to the structure of a site's database, updating fields in custom forms, and deactivating custom widgets that would prevent an update from being fully applied. We updated the layout of the Required First Steps area on the Admin Dashboard. This update is intended to better highlight the pending steps that are required to fully launch a new site. We released the Pay Per Post Add-On. Click here for more information. We added a new field to the Contact Details form in the Member Dashboard section called "Short Description". This field allows Members to add a brief description that will be display on the Member Search Results page. This will replace the display of Sub Level Categories on member search results, which improves the performance of the site. We updated the Search Member Keywords Add-On to add the same functionality to Post searches. An Admin can now select the search depth on a per- feature basis. To change this setting for a Post Type, navigate to Admin >> Content >> Edit Post Settings >> Edit >> Search Results Design Tab . The "Post Keyword Search Options" setting is found on this page. We added an item to the to the Admin Menu >> Dashboard menu section that links to the "Manage Add-Ons" page. Enhancements / Fixes: We fixed an issue which was affecting the URLs of countries. We fixed an issue which was preventing the setting to hide/show a Member's Specialties on the Featured Member and Recent Members widget from working properly. We fixed an issue which was causing the Member Search Module to not include all results within the specified radius around a searched location in some cases. We fixed an issue that was preventing the Admin Sidebar from appearing after clicking "Visit Website" from the Admin area. We applied a UI update to the Member Categories page in the Admin area and subsequently fixed some small issues related to the update. We applied a Security Update to the Save Form widget. We fixed an issue which was affecting the ability to display Text Labels with apostrophes on /checkout pages. We updated the success page after an Admin creates a new subscription for a member from the Admin area. We applied a Security Update to the Edit Post Settings page in the Admin Area. We fixed some issues with the saving of Sub Level Categories on the Member Categories page in the Admin area. We add language localization to the Google Maps used in the Admin Area. We optimized the code of the Recent Coupons and Recent Jobs widgets used on the homepage. Now the emails submitted through the Coming Soon and Contact Us forms are automatically registered as Contacts in the Admin area. We fixed an issue which was causing incorrect search results from displaying in some cases when searching for lead matches in the Admin area. We fixed an issue which was was causing an incorrect Product to show for invoices on the Transaction History page in the Admin Area in some cases. We fixed an issue which was causing the Refund Payment button to not work properly on the Transaction History page in the Admin Area in some cases. We updated the UI of the Edit Web Pages and SEO Templates pages in the Admin Area. We fixed an issue which was showing all of the results from the state a city is in rather just the results from the city when viewing a /state/city "Pretty URL" search results page. We removed the deprecated Lead Match Delivery and the Maximum Lead Matches buttons from the Configuration Tab on the General Settings page in the Admin Area. Now the End Subscription button on the Transaction History page will only appear when the Invoice is linked to an active Subscription. We fixed an issue which was causing the Start Date field form validation to not work properly after a member deletes its value and tries to re-enter it. We fixed an issuue that was causing breadcrumb links on profile contact pages to not work correctly in some cases. We fixed an issue which was causing the Export Member Data Add-On to not work properly on some versions of the Safari web browser. We updated the Admin Froala WYSIWYG in order to allow text to wrap around images when they are floated to the left or right of the page. We updated the Widget Code Difference Checker functionality in order to not render widgets that are called within other widgets. We added the language parameter to all Google Maps API calls in the Admin Area. We fixed an issue which was affecting the member login functionality when a Site Admin uses single quotes in the Text Labels used on the login page. We fixed an issue which was causing the Signup Form to not display when at least one of the One-Click Social Login Add-On options was setting correctly on the site. We updated the display of the details pages of album posts so that posts that have just one image in the album will not show a thumbnail of the image below the large version of the image. We combined the Status and Invoice ID columns on the Transaction History page in the Admin Area in order to save space and simplify the UI. We updated the Recent Blog Articles with Sidebar widget in order to sort the results using the "Date Published" field instead of the "Date Created" field. We added the Billing Cycle and the Easy Coupon Codes dropdown as new search criteria options on the Transaction History page in the Admin Area. Note: The Easy Coupon Codes dropdown will be available only when the Add-On is active on the Site. We fixed an issue which was affecting the action to display the New Zealand map on Demo Sites. We fixed an issue which was causing the Need Help button to not work properly in the Admin Area on some pages. We made a small aesthetic update to the Recent Member widget used on the Homepage to better handle the display of very long category names. We fixed an issue which was affecting the Social Media Sharing details for the Sub-Categories SEO Template in some cases. We added support for Special Characters in Review URLs. Now the system will automatically encode/decode the URLs of the Review Search Result pages and Reviews on Profile pages. We fixed an issue which was affecting the normal behavior of the Insta-Load Search Results Add-On when Site Members have an apostrophe in their names. We updated the Front-End Froala WYSIWYG in order to allow text to wrap around images when they are floated to the left or right of the page. We removed the "View Page" link from the Actions Dropdown on the SEO Template page in the Admin Area, as this link does not apply for SEO Templates. We fixed an issue which was affecting the normal behavior of the Member Review Module when a site is using the Default Review Form. We improved the validation messages displayed when using the Edit Web Pages area of the Admin when saving a page. We added validation to the "Enter URL" fields in the Menu Manager to reduce user errors and provide additional security. We updated the "Fetch from SEO Template" link to support special characters in the member's profile URL when using the "Quick Edit" feature for a member in the Admin. We added the ability to install the SSL Security Add-On from the General Settings page in the Admin area. We made some small updates to the UI of the Form Manager to improve the user experience. Now the "Select Form To Use" field on the Edit Post Setting page on the Admin Area will only show the forms that have the word "Feature" in the name of the form to reduce potential user error. We fixed an issue which was preventing members from deleting Posts when the Pay Per Post Add-On is active. We fixed an issue which was preventing members from purchasing Leads or additional Posts (using the new Pay Per Post Add-On) in some cases. The issue that was affecting the ability to set a Member Post as published when the Pay Per Post Add-On is active have been fixed. We updated the filename generator to automatically find instances where more than one dash would be used in a filename and replace them with a single dash. We fixed an issue with the Media Manager which was preventing the selection of lazy-loaded images in some cases. In all, over 100 feature enhancements and software updates were released this month. For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . Was this article helpful and accurate? Yes No Send feedback Sorry we couldn't be helpful. Help us improve this article with your feedback.

results.title: Changelog - November 2018 | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: Changelog - November 2018 Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000093682 New Features: We updated the Transactions History page to include invoices from any date, regardless of how far in the future or the past the invoices were created. We added the ability to create the next Due Invoice when a Site Admin manually marks an Invoices as Paid. We created a new set of Mobile View Design Settings for the Header Design section in the Design Settings page in the Admin. To use these new Design Settings navigate to: Admin >> Settings >> Design Settings >> Design Settings Tab >> Header Design Section. We improved the UI of the Manage Products page in the Admin Area. We added the ability to add/update a Member's Credit Card information from the Members Actions dropdown on the Search Members page in the Admin. We released a Security Update to all areas of the software where a member can upload an image or a file (CV / resume) and to the Media Manager in the Admin. This update will make sure that only JPG, PNG, GIF, Doc, and PDF files can be uploaded (different files are allowed in different circumstances), and that the files that are of the type specified in their file extension. We updated the UI of the Match Leads page in the Admin. We released the Pin Featured Post Add-On. Click here for more information. We added the ability to change the Site Date Format from the General Settings page in the Admin. In order to use this new feature navigate to Admin >> Settings >> General Settings >> Configuration Tab. The Facebook Website Chat Add-On greeting message is now a Text Label. New text label: fb_chat_greeting. We released the RSS Feed for Posts Add-On. We created a new Text Label in order to show the correct error message during the Signup Process if the email entered is already associated with an existing member. New Text Label: duplicate_email_error. We updated the UI of the "Add Member" workflow from the Search Members page in the Admin. We added the ability to search by category to the Audio File Feature. We added the ability to "Clone" and "Delete" Sidebars to the Actions dropdown on the Sidebar Manager page in the Admin. We updated the Coupon Code page in the Admin to place active and inactive coupons on different tabs. Note: This section is only available if the Easy Coupon Codes Add-On is active in the Site. We added the ability to select the Social Media Image when editing a Static Page in the Admin. We released the Homepage Clickable Maps Pack Add-On. We added the ability to Create/Delete and Update folders through the Media Manager Tool in the Admin. We added the ability to edit the Default Email Signature from the General Settings page in the Admin. This signature will be added to email templates sent out by the system by default. In order to use this new feature navigate to Admin >> Settings >> General Settings >> General Tab. We released the Google Map Search Results and Grid View Search Results Add-On. We updated the design of the Member Reviews Page in the Admin. We added the Bookmark Text Label for the Bookmark Favorites Add-On. Text Label created: bookmark. Enhancements / Fixes: We fixed an issue which was preventing the Get Matched Form from displaying on the homepage for members that were logged in to their account in some instances.. We fixed an issue which was preventing 100% discount coupons from applying properly when a site is using an external payment gateway like PayPal. We fixed an issue that was preventing Admins from using the keys on the Numpad of their keyboard when entering numbers into the new Pay Per Post fields in Product Settings. We fixed an issue which was causing the content in the Newest Members homepage widget from aligning properly in some cases. We updated the Froala WYSIWYG settings throughout the software to provide a more uniform user experience. We removed the Page Type field when editing an SEO Template in the Admin to reduce potential user errors. We fixed an issue which was causing the "SEO Details" of a page from overwriting the corresponding "Social Media Share Details" set for the page in some cases. We fixed an issue which was causing the XML Sitemap Generator to show PHP warning in some cases. We removed the Sidebar Settings when editing an SEO Template in the Admin as these settings are now controlled in the Design Settings. We updated the member numbers reported on the Finance >> Manage Products in the Admin to show the total number of members in each Product, instead of only the Active members in the Product. We removed several options in the Page Type dropdown on the Edit Web Pages section of the Admin in order to reduce potential user errors. We moved the "Default Radius Search" Advanced Setting to Settings >> General Settings >> Configuration tab in the Admin . We made some UI improvements to the Member Categories Page in the Admin. We updated the Transaction History page in the Admin Area in order to better support the invoices generated by the Pay Per Post Add-On. We improved the Error Handling for the Stripe Payment Gateway in order to display the reason supplied by Stripe when a credit card is declined. We fixed an issue which was causing a member's subscription to be listed as "Pending" after attempting to upgrade with a credit card that is rejected in some cases. We fixed an issue that was preventing an Admin from deleting members in some cases. We removed the "Type of Data" field when editing Post Settings in the Admin to reduce potential user errors. We fixed an issue which was preventing image thumbnails from displaying the Admin Media Manager after pressing the "Load More" button. We removed the links to the old lead system in the Admin area on all sites that do not have any leads submitted using the old system. We removed the Google+ share button from the Social Share Widget since Google will be deprecating that social network. We updated the Facebook SDK URL in order to support the latest version of the Facebook Website Chat plugin. We improved the Edit Web Page URL validation in order to reduce potential user errors. We updated the Top-Level Category filter in the Sub-Level Category Page in the Admin Panel in order to support searching the contents of the dropdown. We deprecated the HTTPS Recaptcha settings, now we only use the Original Recaptcha Settings for both http and https. We fixed an issue which was increasing the Search Results page load time for features when the Pin Featured Posts Add-on is active on a site. We fixed an issue which was affecting the ability to upload images using the Media Manager page in the Admin in some cases. We fixed a UI issue which was preventing the Accepted Label from displaying correctly on the Review Details Page in the Member Dashboard. We hid the Footer Newsletter Form when viewing /checkout pages. We fixed an issue that was adding an escape backslash in front of some characters in the keyword search modules. We fixed an issue which was preventing a member from deleting Sub-Accounts in some cases. We fixed an issue which was setting a member's status as "On Hold" even when the paid signup process was successfully completed. We fixed an issue which was preventing the keyword search module from finding members in a matching Sub-Sub Category in some cases We updated the fields where members add their related URLs (website, blog, and social media URLs) in order to support special characters in the URLs. Now the Member Profile and Search Results Review Stars will not showing in the Site if the "Hide Reviews Star Rating Option" setting in the Member Product Settings page is set to Yes. We added a meta tag to the the <HEAD> section of all sites with the RSS Feed Add-On active to make sure search engines are aware of the RSS feed. We fixed an issue which was causing the Blog Articles feature to not respect the Publish Date field when ordering blog posts in some cases. We updated the design of the Recent Reviews homepage widget to add some additional margin between each review. We fixed an issue which was removing the Member Search Results code after installing the Member Profile Analytics Add-On in some cases on older sites. We fixed an issue which was adding extra margin at the top of the Front-End pages when the site does not have a Main Menu. Imported members that have a password pre-set in the import file will now have the password automatically encrypted during import. We fixed an issue which was causing the Member Contact Form that displays on Post Details pages to not work properly in some cases. In all, over 85 feature enhancements and software updates were released this month. For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . Was this article helpful and accurate? Yes No Send feedback Sorry we couldn't be helpful. Help us improve this article with your feedback.

results.title: Changelog - January 2019 | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: Changelog - January 2019 Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000093683 New Features: We created two new Text Labels to be used on Member Search Results pages. New text labels: results_search_results_tab and read_more_search_tab. Members can now see their Product Level in the sidebar of the member dashboard when they are logged into their account. We added back the "Ok" button that displays in the popup after saving the Member Categories page in the Admin Area. All text in the Member Review form is now fully based on Text Labels. The text of the "Search" button in the Header Search module is now a Text Label. We updated the UI of the Match Lead Details page in the Admin Area. The Remove Card button text on the Billing Details page in the Member Dashboard is now a Text Labels. New text label: account_clear_credit_card. Now if an Admin clicks on the "View Live Profile" option in the Actions dropdown for a member on the "Search Members" page in the Admin, it will only redirect to the member's profile page if the member is Active and therefor their live profile will be viewable. Otherwise it will show a message explaining that the profile page is not viewable due to the member not being Active. We updated the UI of the Multi-Locations Listings Add-On in the Member Dashboard area. We added Google Recaptcha validation to the Default External Paid Signup form. We updated the Revenue column on the "Search Members" page in the Admin Area in order to show the Past Due amount for a Member. Now the Featured Blog Article slider is fully controlled by the Add-On Manager. We added Schema Markup classes for Breadcrumbs links displayed on the frontend of websites. Now the title attribute for the "Send a Message", "Write a Review" and "Show Phone Number" buttons on Member Profile pages are now Text Labels. New text labels: view_phone_number, contact_label, write_a_review_for. We created a new Display Setting for the Edit Web Page section called "Hide Banner Ads". This setting will help Admins hide banner ads on specific pages and SEO templates. In order to use this new feature navigates to Admin >> Content >> Edit Web Pages >> Edit >> Display Settings. We created two new Design Settings in order to control the layout of the Join Offer link and the About Website button on the homepage. In order to use this new feature navigates to Admin >> Settings >> Design Settings >> Homepage Layout >> About Website and Join Offer. We added the ability to choose a sort order for Top Level Categories when viewed in dropdowns on the site. To use this, change the "Front-End Display" setting on the Member Categories page in the Admin Area. In order to use this new feature navigates to Admin >> Members >> Member Categories >> Top level Categories Tab. We added the ability to display custom widgets in the Member Dashboard area. With these new settings an Admin can now select custom widgets to display on the member's dashboard without editing a default widget. In order to use this new feature, navigate to Admin >> Finance >> Manage Products >> Edit >> Additional Settings tab. We created a new Advanced Setting in order to choose which languages show up for the Google Translator Add-On. New Advanced Setting: translate_languages. Now the Delete modal on the View Post page in the Member Dashboard Area is fully based on text labels. Enhancements / Fixes: We fixed an issue which was causing the Back button on the Edit Widget page to redirect to a 404 error in some cases. We updated the Lead Information on the Dashboard page in the Admin to show the number of Leads that need to be matched instead of the total number of Leads. We fixed an issue which was affecting the normal behavior of the Show Advertisement On Listing Product setting in some cases. We fixed an issue which was causing the location of a member search to not display in the H1 tag of the search results page in some cases. We fixed an issue which was causing the System Updates Module in the Admin Dashboard to install an update even if the "Install Button" was not clicked. The issue which was affecting the ability to upload Profile Images using Microsoft Edge browser have been fixed. We did a Security Update to the Create Email Template section, now Email Teamplates can not be saved without a Subject and Email Body message. We implemented a Security Update to the algorithm who handles the abilty to highlight the widgets when somebody press the "Show Widget button" on the Front-End Admin Bar. We fixed an issue which was affecting the ablity to View/Edit the Member Categories Page in the Admin Area. We fixed an issue which was causing after deletes a Widget the system redirect to a 404 error in some cases. We added a confirmation prompt when a site Admin is placing an Order in the Admin Panel. We removed deprecated functionality from one of the core files that load in all Front-End pages. We fixed an issue which was affecting the mobile view of the Blog Post Slider Add-On in the homepage. We fixed an issue that was affecting the signup process in some cases. We fixed an issue which was causing the Blog Article search module to not work properly in some cases. We fixed an issue which was preventing a member from upgrading their membership in some cases. We implemented a Security Update so Admins can no longer edit the username of their account, but can still create a new one if necessary. We deprecated the "Email Login Info" link from the Admin Accounts page in the Admin Area as all Admin Accounts have encrypted information that cannot be emailed. We updated the "Compose Email" validation page in order to support modern domain gTLDs. We removed the Breadcrumbs, Sidebar and full width settings from the Homepage Edit page in the Admin Area as they are not used for the Homepage. We improved the logic of the Restore Defaults button on the Autosuggest Settings page in the Admin Area. We fixed an issue which was affecting the normal behavior of the Signup Pages when the GDPR module have been activated on a Site. Now if a Custom Form has been disabled, it will not been displayed in the Select Form To Use setting on the Edit Post Settings page in the Admin Panel. We fixed an issue which was affecting the display of the Sub Level Categories widget on the homepage when viewing on a mobile device. We fixed an issue which was affecting the ability of a Member to accept a Lead in some cases. We improved the validation of the Soundcloud URL field to ensure it has a valid Soundcloud URL when saving the post. Now the search_results_require_complete_profile A dvanced Setting will also check if a Member has a Profile Photo or Logo Photo before displaying them on a Search Results page. We improved the logic for the "Hide Field Labels" setting in the Leads Settings page in the Admin to not hide the labels for Checkbox and Radio fields as that will cause those fields to not display correctly. We fixed an issue which was preventing the name of the Product from displaying in the "Upgrade" Email Template when it is sent. We removed the additional Signup Button from displaying in the Recent and Featured Member widgets when viewing a site on a mobile device. We fixed an issue which was affecting the display of the Collect Payment modal on the Transaction History page in the Admin Area. We updated the "Google Map Search Results" Add-On to include the additional posts on the map that are retrieved when the "Load More" button is clicked on search results pages using the "Insta-Load Search Results" Add-On. In all, over 70 feature enhancements and software updates were released this month. For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . Was this article helpful and accurate? Yes No Send feedback Sorry we couldn't be helpful. Help us improve this article with your feedback.

results.title: Changelog - February 2019 | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: Changelog - February 2019 Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000093684 New Features: We added Danish as a new language option that can be selected for the Google Map Language setting in the Admin. We updated the UI of the image upload section when a member adds or edits a post to better support mobile devices. We moved the View Profile and Upgrade Listing buttons visible when logged in the the Member Dashboard from below the header of the page to the sidebar of the page. We updated the UI of the Member Upgrade pages in the member dashboard. We released the Member Profile Badges Add-On. For more information click here . We added a new setting to the Edit Post section in the Admin Area called Respect Membership Level Search Priority setting. This setting will first group posts by the Search Priority of the member who made the post before sorting them by the selected sort order. In order to use this new feature, navigate to Admin >> Content >> Edit Post Settings >> Search Results Design tab. We updated the UI of the Email Templates page in the Admin. We updated the Post Auto-Suggest feature to include the location information of posts displayed as autosuggestions in a keyword search field. Now the Manage Leads page in the Member Dashboard is fully based on text labels. New Text Labels: leads_no_data_available, leads_showing_no_data_info, leads_showing_no_data_info. Enhancements / Fixes: We removed the "Image Filter" link when we right-click on an image file in the Admin Media Manager. We also added the "Copy File URL" link when a user right-clicks on a PDF file. The Admin Account last login date is now based on the Website Time Zone setting ( General Settings >> Configuration tab >> "Website Time Zone" ) instead of the server's timezone. We deprecated the ability to edit the sort order of images in Photo Album Posts (Classifieds, Products, Photo Albums, Properties) on mobile devices as it was causing usability issues when scrolling on the page. The sort order can still be edited on all other devices. Note: This ability was available when the lazy_load A dvanced Settings was set as 0. We fixed an issue with the Members-Only Access setting on the Edit Post Settings page in the Admin. This setting is available when the Members-Only Content Add-On is active on a Site. We fixed an issue with the Spam Form Protector that was preventing members from signing up on a website in some cases. We fixed an issue which was preventing an email notification from being sent to a user when they signup for a site's Newsletter. We fixed an issue with the Google Recaptcha used on the Get Matched form of sites in some cases. We released a large security update which adds additional encryption to multiple layers of the Brilliant Directories infrastructure. We fixed an issue which was causing the Recent Events widget to not display the newest event posts even when the Display Order settings was set to display the Newest Event first. We fixed an issue which was preventing invoices from being downloaded when the Dowloadable PDF Invoices Add-On was active in some cases. We improved the logic of the Honey Pot field included in member signup forms for SPAM protection. We updated the logic of how member addresses are displayed on Member Search Result pages. We fixed an issue which was causing the Insta-Load functionality to not work properly for the Events tab on Member Profile pages when the Auto-Recurring Events Add-On is active on a site. We fixed an issue which was causing the Pay Per Post Add-On to not show the correct price when purchasing a Post in some cases. We updated the the location suggestions functionality when searching for members by location in the Admin to show the exact same options as the one use when searching for members by location on the front end of a site. We updated the "Admin Account Forgot Password" logic in order to make it compatible with the most recent Admin Account updates. We updated the UI when an Admin clicks the "Show Widget button" on the Front-End Admin Bar to only show widgets that are editable. We improved the logic of the Visit Website Link in the Admin Area to use the protocol used by the site (http or https) when the button is clicked. We fixed an issue which was causing the system to use the default version of a form instead of the custom version of the form when the Bootstrap Theme - Function - Form widget has been customized on a site. We fixed an issue which was causing devices in some locations to return a very general result (state or country instead of city) when the Detect Visitors Location Add-On is active. We fixed an issue which was affecting the ability to process refunds from the Admin in some cases. We implemented a security update in order to avoid XSS attacks targeting the page parameter. We updated the help link inside the duplicate widget tag on the Widget Manager page in the Admin. We fixed an issue which was preventing searches for members by country in the Admin from returning the correct results in some cases. We fixed an issue which was preventing the Insert Link feature of the "Default Email Signature" WYSIWYG in the Admin General Settings from working properly in some cases. We updated several variables used in the default code found in the Post Settings area of the Admin to make them more secure. We fixed an issue which was causing Custom Forms to not display in the dropdowns on the Profile Tab in the Edit Member Product section of the Admin. We made an update to require that all Admin Usernames be unique, valid email address. We updated the logic of the Member Related Searches widget to make it work more seamlessly with the preferred_domain Advanced Setting. The Member Reviews Sidebar widget will now show 1 star as a minimum rating for a member. We updated the display of checkbox options selected by a member when a custom checkbox field is added to a member form. The selected options will now display on the member's profile page always followed by a comma and a space. We fixed an issue which was causing the system to set the wrong Member Status if the signup process did not complete successfully in some cases. We refactored the code of the Manage Product page in the Admin in order to reduce the load time of the page. We fixed an issue which was causing Checkout pages to show a connection error in some cases. We fixed an issue which was preventing the Detect Visitor Location Add-On from working properly in some cases. We implemented a couple of minor workflow updates to the View Leads page in the Admin. We fixed an issue which was preventing the Member Profile Analytics Add-On from collecting data properly in some cases. We fixed an issue which was causing the Member Related Searches widget to show inaccurate location links in some cases. We fixed an issue which was affecting searches for members in New Zealand in some cases. We removed an extra space which was showing below of the Member Results on the /listing page. We updated the Newsletter signup Form to be fully compatible with the Spam Form Protector Add-On. We the Clone Email Template functionality to avoid the collision of templates with the same name. The system will now return a 404 error page as expected when trying to view a /checkout page that does not exist. In all, over 70 feature enhancements and software updates were released this month. For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . Was this article helpful and accurate? Yes No Send feedback Sorry we couldn't be helpful. Help us improve this article with your feedback.

results.title: Changelog - March 2019 | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: Changelog - March 2019 Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000093685 New Features: The System will now reset the Google Recaptcha field automatically without refreshing page when a form submission fails. With this update, users will not have to refresh the page before attempting the submission again. The Auto-Recurring Event Add-On is now fully based on Text Labels. New Text labels: time_am_label, time_pm_label, swal_notice, photo_upload_max_images, photo_upload_no_image_uploaded, photo_album_created_message. We added the ability to set a limit on the number of Sub-Accounts each member can have on a per-product basis when a site has the Multi-Member Manager Add-On active. We released the Private Member Chat Add-On. Click here for more information. We added a Search Filter field to the Front-End Text-Label Editor. The Export Member Data Add-On will now optionally include the Paid Revenue, Past-Due and Refund information for each Member when members are exported. We created a new Search Filter field in the Manage Post page in the Admin Area in order to filter results based on the Status of the Post. We created a new Product Setting that hides or shows Banner Ads when a member is viewing their Member Dashboard. In order to use this new feature, navigate to the Admin >> Finance >> Manage Products >> Edit >> Additional Settings tab. The Billing Details page in the Member Dashboard section is now fully based on Text Labels. We added the ability to attempt collection on multiple Past-Due Invoices simultaneously from the Transaction History page in the Admin. In order to use this new feature, navigate to the Admin >> Finance >> Transaction History >> Past Due tab . We added an Alert Message to the Widget Manager page in the Admin when a member of our team temporarily disables the custom widgets on a site to troubleshoot an issue reported by the site's owner. We refactored the code of the Member Import page in the Admin Area in order to be able to support large CSV import files. We removed the Actions Dropdown for the Listing, Reviews, Specialties and Favorites features on the Edit Post Settings page in the Admin. We changed the name of the "Enable Insta-Load Search Results" option to "Pagination Display Options" on the Edit Post Settings Page in the Admin. Admins can now choose to use the Insta-Load Search Results Add-On, Standard Pagination or Hide the Pagination. We improved the logic of the Expanded Keyword Search Add-On in order to include custom data and show more accurate results. We updated the Text Label of the View All Button in the Recent Reviews widget. We updated the UI of the View All Button in the Recent Top Categories Widget. We released the Featured Members on Homepage Add-On. Click here for more information. We created a new Product Setting in order to disable signup pages for specific Products. Enabling this setting will prevent members from signing up for the Product. In order to use this new Feature navigates to the Admin >> Finance >> Manage Products >> Edit >> Pricing Tab. We deprecated the yellow warning messages at the top of Admin pages and created a new Website Conflicts section which contains these notifications. This new feature can be found in the top-right section of Admin pages. We added the ability for the Pay Per Post Add-On to set a Post Max Limit without charging a price for an additional post if desired. In order to use this new feature, navigate to the Admin >> Finance >> Manage Products >> Edit >> Post Publishing tab. We released the "Report This Page" Add-On. Click here for more information. We updated the "Bookmark My Favorites" Add-On to show the total number of times a page has been bookmarked next to the bookmark icon. In order to use this new feature navigates to the Admin >> Setting >> Design Setting >> Search Results section. Enhancements / Fixes: We deprecated the "Get Email Updates" field when editing an Admin Account. We updated the Multi-Member Manager Add-On in order to prevent Sub-Accounts from creating other Sub-Accounts in all cases. We implemented a Security Update to escape HTML in the title tag (<title></title>) and in the "og:title" elements on all pages. We improved the "Enable Recurring Events" setting found on the Edit Post Settings page in the Admin, making sure the Add-On is always turned fully on or fully off through this setting. The Google Developer Key, Google Developer Client ID and the Facebook App ID fields are now required to be setup before the Google and Facebook login buttons will appear on signup and login pages when the One-Click Social Login Add-on is active. We fixed an error that was appearing when signing up as a new member is some cases. We deprecated an Advanced Setting which was no longer being used to enable the Easy Coupon Codes Add-On. We added extra logic to insure members can only upgrade to the Products specified in the Available Upgrade Options area on the Product Edit page in the Admin. New sites will now have a custom copy of the Login Page Links menu available on their sites by default. We fixed an issue which was preventing the site's logo from appearing in PDF invoices generated by the Downloadable PDF Invoices Add-On. We fixed an issue which was preventing files with capitalized file extensions (EG: .JPG rather than .jpg) from being uploaded properly through the Media Manager. When a member signs up for a paid product but the payment fails, they will now receive an additional notification that they can login to their newly created account to update their credit card and complete the signup process. We updated some of the text of the Media Manager page in the Admin. We fixed an issue which was affecting the normal behavior of the Event End Date field when the Auto-Recurring Events Add-On is active on a site in some cases. We fixed an issue which causing the Export Member Data Add-On to generate improperly formatted files in some cases. We fixed an issue with the Form Styles field on the Edit Form Settings page in the Admin which was preventing the inputted styles from modifying the form properly. The show_dashboard_manage_listing Product Setting will now hide the Manage Listing menu items in the Account Sidebar Menu in the Member Dashboard Area. Images displayed in the Feature Blog Article Slider Add-On will now display at their original aspect ratio, centered on the page rather than stretched to fit the container. We fixed an issue which was preventing the Member Login form from displaying an error message when incorrect login credentials were used. We fixed an issue which was preventing Posts from being marked as "Featured" using the Pin Featured Posts Add-On in some cases. We implemented an update to all forms to prevent the saving of extraneous data in the database when the form is submitted. We fixed an issue with the Member Export Data Add-On which was causing Member Export files to show duplicate information in some cases. The Date Picker, Category Dropdown, and Star Rating fields are now fully compatible with the "Required" Field Setting in the Form Manager. We fixed an issue which was causing the Profile Image uploader to change the file extension of uploaded images to .png in some cases. We fixed an issue which was affecting the member signup process on checkout pages when the One-Click Social Login Add-On is enabled but the Facebook or Google credentials have not yet been setup. We fixed an issue which was preventing the Member Profile Analytics Add-On from saving data properly in some cases. We implemented a set of small aesthetic changes to the Google Map Controls shown on maps on the frontend of websites to remove unnecessary options that limit the viewport of the map. The issue which was affecting the ability to accept/decline Member Reviews in the Admin using certain mobile devices has been fixed. We renamed some Banner Ad Titles on the Design Settings Page in the Admin Area in order to make the intended use of each banner ad field more clear. We fixed an issue which was causing the "About" WYSIWYG in the Member Dashboard to not respect the image alignment when the content was displayed on live profile pages. We removed some extra space which was showing on Feature Search Results pages when the Google Map Search Results Add-On is active on a Site. We fixed an issue which was preventing members from being able to click on the Main Menu icon when viewing the Chat Messages page on mobile devices. We added the ability to re-open a message thread after a thread has been reported and closed by a member. We improved the Member Search Results SQL logic in order to return more accurate results for keyword searches. We updated the Error Messages when an Admin User tries to manually collect payments from the Transaction History Page in the Admin. We fixed an issue which was preventing profile pages from reading the default version of a form when a corresponding custom form of the same name was disabled. We fixed an issue which was preventing the Pagination on the Manage Post Page in the Admin from working properly. We removed the Actions Dropdown for the Listing, Reviews, Specialties and Favorites features on the Edit Post Settings page in the Admin. We improved the logic of the /locations page in order to show more accurate results for cities and countries. We fixed an issue with the naming convention of the member profile photos and logos created for social media sharing. We fixed an issue which was preventing the last day of an Event from displaying on the Event Calendar in some cases. The "Not Active Account" box in the Member Dashboard and the "View My CV" Form Field are now fully compatible with the Front-End Edit Text Label feature. We updated the Google Maps API Usage Status Checker on the Admin dashboard in order show a more specific API status message for different API responses. We fixed an issue which was causing the Export Member Data Add-On to show an incorrect format for some data. We improved the Validation for the Parent ID field on the Quick Edit Form in the Admin Search Results page when the Multi-Member Manager Add-On is active on a Site. This validation will prevent infinite sub account loops and sub-sub accounts from being accidentally set. The "Full-Width Page" setting on the Edit Web Pages section of the Admin is now only available when the Page Type setting is set as "Single Web Page". We fixed an issue with members using 100% coupon off coupon codes in some cases. We fixed an issue which was causing menus to show empty <li> HTML tags when the Menu does not have any content. We added logic to prevent any 2 members from having the same profile page URL in all cases. In all, over 90 feature enhancements and software updates were released this month. For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . Was this article helpful and accurate? Yes No Send feedback Sorry we couldn't be helpful. Help us improve this article with your feedback.

results.title: Changelog - April 2019 | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: Changelog - April 2019 Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000093686 New Features: We improved the functionality of the Pin Featured Posts Add-On, by adding the ability to specify a date the Featured Post expires. In order to use this new feature, navigate to the Admin >> Content >> Manage Posts . Note: This update only will be available if the site has the Pin Featured Posts Add-On active. The Lead Form title is now fully compatible with the Front-End Text Label Editor tool. We added the ability to show the Website Timezone below Date, Time, and Datetime picker field. In order to enable this new feature, navigate to the Admin >> Settings >> General Settings >> Configuration Tab. The "Promo Discount" text in the Order Summary on Checkout pages is now a Text Label. New Text label: promo_discount_label. The Auto-Recurring Event Add-On is now fully compatible with the" Order Results By" Setting on the Edit Post Settings page in the Admin. Choosing a language using the Language Setting in the Configuration tab on the General Settings page of the Admin will now also update the language of PDF invoices generated by the site. The title tags of the available buttons on the Profile Photo and Logo page in the Member Dashboard can now be edited via Text Labels. New Labels: photo_zoom_in, photo_zoom_out, photo_move_left, photo_move_right, photo_move_up, photo_move_down, photo_rotate_left, photo_rotate_right, photo_flip_vertical, photo_flip_horizontal, photo_crop. We added a filter field to the Edit Post Settings page in the Admin. We refactored the Reviews feature search to be controlled by a widget called "Search - Reviews - Search Query". Also, we created a new Reviews Filter Search Module. In order to use this new Reviews Filter Search Module, navigate to the Admin >> Content >> Edit Post Settings >> Reviews >> Search Results Tab >> Sidebar Search Module. We added integrations with ShareaSale and PostAffiliatePro. These can be integrated on a site by entering the corresponding information in the General Settings >> Integrations tab in the Admin. We released the Filter By Star Rating Add-On. Click here for more information. We added the ability to export Contacts as a CSV file. In order to use this new feature, navigates to the Admin >> Emails >> View Contacts. We added the ability to control how many results will display per row in Recent Homepage Widgets. In order to use this feature, navigate to the Admin >> Settings >> Design Settings >> Homepage Layout tab >> Homepage Section Order Options. We created a new Design Setting to control the background color of post images on Post Search Results and Post Details pages. In order to use this new feature, navigate to the Admin >> Settings >> Design Settings >> Design Settings tab >> Additional Design Setting section. Select2 dropdown fields marked as required in the Form Manager will now be treated as required when displayed on a site. We created a new Design Setting to control whether or not a "View All' button on displays in the Recent Member homepage widget. In order to use this new feature, navigates to the Admin >> Settings >> Design Settings >>Homepage Layout Tab >> Homepage Section Order Options. Enhancements / Fixes: We fixed an issue which was preventing the Admin Bar to display on the frontend of websites in some cases. We fixed an issue with the Feature Members On Homepage Add-On which was causing it to not use the correct widget in some cases. The Checkbox field in the Form Manager module is fully compatible with the Required form field setting. We fixed an issue which was causing the Member Categories Autosuggest feature to not work properly if the category name included an apostrophe. We fixed an issue which was preventing the proper import of member images when importing members via CSV file. We fixed an issue with the member import tool which was causing instances of "nn" in the file creating a line break. We added "postal_code_prefix" as a supported location type in the member search system. Now searching for a postal code prefix location will return results as expected. We fixed an issue which was causing the Event End-Date field in post forms to not display the datepicker in some cases. We fixed an issue which was causing the Edit Widget page in the Admin Panel to show the "Save Changes" confirmation alert when pressing the keyboard Space Bar in some cases. We fixed an issue which was preventing the Recent Videos homepage widget from showing the Video Details link button on iPhones. We fixed an issue which was causing Checkout pages to not function properly when the the Newsletter Signup form was displaying on the page. We fixed an issue which was causing textareas in the Admin that have code highlighting turned on to not scroll smoothly in some cases. We fixed an issue with the alignment of the success message when deleting a Menu Item in the Menu Manager in the Admin. We fixed an issue which was affecting the use of the "Insert Image" feature of the WYSIWYG when editing a web page in the Admin. We fixed an issue which was causing Members to have their status set as Past Due automatically when they had a Past Due invoice related to a lead rather than their membership. We fixed an issue with the Google Sitemap Generator Add-On which was creating empty Sitemap Files when a website does not have Member Categories or Sub-Level Categories. We improved the UI of member Profile Pages when one or more of the Send Message, Show Phone Number, and Write a Review buttons are disabled for the member's Product. We fixed an issue with the Media Manager Tool in the Admin which was prompting the user to download a JSON file when a new folder was created. We added the ability to edit the H1 title on post search results pages. New text labels: default_search_listings_text, h1_for_label, search_results_location_operand, results_for_separator. We minified some default JS files used on the frontend of sites in order to speed up the loading of these pages. We fixed an issue with the Bookmark my Favorites Add-On which was causing favorites text to overlap when search results were displayed in Grid View. We fixed an issue which was causing the H1 element on member search results pages to show unexpected text in some cases. We fixed an issue which was preventing the General Settings page in the Admin from saving when the Members-Only Content Add-On was de-activated on a site in some cases. The "Hide Reviews Star Rating Options" Product Setting will now hide the Review Stars on Review Search Results pages and Member Profile pages. We fixed an issue with the 301 Redirect feature where URLs that ends with /connect not being redirected as expected in some cases. We optimized the Google Autocomplete API feature in order to request more specific information which may lower the cost of using the API in some cases. The Filter By Top Level Category dropdown on the Member Category page will now display the categories in alphabetical order. We fixed an issue which was causing the "Write a Review" button on Member Profile pages to not display in some cases. We fixed an issue which was causing "Hide Specialties Tab" Product Setting to not work properly when Member Profile pages are set to "Display Member Content Without Tabs". We resolved an issue that was displaying a backslash after apostrophes when included in the content of an Admin account. We fixed an issue which was causing the "View Preview" button to not work properly after a member creates a new Sub-Account in their Member Dashboard. We updated the look of the "View my CV" button on member profiles pages. We updated the Sidebar Manager page in the Admin to exclude homepage widgets that do not work properly in sidebars from the list of available widgets. We fixed an issue which was preventing replies to reviews from being saved when the reply was longer that 512 characters. We updated the version of the Event Search Date picker script to better support mobile devices. We updated the Manage Products page in the Admin in to replace the "Sign Up Page" button with the message "Sign Ups Disabled" when a Product has the "Disable Signups For This Product" setting enabled. We fixed an issue which was preventing the Private Member Chat Add-On from showing the correct Sender information on the My Chat Messages page in the Member Dashboard in some cases. The Website Activity Log in the Admin now tracks when a Form is Enabled, Disabled or Deleted. We fixed an issue which was preventing members from downloading an Invoice when the Downloadable PDF Invoices Add-On is active on a Site. We improved the Admin Usernames validation to insure Admin Usernames are a valid email address format. We are no longer displaying the Breadcrumbs field when a Site Admin is editing a Static Web Page in the Admin. We updated the logic of the Listing Search Results H1 Title. Now if the /search_results SEO Template H1 Title is empty, the system will display the Feature Search Results Title as a backup. We fixed an issue which was causing the Write a Review Button to display slightly out of alignment on Member Profile pages in some cases. We updated the UI of the Leads Details page in the Member Dashboard to display the content of the lead more clearly on mobile devices. We fixed a display issue with the 301 Redirect Search Filter Field causing the search icon to overlap with the text. We updated the URL of the Menu Manager page in the Admin. We fixed a design issue on the Member Account Details page in the Admin which was causing the "Cancelled" text to display without the proper background color when a member's status is Cancelled. We fixed an issue which was causing the scroll bar to get stuck when viewing a code editor in the Admin. The Category dropdowns on Lead Forms on member profile pages will now display all Sub Categories when the member is automatically added to all categories in their Product's settings. We added Search Filter Options to the Email Templates page in the Admin to allow Email Templates to be filtered by Keyword or Category. We improved the logic of the Email Notification badge in order to only take into consideration un-read and un-archived Form Inquiry records. We fixed an issue with the sort order of Reviews on Profile pages. Now the most recent reviews will be displayed first. In all, over 80 feature enhancements and software updates were released this month. For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . Was this article helpful and accurate? Yes No Send feedback Sorry we couldn't be helpful. Help us improve this article with your feedback.

results.title: Changelog - May 2019 | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: Changelog - May 2019 Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000093687 New Features: We added Bulk Actions functionality to the View Members page in the Admin. This new feature will enable Site Admins to change the Status or Product of a Member, or Delete members in bulk. We updated the display of the Import Member page in the Admin. We added a new Transaction Type to the "Transaction Types" field on the Search Member page in the Admin called "Stopped / Cancelled". Choosing this option will only show members which have a Stopped or Cancelled Product Subscription. We updated the look of the Activity Tracker page in the Admin. We added the ability to Enable/Disabled Widgets in bulk on the Widget Manager page in the Admin. We added text to checkout pages to inform users whether a coupon code applies to only the first payment, or all future payments. This featured will be available when the Easy Coupon Codes Add-On is active on a Site. New Text Labels: promocode_nonrecurring_help_text_label, promocode_recurring_help_text_label. We created a new Design Setting to control whether or not to display the Member's Category in the Recent and Featured Member widgets on the homepage. In order to use this new feature, navigate to the Admin >> Settings >> Design Settings >> Homepage Layout tab >> Homepage Section Order Options. We released the Sell Digital Downloads Add-On. Click here for more information. We updated the aesthetics of the Member Reviews, Send Newsletter, Manage Leads, Email Templates Preview, Import Member Categories, and View Contacts pages in the Admin. We updated the aesthetics of the Coupon Codes, Country Settings, and Form Inquiries pages in the Admin. We added a Keyword Filter Search field to the Add-Ons Status page in the Admin. We created new Design Settings that allow the Admin to Show Categories with or without Photos in the Recent Categories widget. In order to use this new feature navigates to the Admin >> Settings >> Design Settings >> Homepage Layout tab >> Homepage Section Order Options box. We updated the layout of the Sidebar Manager page in the Admin. We updated the aesthetics of the Send Newsletter process in the Admin. We created new Design Setting that allows an Admin to select which Products' Members will display in the Recent Members. To use this new feature, navigate to the Admin >> Settings >> Design Settings >> Homepage Layout tab >> Homepage Section Order Options box. Enhancements / Fixes: We fixed an issue which was causing the Member Search Results H1 Title to show twice when performing a member keyword search in some cases. We applied a design fix to the "Reply to Review" field in the Member Review Details page in order to expand the textarea vertically. We fixed an issue which was causing Member Search Sidebar widgets to not auto-select the searched Sub and Sub-Sub Categories after performing a search. We fixed an issue which was causing upgrade options to display a price when the Product had been marked as Free in some cases. We updated the description of the Require Location and Require Category settings on the Lead Settings page in the Admin. Location searches for posts now support the Strict Search Advanced Setting. We fixed an issue which was causing a website's logo to not link to the homepage of the site properly when displayed on securemypayment.com payment pages. We fixed an issue which was preventing the Turkish Finansbank Payment Gateway credentials from being edited in the Admin Area. We deprecated the HTTPS Recaptcha Settings on the Advanced Settings page. These credentials will continue to be updated in the General Settings >> Integrations tab. Deprecated Advanced Settings: https_recaptcha_site_key and https_recpatcha_secret_key. We improved the logic of the Search Members page in the Admin when the "Search Location" and "Transaction Types" fields are used to search for members. We fixed an issue which was causing the Transaction Tab on the Member Account Details page in the Admin to inaccurate results when using the Load Next Results button in some cases. We removed the Members column on the Member Category page in the Admin and merged its contents into the Action column. This change will help with the display of this page on mobile devices. We updated the text of the Admin menu item "Website Activity Log" to "Activity Tracker". We added the ability to remove the Featured Post Expiration Date when one has been assigned to a post in the Admin using the Pin Featured Post Add-On. We improved the logic of the Profile Tab settings of Products to resolve a conflict that could arise with certain deprecated Advanced Settings. We fixed an issue which was preventing the Member Export Data Add-On from working properly in properly in some cases. We added the total number of pending leads as a notification next to the Leads menu item in the Admin. We fixed an issue which was preventing Member Bulk Actions on the Search Members page in the Admin from functioning properly in some cases. We fixed an issue which was causing the Froala WYSIWYG to not upload images with capitalized file extensions in some cases. We made an update so that an Admin will be redirected to the Member Categories page after importing Member Categories in the Admin. Previously it was redirecting the user back to the Member Category Import Tool instead. We moved the "Search Engine Visibility" setting from being an Advanced Setting to being a General Setting. To find the setting, navigate to the Admin >> Settings >> General Settings >> Configuration Tab. We fixed an issue which was affecting the ability to edit widgets in the Admin using the link for the widget seen when editing a Sidebar in the Sidebar Manager. We added the "Add-On Available" tag to the Multi-Location Listings and Click-To-Call Members Add-Ons on the Edit Products page in the Admin. We fixed an issue which was causing the System to send several emails if the Compose Email modal was opened in a New tab. We fixed an issue which was preventing the Email Signature from being included when sending a Newsletter Test from the Send Newsletter page in the Admin. We fixed an issue which was affecting the Redirect Action after an Admin deletes a Single 301 Redirect Rule in the Admin. We refactored the function which retrieves Member Subcategories on the Member Search Results page in order to reduce the page load time. We fixed an issue which was causing the Member Upgrades page to show an incorrect "Save Message Label" when a Quarterly Price was the only recurring option available for the upgrade. We fixed an issue which was affecting the ability to submit the Get Matched form on Member Profile Pages. We fixed an issue which was causing Post location information to be saved with the location information of the Member even when a Location was correctly entered for the post. We fixed an issue which was causing the Facebook Feed widget to not work properly in some cases. We added the ability to add the Buy Post button multiple times on Details pages for the Sell Digital Downloads Add-On. We fixed an issue which was displaying the $ currency symbol in some places when another currency was selected for a site. We refactored the code of the Admin Dashboard in order to reduce the page load time. We removed the Invoice Table which was showing when an Admin clicks on the "CC Info" button on the Transactions Tab of the Member Account Details page in the Admin. We fixed an issue which was affecting the redirect action after an Admin creates a new Contact on the View Contact page in the Admin area. We fixed an issue which was preventing a "Joined Date" from being saved for Sub-Account Members when they were created. We moved the Specialties, Reviews and Bookmark My Favorites Add-On options to the top of the Post Publishing tab on the Edit Product Settings page. The other Feature Options display in alphabetical order. We fixed an issue which was causing failed Lead purchase invoices to display as "Past Due" in the Transaction History page. In all, over 90 feature enhancements and software updates were released this month. For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . Was this article helpful and accurate? Yes No Send feedback Sorry we couldn't be helpful. Help us improve this article with your feedback.

results.title: Changelog - June 2019 | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: Changelog - June 2019 Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000093688 New Features: We released an update to several widgets and PHP files to make them compatible with PHP 7. We will be updating all existing servers to use PHP 7 in the coming months. We added the ability to enable/disable forms in bulk on the Form Manager page in the Admin. We updated the logic of the 301 Redirect module in order to support external as well as Internal redirect links. We added a new Email Variable to the System, the signup_date_format will display the Signup Date of the Member based on the format selected on the General Settings page. We released the Export Member Categories feature. We added a security check to the Profile Photos and Post Feature Image upload fields used in the Member Dashboard, and to the Member and Categories Import Tools and Media Manager pages in the Admin. This security check will validate that all files being uploaded to the site are of the correct type and do not contain malicious code. We added the ability to search by Login IP or Join IP address on the Member Search Results page in the Admin. We improved the Member Keyword Search logic making it possible to search by keywords, categories, and more, returning all of the results together. In order to use this new feature, navigate to the Admin >> Settings >> General Settings >> Configuration Tab >> Member Keyword Search Type. We released the Real Estate Company Theme. We added a Dynamic Search Filter module to the Unsubscribe List page in the Admin. We added a new Search Field in the Form Inquiries pages, the Filter By Form search field will sort the Form Inquiries result based on the form submitted. We released the Highlight Member Results Add-On. Click here for more information. We added the "Create Date", "Start Date", "End Date" and "Last Edit" information for each post in the Manage Posts page in the Admin. We added the ability to log the "Enable", "Disable" and "Delete" Widget actions in the Admin Activity Tracker. We released the ability to rotate Individual photos when editing photo album posts in the Member Dashboard. We created a tool to the Admin General Settings in order to identify if the Default Website Email is blocked from receiving emails and unblock it if it is. We added the ability to place custom HTML content Above Member Results, Below Member Results, Above Body Content, Below Body Content and Inside a Tab when an Admin adds content a to a Member Search Results page by creating a Single Web Page for it. In order to use this new feature, navigate to the Admin >> Content >> Edit Web Pages >> Display Settings section. We updated the logic of the Export Member Data Add-On in order to include the Profile Photo and Logo image URLs of members in the export file. We added the ability to automatically update the sitemap generated by the Google Sitemap Generator Add-On every week or every month. In order to use this new feature navigates to the Admin >> Toolbox >> Sitemap Generator. We added the ability to add custom code to the footer of a site (just above the closing </body> tag without editing a widget. In order to use this new feature, navigate to the Admin >> Settings >> Design Settings >> Custom CSS / HEAD tab. We created a new sets of Text Labels for the File Validation alerts shown when uploading a file through the frontend of a site. New Text Labels : file_validation_title, file_validation_messsage. We updated our Google Fonts implementation in order to use the latest version available. We updated the Froala WYSIWYG in the Default Email Signature section in the Admin General Settings in order to support links for images. Enhancements / Fixes: We fixed an issue which was preventing the Admin Dashboard from loading on sites with 10,000 or more invoices. We added a search filter field to the "Select Form to Use" field on the Edit Post Settings page in the Admin. We fixed an issue which was preventing all of the text from showing in some modals in the Admin. We updated the logic used in the Admin to determine whether to use http or https protocol, depending on whether or not an SSL Certificate is installed on a site. We updated the Easy Coupon Codes Add-On message in order to display a more accurate notification message depending on the type of coupon a member applies to their purchase. We added a confirmation modal when an Admin chooses to delete a Single Web Page one at a time and when using a bulk action. We fixed a UI issue which was causing the Admin Sidebar Menu to not display properly after the Compose Email modal is closed. We fixed an issue which was preventing the Review Submitter name from displaying in the Email Template sent after an Admin or Member approves a review. We excluded the URL of the submission Form from being checked by the SPAM Form Protector Add-On when a form is submitted. We fixed an issue which was causing Pay Per Post Add-On to get stuck on the "Processing Order" message if the Member making the purchase did not have full credit card information on file. We fixed an issue which was affecting the ability to select dates in the past using the Events Date Picker field in the Event Search Module. We fixed an issue which was preventing fields from being saved properly when a Default Form is initially customized. We fixed an issue which was causing the system to show the "Limit Post Reached" error message when editing an existing post that was not over the post limit. We fixed an issue which was preventing the full Transaction History totals from being displayed throughout the Admin. We fixed an issue which was preventing the Events Calendar from displaying Events in some cases. We fixed an issue which was preventing the Export Member Data Add-On files from adding information into the proper columns in the export file in some cases. We fixed an issue which was causing Checkbox Form Fields to show "Array" as an option in some cases. We fixed an issue which was preventing members from viewing content they should have access to when the "Members-Only Access" field was set as "Only Protect Details Pages" for a Post Type. We fixed an issue which was preventing the "Edit Post Settings" >> "Select Form To Use" field from showing the custom Forms available on the site as options. We fixed an issue which was preventing the Froala WYSIWYG from rendering on the "Edit Web Pages" and "SEO Templates" pages in the Admin in some cases. We fixed an issue with the "Limit Posts to These Products" Design Setting which was preventing posts from Non-Searchable members from being shown as options. We added a "Processing" message after an Admin clicks the "Save Sidebar" button when creating a new Sidebar. We updated the Signup Form Title in order to show the correct Title text if the One-Click Social Login Add-On is active but not being used on a site. The Sidebar settings chosen for a Static Page when the Page Type of the page is set as "Member Search Results" will now override the sidebar settings for member search results pages in the Design Settings. We fixed an issue which was causing the "Link / Text Inline Style Attribute" Menu Builder Element Setting field to not apply the styles when the Menu Element does not have a URL. We fixed an issue which was causing the Photo Gallery Full Screen button to make the browser full screen instead of the Photo Gallery. The Overview Tab on profile pages will now be hidden automatically when the tab has no content to display. We added an confirmation alert message when an Admin tries to Copy a Post Type in the Admin (Content >> Edit Post Settings). We updated the dates on the Lead Details Page in the Admin in order to use the Date Format selected for the site in the General Settings. Text Labels will now be highlighted when showing widgets / text labels when an Admin is viewing Post Management pages in the Member Dashboard. We fixed an issue which was causing Location Breadcrumbs to link to the incorrect URL in some cases. We updated the Froala Image Upload functionality in order to create a unique image folder for each member when they upload images to posts using the Froala WYSIWYG editor. We fixed an issue which was preventing the Private Member Chat Add-On Icon from displaying properly in the Member Dashboard area in some cases. We fixed a layout issue which was causing the Sales Rep Name Search field to show in the wrong location on the Member Search Results page in the Admin. We fixed an issue which preventing Custom Email Templates from being selectable when using the "Send Confirmation Email After Purchase" field in the Sell Digital Downloads form. We fixed an issue which was preventing Member Search Results pages from loading property in some cases. The Invoice Tax customization is now fully compatible with all Invoices generated by the system. We updated the Members Only field on the General Settings page to be a multi-line field so the content can be more easily edited. We fixed an issue which was preventing the Category fields in search modules from being autopopulated after completing a member search on the frontend of a site in some cases. We added the ability to highlighted the Text Labels available on the Write a Review form. We fixed an issue which was preventing the Downloadable PDF Invoices Add-On from working properly in some cases. We fixed an issue which was causing Member Search Results pagination links to show a PHP error in some cases. We fixed an issue which was causing Member Search Results to not display Members when using the Keyword Search and the Member keyword Search Type setting was set to "Inclusive". We fixed an issue which was causing the system to use incorrect SEO Templates when searching for members in some cases. We fixed an issue which was affecting the ability to render the Recent Blog and Recent Articles with Sidebars homepage widgets on servers using PHP 7. We updated the SQL engine widgets in order to prevent SQL Injections in Member search queries. We added a confirmation alert message when an Admin uses the Bulk Actions on the Manage Post Page in the Admin. We fixed an issue which was causing the "Quote" field in the Member Dashboard to not accept apostrophes on servers running PHP 7. We fixed an issue which was causing the searched location in the H1 of member search results pages to display in lower case in some cases. We fixed an issue which was preventing the system from automatically changing the status of a member to Past Due when the Member has a Past Due subscription invoice. We added a confirmation alert message when an Admin uses Bulk Actions on the 301 Redirects, View Contacts and Unsubscribe List pages in the Admin. We fixed an issue which was preventing the background of items in the Recent Sub Categories homepage widget from sliding up on mobile devices. We fixed an issue which was adding the member's ID to the end of their profile page URL when saving the Listing Contact form in the Member Dashboard. We fixed an issue which was preventing the system from uploading images using the Media Manager tool in the Admin in some cases. In all, over 90 feature enhancements and software updates were released this month. For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . Was this article helpful and accurate? Yes No Send feedback Sorry we couldn't be helpful. Help us improve this article with your feedback.

results.title: Changelog - July 2019 | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: Changelog - July 2019 Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000093689 New Features: We added the ability to set different images to be used as the Invoice Logo and Email Template Logo. In order to use this new feature navigate to the Admin >> Settings >> General Settings >>Brand Images. We added the ability to select which members can view each single "Web Page" when the site is set to be Members Only . Note: This feature is available when the Member-Only Content Add-On is active.
