results.title: How Can I Create a New Text Label or Custom Text Labels | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: How Can I Create a New Text Label or Custom Text Labels Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000097730 Brilliant Directories does not currently include a feature for creating custom text labels. However, the same result can be achieved by creating a custom widget that contains the desired text and displaying it anywhere on the website using a widget shortcode. Creating a Text Label Widget Log in to the Admin Area. Navigate to Toolbox → Widget Manager . Click New Widget . In the HTML tab, enter the text that should be displayed. Assign the widget a descriptive nickname that makes it easy to identify later. For example, if the widget displays the text "Join Us" , a nickname such as Text - Join Us helps keep similar text label widgets organized. Save the widget after entering the desired content. Displaying the Text Label Once the widget has been created, it can be displayed anywhere that supports widget shortcodes. For example: Copy [widget=Text - Join Us] Wherever this shortcode is added, the widget's content will be rendered on the page. This approach makes it easy to reuse the same text in multiple locations while only needing to update it in one place. results.title: How to Apply Coupon Codes or Price Overrides in the Admin When Manually Creating an Order | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: How to Apply Coupon Codes or Price Overrides in the Admin When Manually Creating an Order Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000097731 When manually creating an order in the Admin Area, there is no need to apply a coupon code. Instead, the order price can be adjusted directly, allowing any discount or price override to be entered manually. Creating a Manual Order with a Custom Price Log in to the Admin Area. Navigate to My Members → Search Members . Locate the member and click Actions → Payment History . Click New Order in the upper-right corner. Select the appropriate Membership Plan and Billing Cycle . Enter the desired price for the order. This value overrides the default price for the selected membership plan, making a coupon code unnecessary. Complete the remaining order details as needed. Click Save Changes to create the order. This approach can be used whenever a discounted price or one-time price adjustment needs to be applied to a manually created order. results.content: How to Clear and Remove User Cookies on Specific Web Pages Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000098261 This article explains how to remove a specific cookie when a visitor accesses a particular page on the website. Warning Cookies are used to maintain important website functionality, such as user authentication and session data. Removing cookies may affect how certain features behave. Use this code only when the cookie is no longer needed. For example, the claim_listing cookie is created when a visitor begins the process of claiming a member listing. results.title: Block Traffic by Country | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: Block Traffic by Country Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000098368 Say goodbye to unwanted website traffic and hello to a more secure and personalized website with the Block Traffic by Country website add-on. Easily prevent visitors from specific countries from accessing the front-end of your website, enhancing security and tailoring the website experience to the target audience. Ensure that only the desired audience can access the website. This add-on identifies a visitor's country based on their IP address. And based on the geo-location of the IP address , the rules set with the add-on will control a visitor's ability to access the website. Key Features & Benefits : Allow traffic from all countries except specified countries Allow traffic only from specific countries Website visitor location determined by their IP address Enhance security by preventing traffic from countries known for malicious activity Reduce spam by blocking traffic from countries notorious for spamming Tailor content based on the geographic location of your visitors More easily comply with regional regulations by restricting access to specific countries How To Get This Add-On Websites with the VIP Add-Ons Club automatically have this add-on available: Join The VIP Add-Ons Club Purchase Individually: Block Website Traffic By Country Add-On Using the Add-On Go to: General Settings > Localization > Block Traffic by Country This will allow website owners to block unwanted traffic from entire countries. There are 3 options: Disable Setting Only Allow Traffic From Block Traffic From Disable Setting This will deactivate the setting from allowing or blocking specific countries. Sign ups from all countries are allowed. Only Allow Traffic From This will set the countries that are allowed to sign up on the website. If the country is not in the list, users in those countries will not be allowed to sign up on the website. Block Traffic From This will decide the countries that are not allowed to sign up on the website. If the country is not on the list, users in those countries can sign up on the website.. Adding Countries Click on the white space and a Country List will appear: Scroll or type in the country: Select the country to add it to the list: Removing Countries Use the " X " to remove a country from the list: Blocked Countries When a country is blocked from the website, there is a 403 Forbidden warning: API Requests Are Not Blocked Requests to the website's API (addresses that begin with /api/v2/ ) are not blocked by this add-on. Integrations such as BD Butler, Zapier and n8n keep working even when their requests come from a country that is blocked, or from a country that is not on the "Only Allow Traffic From" list. API requests still need a valid API key. All other pages are still blocked or allowed by the country rules. Websites that already use this add-on. The API exemption is added to the website's .htaccess file when the country rules are regenerated. That happens when the Block Traffic by Country settings are changed and saved, not when the tab is saved without a change, and not when the website cache is refreshed. To add the exemption to an existing website, go to Settings >> General Settings >> Localization , add a country to the list (or remove one), click Save Changes , then put the list back the way it was and click Save Changes again. Websites that set up the add-on after this change receive the exemption automatically. Important Notes Even if your website only serves a single country or market, sometimes your members and visitors are accessing your website while traveling or from other locations. Be cautious when deciding to block countries. If you're working with staff or team members abroad, make sure you're not blocking their access to your website. Sometimes search engines like Google, Bing and other tools need to crawl your website from IP addresses and countries that you may have blocked. So use the tool as needed and with intent. Remember, you can always block and unblock countries temporarily based on your needs. The most practical use of this add-on is to block traffic from countries that are delivering spam to your website. When the spam stops, you may choose to unblock and allow the country again. results.title: What is a Backlink? | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: What is a Backlink? Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000098405 A backlink is like a virtual high-five from one website to another. It's a link that points from another website back to yours. Think of it as a vote of confidence in the online world. When a website links to your site, it's telling search engines, "Hey, this content is valuable and worth checking out!" This is crucial because search engines like Google use these links to determine how important and relevant your website is. The more high-quality backlinks you have, the higher your site can rank in search results, which means more people can find and visit your site. But not all backlinks are created equal. It's all about quality over quantity. A backlink from a well-respected, authoritative site is like gold dust, while a link from a low-quality site might not do you much good. So, how do you get these awesome backlinks? Here are a few strategies: Create Stellar Content : If your content is amazing, informative, and helpful, other websites will naturally want to link to it. Guest Blogging : Write articles for other websites in your industry, and include a link back to your site. Broken Link Building : Find broken links on other websites, and suggest your content as a replacement. Reach Out : Don't be shy! Contact other website owners and ask if they'd be interested in linking to your content. Our platform is designed to help you create a website that's not just beautiful but also SEO-friendly, making it easier for you to attract those precious backlinks. Backlinks are a key player in the SEO game. They help search engines understand that your site is a valuable resource, which can boost your rankings and bring more visitors to your site. results.title: Settings » Domain Manager » Usage and Storage Cleanup | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: Settings » Domain Manager » Usage and Storage Cleanup Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000098735 The Usage tab in Settings > Domain Manager shows how much of the website's plan is in use and provides a storage breakdown and cleanup tools. Before starting The administrator must have permission to view website resources. Download any export or backup files that must be retained before running cleanup. Review plan usage Open Settings > Domain Manager > Usage . Review How much of your plan you are using . Click Refresh to update the displayed figures. The card includes members, the current month's bandwidth, and storage. A sent-email allowance appears where applicable; it can be daily or monthly depending on the site's email arrangement. Private-server administrators may also see Server usage . Use Increase Limit beside an allowance to review options for more capacity. The Usage tab compares current consumption with the website’s plan limits. Measure storage Find What is using your storage . Click Measure . Review the returned breakdown before choosing a cleanup action. Storage measurement helps distinguish files, mail, and database use. A mailbox consuming space needs a different response from old export files. Measure storage before choosing a cleanup action. The displayed figures are an example from an internal test website. The folder breakdown depends on the server; where it is unavailable, the panel says Folder detail is not available on this server and still reports the database and email totals. Use the cleanup tools Action What it removes Delete unused images Image files no longer referenced by members, posts, or listings. Delete old export files Saved CSV and spreadsheet export files. Download any files still needed first. Delete backup files Backup archives stored in the website account. Server-level backups are separate. Cleanup permanently removes files. The Domain Manager cannot undo these deletions. Read the selected action’s scope and retain any necessary files before confirming. Select the cleanup action that matches the measured storage use. Review its confirmation message. Confirm only the intended deletion. Wait for the action to finish. Review the refreshed storage measurement. These cleanup controls are intended for the named file categories, rather than deleting member records, web pages, or database content. For high bandwidth use, see How to Optimize the Bandwidth Usage of a Site . For mailbox storage, use Mailboxes . results.content: Design Settings » Homepage » Select Content to Display » Streaming Members Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000098834 Streaming Members This article goes over the available settings to edit the Streaming Members section on the homepage of the website. This section is meant to be displayed on the homepage exclusively. This homepage widget will display the Newest Members that sign up to the website. Visual Guide of the Streaming Members Settings 1. Streaming Members Title This setting controls the title for this homepage section. It can be edited to match the website's needs. 2. Title Color This setting controls the title color for the title of this homepage section. It can be edited to match the website's needs. Click on the color bar to display the color pallet and select the color accordingly. 3. Display Options This setting control the total amount of members that will be displayed on this homepage section. Click on the drop-down menu to select the number of total results from the list. The maximum is 24 results. 4. Results Per Row This setting control the amount of members that will be displayed on this homepage section per row. Click on the drop-down menu to select the number of total results from the list. The maximum is 24 results. 5. Enable Carousel Slider? This setting control the layout of the Streaming Members section, if enabled the Streaming section will display as a carousel, with arrows at each side, instead of displaying the Streaming Members in a grid layout, they will appear in the carousel. If set to No, the Streaming Members will be displayed in the default grid view. 6. Hide On Mobile? This setting controls whether or not the Streaming Members section will display on mobile devices. If enabled this section will not appear on mobile devices. If the setting is set to No, the Streaming Members section will appear on mobile devices accessing the website. 7. Only Show Members with Photo This setting controls whether or not the Streaming Members section will display members that have already uploaded either a Member Image or Member Logo, but the system will only display the Member Image, not the Member Logo. The options are: "Show All, Even if Member Does Not Have Photo" or "Member Must Have Photo" 8. Show "View All" Button This setting controls whether or not the View All button on Streaming Members section will display in this section. If set to Yes, the button will show up at the top right corner of the section, if set to No, the button will not be displayed. To learn more about how to edit the color of this button, navigate to the following link: Design Settings » Button Colors 9. Sort Order This setting controls the order in which the Streaming Members will be displayed on the homepage of the website. The options are: Newest: this will set the newest members first. Oldest: this will set the oldest members first. Random: this will set a random order based on the browser session. 10. Only Display 'Verified' Members? This setting will show only members that have verified their account with this process: How to Verify a Listing . 11. Display Verified Badge? This setting controls will display the verified badge. 12. Limit Members Shown to These Membership Plans This setting controls the membership plan that will be used to display members from. If left blank all members from all membership plans will be displayed on this section. 13. Display Additional Information This setting controls the information displayed per member in the Streaming Members section on the homepage of the website. The options to choose from are: Display About Snippet Display Top Level Category Display Sub Level Category Display Short Description Do Not Display Additional Information Display About Snippet Using this option will display the About Snippet field from the Contact Details form. Display Top Level Category Using this option will display the Top Level Category from the Contact Details form. Display Sub Level Category Using this option will display the Sub Level Category from the Additional Details form. Display Short Description Using this option will display the Short Description from the Contact Details form. Do Not Display Additional Information Using this option will hide this section. 14. Display Location This setting controls whether or not the address or location for the members is displayed on this section of the homepage. If set to Yes the location or address will be displayed, if set to No, the address or location will be hidden for the members on the Streaming Members section of the homepage. 15. Display Star Ratings This setting enables or disables the display of star ratings for streaming members. Administrators can choose to show or hide star ratings. 16. Only Display Members Who Have Star Ratings This setting specifies whether only members with star ratings should be displayed. It includes options to require a minimum star rating from 1 to 5 stars. 17. Display View Profile Button This setting controls whether or not the button that links website visitors to the members profile will be displayed. If set to Yes the button will appear in the Streaming Members widget of the homepage. If set to No, the button will not be displayed. results.content: Import Members: "active" Variable Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000099142 In an import file for Brilliant Directories, the variable " active " decides the Active status of members. This controls whether the profile will not be visible on the front-end of the website and the search results. Here's a quick breakdown of the " active " status values: 1 = Inactive (as in they signed up for a free account but have not verified their email address) 2 = Active 3 = Cancelled / Account Closed 4 = On Hold (usually the status an Admin would assign to temporarily suspend an account) 5 = Past Due Remember, you can always change a member's active status later from the admin dashboard. results.title: Post Types API - How to Edit Post Types Data with API Calls | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: Post Types API - How to Edit Post Types Data with API Calls Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000099435 Using the API there are 5 Post Type actions that can be achieved: GET - /api/v2/data_categories/get/{data_id} POST - /api/v2/data_categories/create POST - /api/v2/data_categories/custom_fields PUT - /api/v2/data_categories/update DELETE - /api/v2/data_categories/delete We will break down these actions and explain how to achieve an end results with each one. The examples shown in this article are completed using https://www.postman.com/ For all actions, add the API Key to the Headers: 1. GET - /api/v2/data_categories/get/{data_id} Read the data of a single Post Type based on the Data ID. Choose GET as the method Replace the {{api_url}} for the website url Replace the {id} with the actual post type ID Using this action is simple, add the url above but replace {id} with the actual post type ID. This will fetch the post types information from the website. 2. POST - /api/v2/data_categories/create Add a Post Type to the database. Choose POST as the method In the Body select x-www-form-urlencoded Enter data 3. POST - /api/v2/data_categories/custom_fields Get all fields available for the Post Type. Choose POST as the method. In the Body select x-www-form-urlencoded Then add the data_id of the Post Type 4. PUT - /api/v2/data_categories/update Update a Post Type record and their related data from the database. Choose PUT as the method In the Body select x-www-form-urlencoded Then add the new data for the Post Type 5. DELETE - /api/v2/data_categories/delete Use this action URL to delete a Post Type, replace {id} with the Post Type ID that will be removed from the website. Choose DELETE as the method Replace the {id} with the data_id that will be deleted In the Params add the data_id to delete For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . results.title: How to Prevent and Minimize Unwanted Spam Emails | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: How to Prevent and Minimize Unwanted Spam Emails Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000099550 Unfortunately, websites that have Contact Us forms are susceptible to unwanted spam form submissions, this is quite common on the internet. Here are a few recommendations to address this: Block SPAM Keywords Read more : Spam Form Protector Add-On Go to Settings Click on General Settings Use the Integrations tab to access the SPAM Keyword Blocker Use these fields to add keywords, characters and email addresses that will be blocked from being submitted in forms on the site. Block Individual IPs Read more : Block An IP Address From The Website Go to Emails Click on Forms Inbox The IP will be displayed in the Inquiry Details Block the IP of individual spammers if there is an influx of spam submissions from one IP Address. Block Traffic by Country Read more : Block Traffic By Country Go To Settings Click on General Settings Use the Localization tab to access the Block Traffic by Country setting Easily prevent visitors from specific countries from accessing the front-end of the website, this add-on identifies a visitor's country based on their IP address. This prevents the submission of the forms on the site from users in the blocked countries. Members-Only Pages Read more: Members-Only Content This add-on provides full control over who can access the website’s content by requiring designated “members” to log in before being able to view certain pages. In this case the pages with the forms can be protected. For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . results.title: Design Settings » Homepage » Select Content to Display » Streaming Featured Members | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: Design Settings » Homepage » Select Content to Display » Streaming Featured Members Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000099554 Streaming Featured Members This article goes over the available settings to edit the Streaming Featured Members section on the homepage of the website. This section is meant to be displayed on the homepage exclusively. This homepage widget will display the members selected to display as Featured Members of the website, to learn more about the process of setting up Featured Members, navigate to the following link: Featured Members on Homepage Visual Guide of the Streaming Featured Members Settings This is a representation of the available settings for the Streaming Featured Members. 1. Featured Members Title This setting controls the title for this homepage section. It can be edited to match the website's needs. 2. Title Color This setting controls the title color for the title of this homepage section. It can be edited to match the website's needs. Click on the color bar to display the color pallet and select the color accordingly. 3. Display Options This setting control the total amount of members that will be displayed on this homepage section. Click on the drop-down menu to select the number of total results from the list. The maximum is 24 results. 4. Results Per Row This setting control the amount of members that will be displayed on this homepage section per row. Click on the drop-down menu to select the number of total results from the list. The maximum is 24 results. 5. Enable Carousel Slider? This setting control the layout of the Streaming Members section, if enabled the Streaming section will display as a carousel, with arrows at each side, instead of displaying the Streaming Members in a grid layout, they will appear in the carousel. If set to No, the Streaming Members will be displayed in the default grid view. 6. Hide On Mobile? This setting controls whether or not the Streaming Members section will display on mobile devices. If enabled this section will not appear on mobile devices. If the setting is set to No, the Streaming Members section will appear on mobile devices accessing the website. 7. Only Show Members with Photo This setting controls whether or not the Streaming Featured Members section will display members that have already uploaded either a Member Image or Member Logo, but the system will only display the Member Image, not the Member Logo. The options are: "Show All, Even if Member Does Not Have Photo" or "Member Must Have Photo" 8. Display Additional Information This setting controls the information displayed per member in the Streaming Members section on the homepage of the website. The options to choose from are: Display About Snippet Display Top Level Category Display Sub Level Category Display Short Description Do Not Display Additional Information Display About Snippet Using this option will display the About Snippet field from the Contact Details form. Display Top Level Category Using this option will display the Top Level Category from the Contact Details form. Display Sub Level Category Using this option will display the Sub Level Category from the Additional Details form. Display Sub Sub Level Category Using this option will display the Sub Sub Level Category from the Additional Details form. Display Short Description Using this option will display the Short Description from the Contact Details form. Do Not Display Additional Information Using this option will hide this section. 9. Display Location This setting controls whether or not the address or location for the members is displayed on this section of the homepage. If set to Yes the location or address will be displayed, if set to No, the address or location will be hidden for the members on the Streaming Members section of the homepage. 10. Display Star Ratings This setting enables or disables the display of star ratings for featured members. Administrators can choose to show or hide star ratings. 11. Only Display Members Who Have Star Ratings This setting specifies whether only members with star ratings should be displayed. It includes options to require a minimum star rating from 1 to 5 stars. 12. Display View Profile Button This setting controls whether or not the button that links website visitors to the member's profile will be displayed. If set to Yes, the button will appear in the Streaming Members widget of the homepage. If set to No, the button will not be displayed. 13. Display Order This setting controls the order in which the Featured Members will appear organized on the front end of the website. The options are Ascending lowest to highest, Descending highest to lowest and Random. 14. Only Display 'Verified' Members? This setting specifies whether only members that are " Verified " should be displayed. 15. Display Verified Badge? This setting specifies whether the Verify Badge should be displayed or not. results.title: Email Limit Boost | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: Email Limit Boost Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000099952 Is your membership community growing faster than expected? All Website Plans are allocated 1,500 daily email sends (45,000 free emails each month – for life). The Email Limit Boost removes the 1,500 daily limit and increases your total monthly send limit. Perfect for Websites That: Frequently reach the free 1,500 daily limit Send newsletters to all members and email subscribers Have high activity levels resulting in a large volume of notification emails Need to accommodate business growth and reach larger audiences Get This Boost Visit our website: Email Limit Boost On the website use the slider to ADD to the email limit: Use the " Add (5,000,10,000,15,000,...) Emails ($x/Mo) " button to increase the limit: Current Daily Email Usage The daily email usage is displayed in the dashboard when scheduling a new email or newsletter. How Billing Works for Email Limit Boosts When you purchase an email limit boost, the sending limit for that site increases immediately for the current calendar month. Example: An email limit boost purchased on June 1st or June 29th will both apply through June 30th. On July 1st, the limits will renew and reset based on the total number of email limit boosts purchased and billed for that month. The subscription for the email limit boost will be billed in advance on the 1st of each month, covering that month’s email sending limits. Example: A boost purchased on June 29th will be billed again on July 1st, in advance, when the email limits renew and reset for the new month. Unused email sends do not carry over to the next month. Each month, the sending limit resets to match the total number of active email limit boosts for that calendar month. The subscription will continue to auto-renew as a single, consolidated charge per site on the 1st of each month, covering all active email limit boosts. If you purchase multiple email limit boosts for the same site in a single month: Each one increases the sending limit right away. All boosts are consolidated into one subscription billed on the 1st of the following month. If the consolidated subscription goes past due or cannot be billed on the 1st of the month: All email limit boosts will be removed from the site.You can repurchase email limit boosts at any time to restore your desired sending limits for the month. For a customized quote for higher limits, please CONTACT OUR TEAM . For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . results.content: How To Add Member Profile URLs in Email Templates Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000099989 To add a member's URL to an email in Brilliant Directories, follow these steps: Navigate to Emails » Email Templates . results.content: Design Settings » Homepage » Select Content to Display » Streaming Blog Articles Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000100094 Streaming Blog Articles This article goes over the available settings to edit the Streaming Blog Articles section on the homepage of the website. This section is meant to be displayed on the homepage exclusively. This homepage widget will display the Recent Blog Articles To edit these settings, navigate to: In the Admin Sidebar Open Settings Select Designs Settings Open The Homepage Tab Open The Module Select Content to Display Select The Streaming Blog Articles Option Visual Guide of the Streaming Blog Articles This is a representation of the available settings for the Streaming Blog Articles 1. Recent Blog Articles Title This setting allows the administrator to set the title for the recent blog articles section. The title can be customized by entering the desired text in the provided input field. 2. Title Color The title color setting enables the customization of the title's color. Administrators can choose a color by inputting the desired color code or using the color picker tool provided. 3. Display Options This setting controls the number of recent blog articles displayed. Administrators can select from a range of options, from 1 to 24 results. Additionally, the layout can be adjusted to show a specific number of results per row, ranging from 2 to 4 results per row. 4. Results Per Row This setting controls the number of recent blog articles displayed per row. Administrators can select from a range of 2 to 4. 5. Enable Carousel Slider The carousel slider option allows recent blog articles to be displayed in a sliding carousel format. This can be toggled on or off using the provided dropdown menu. 6. Hide On Mobile This setting allows administrators to choose whether the recent blog articles section should be hidden on mobile devices. It can be enabled or disabled using the dropdown menu. 7. Linked Post Type This setting allows the administrator to select the type of content linked to the recent blog articles. Options include events, job listings, coupons, videos, audio posts, website blog articles, community articles, and discussions. 8. Only Show Posts with Photos Administrators can choose to display only those posts that have photos. This setting ensures that posts without photos are excluded from the recent blog articles list. 9. Image Quality This setting controls the quality of the images displayed in the recent blog articles. Administrators can choose between thumbnail size and large size. 10. Show "View All" Button The "View All" button allows users to see all recent blog articles. This setting can be toggled on or off using the dropdown menu. 11. Hide If No Posts Exist This setting allows administrators to choose whether the recent blog articles section should be hidden if no posts exist. It can be enabled or disabled using the dropdown menu. 12. Only Include Posts from Active Members This setting specifies whether only posts from active members should be included. Administrators can choose to include posts from active members only or from all members. 13. Include Posts from Non-Searchable Members This setting allows administrators to choose whether to include posts from non-searchable members. It can be enabled or disabled using the dropdown menu. 14. Include Posts from Members in These Plans This setting allows administrators to limit the displayed posts to specific membership plans. Administrators can select the desired membership plans from the provided list. 15. Display Order The display order setting determines the order in which recent blog articles are shown. Options include Newest First, Oldest First, or Random order. This can be customized by selecting the desired option from the dropdown menu. 16. Limit One Post per Member? This setting specifies whether only one post per member should be displayed. Administrators can choose to display one post per member or allow multiple posts from the same member. results.content: Clone My Website Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000100525 Want to make an exact copy of your Brilliant Directories website? Purchasing the Clone My Website service will direct our team to promptly clone your existing website and duplicate it to another website that you currently own with Brilliant Directories. This saves you the time of starting a new website from scratch and allows you to copy over all your customized work and data to a new website with ease – perfect for launching similar websites in varying industries or regions. Get This Service Visit our website: Clone My Website Key Features to Boost Sales & Conversions Quickly create similar websites Maintain consistency through all of your websites Every aspect of your existing website will be cloned All custom coding will be cloned NOTICE : Typical turnaround time to have your website cloned is one business day or less. You must already own an additional Brilliant Directories website that you would like your existing website copied to. Who Is This For? The Clone My Website service is a time-saving resource that can be used with any Brilliant Directories website. We especially recommend this service if you create many similar websites with the Brilliant Directories platform. This is the service for you if you answer “ Yes ” to at least one of the following questions Question 1 Are you a web developer who’s customers often want their websites to look or function like your previously developed websites? With the Clone My Website service, the Brilliant Directories team will quickly clone one of your existing websites to another one of your websites. All of the content, from images to custom code, will be cloned. Question 2 Are you launching multiple websites that serve the same purpose, but marketed to different industries or locations? You can establish your desired design and functionality of your flagship site and then have it cloned to your other websites. All you will need to do is update the industry or location data on these other websites to fit their intended market. Additional Licenses This service requires you to have an additional, unused website plan with Brilliant Directories. One of your websites can then be cloned to your additional, unused website plan. For Brilliant Directories website plans and pricing please click HERE . For additional information please call +1 (800) 771-9332. Add-Ons Information Premium add-ons will not be cloned to your new website unless they have been purchased for your new website as well. Example : If you wish to have your Easy Coupon Codes cloned from your old site to your new site, you must repurchase the Easy Coupon Codes add-on for the new website. This applies to all add-ons as well as the VIP Add-Ons Club. For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . results.content: Allow the facebookexternalhit Bot in the Robots.txt File Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000100532 Facebook uses the facebookexternalhit crawler to retrieve website content when links are shared. To allow this crawler, add the following directives to the Robots.txt file. User-agent: facebookexternalhit Disallow: /api/ Allow: / Navigate to Developer Hub . Select Robots File . Add the following directives above the default rules at the end of the Robots.txt file. Bandwidth IMPORTANT : Allowing the facebookexternalhit crawler can significantly increase a website's bandwidth usage. Internal testing has shown that the facebookexternalhit crawler may consume substantially more bandwidth than other common crawlers, such as Googlebot and Bingbot. This increase in traffic may result in higher bandwidth usage and, in some cases, reduced website performance. For this reason, the facebookexternalhit crawler is not allowed by default. It should only be enabled when Facebook link previews are required. The following example illustrates the difference in bandwidth usage between the facebookexternalhit crawler and other common crawlers over the same time period: For these reasons, we do not allow this bot by default, and only recommend allowing it when absolutely necessary. We released the Business Data Import tool which allows Admins to search for businesses and import them as members to their website. We released the new Setup Wizard to help guide new websites through the initial setup process. This can be found on the Admin Dashboard page in the Admin area. Enhancements / Fixes: We fixed an issue which was preventing changes made on the Webhooks page in the Admin from saving properly in some cases. The auto_match and auto_geocode variables now support Boolean values (true or false) when creating and updating members and posts using the Brilliant Directories API. We updated the Event Description text for the Paid Plan Signup Webhooks on the Webhooks page in the Admin. We fixed a display issue with the "No Settings Found With Your Keyword Search" text that occurred after performing a keyword search with no results on the General Settings page in the Admin. We fixed an issue which was preventing the system from correctly centering Google Maps on a member's location when viewing a member profile page when the "Enable Search Results Cache" Post Type setting was active in some cases. We optimized the "Find Duplicates" filter on the Search Members page in the Admin so it executes much faster. We made several small bug fixes and improvements to the new Send Newsletter functionality in the Admin. We fixed an issue which was preventing a member's remaining credits and proration calculation from displaying correctly when when a member upgraded their Membership Plan from the Member Dashboard in some cases. We updated the display of member profile pages to hide the "Company Details" H2 title when there is no data to display in this section on the frontend of sites. We fixed a display issue on the Search Members page in the Admin area when the "Require Complete Profile" and the "Enable Sales Rep Field in Edit Members Form" Advanced Settings were both enabled in some cases. We fixed an issue which was causing the system to return members that were not geocoded on member search results pages after performing a location search in some cases. We fixed an issue which was preventing the system from including the country name as part of the member profile URL when the "Member Profile URL Structure" Advanced Setting had not been saved in some cases. We fixed an issue that was preventing the Details pages of Multi-Photo Post Types to display at full width when there was no sidebar selected. We implemented a security update to member search result pages on the frontend of sites. We fixed an issue that was causing the system to display duplicate posts after using the "Click to Load More Results" button when the "Order Results by" Post Type Setting was set to "Random Order" in some cases. We made several small bug fixes and improvements to the new Import Business Data tool in the Admin. Webhook activity is now being logged in the Activity Tracker. We fixed an issue that was causing member CSV imports to get stuck when the Billing Module was not correctly installed on a site in some cases. We made several small bug fixes and improvements to the In-App Purchase process for the Import Business Data tool in the Admin. The Stock Photo Library Add-On is now compatible with Text Labels. We fixed an issue that was preventing member search results pages from returning accurate results when performing location searches in some cases. We fixed an issue that was preventing the "Paid Plan Signup" Webhooks from triggering as expected on the frontend of sites in some cases. We updated the default robots.txt file to remove the facebookexternalhit directive. Facebook has been aggressively crawling sites that have this bot allowed in the robots.txt file, causing the bandwidth of sites to be consumed much faster than expected and affecting the performance of the servers the sites are hosted on. We fixed an issue which was preventing the new Send Newsletter module from working properly when sites are connected with specific TLDs like ".com.au" in some cases. We fixed an issue that was causing the system to create an additional invoice when a member purchased a Digital Product with a recurring subscription without having a credit card on file prior to the purchase. We fixed an issue which was affecting the ability to upload PDF files through the Media Manager in the Admin area in some cases. results.title: Enhancing Security with Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: Enhancing Security with Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000100753 In the coming weeks, 2FA will be gradually implemented for admin account logins. If the feature is not visible yet, admins are encouraged to wait a bit longer. A prompt will soon be provided to enable this feature for admin accounts. Any further questions can be directed to the support team, who are available to assist. The Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) feature is an advanced security measure that adds an extra layer of protection, ensuring that only the authorized user can access their account, even if their password is compromised. What is Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)? Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) is a security process that requires two distinct forms of identification before granting access to an account. Unlike traditional single-factor authentication, which relies solely on a password, 2FA incorporates an additional verification step to enhance security. Note : 2FA is optional—the admin of the website has the choice to either use it or skip it according to personal preference. Setting Up 2FA Getting started with 2FA is straightforward. Users should follow these steps: Log In: Begin by entering the username and password. Provide Additional Verification: After the initial login, users will be prompted to provide a second form of verification. This will involve receiving a code via email, which is required to log in to the admin section of the website. If users wish for the browser to remember their password for the next 7 days, they can select the checkbox to remember the device. If the user logs in from a different device, the system will prompt for the code sent via email once more. The One Time Passcode will be sent to the Username email. results.title: Customizing Froala Editors: Adding RTL and LTR Options for Text Direction | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: Customizing Froala Editors: Adding RTL and LTR Options for Text Direction Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000100799 In this tutorial, we explore how to customize Froala editors, focusing on adding RTL and LTR options for text direction. For more details, refer to the Froala development page . In many languages, the text flows either from left to right (LTR) or right to left (RTL), and adjusting the text direction in Froala text editors can be essential for accurately displaying content in these languages. To customize text direction, follow the steps outlined below: 1. Create a Widget Using the Provided Code To begin, copy the code provided below: <script> // Function to change the text direction and alignment var changeDirection = function (dir, align) { // Save the current selection to maintain it after modifications this.selection.save(); // Wrap the selected block tags this.html.wrap(true, true, true, true); // Restore the selection to work with the selected elements this.selection.restore(); // Get the selected blocks var elements = this.selection.blocks(); // Save the selection again to restore it after changes this.selection.save(); // Iterate over the selected elements and apply changes for (var i = 0; i < elements.length; i++) { var element = elements[i]; if (element != this.el) { // Change the text direction and alignment of the element this.$(element) .css('direction', dir) .css('text-align', align) .removeClass('fr-temp-div'); // Remove the temporary class used for wrapping } } // Unwrap the temporary divs used during the wrapping process this.html.unwrap(); // Restore the original selection this.selection.restore(); } // Function to add custom buttons to the Froala editor function addCustomButton(editor, FroalaEditor) { // Define the icon for the right-to-left (RTL) button FroalaEditor.DefineIcon('rightToLeft', { NAME: 'arrow-left', template: 'font_awesome' }); FroalaEditor.RegisterCommand('rightToLeft', { title: 'RTL', focus: true, undo: true, refreshAfterCallback: true, callback: function () { changeDirection.apply(this, ['rtl', 'right']); // Apply RTL direction and right alignment } }); // Define the icon for the left-to-right (LTR) button FroalaEditor.DefineIcon('leftToRight', { NAME: 'arrow-right', template: 'font_awesome' }); FroalaEditor.RegisterCommand('leftToRight', { title: 'LTR', focus: true, undo: true, refreshAfterCallback: true, callback: function () { changeDirection.apply(this, ['ltr', 'left']); // Apply LTR direction and left alignment } }); // Add the custom buttons to the editor's toolbar let toolbarButtons = editor.opts.toolbarButtons; if(Array.isArray(toolbarButtons)){ toolbarButtons.push('rightToLeft'); toolbarButtons.push('leftToRight'); }else{ // scenario Froala Text Editor - Media Manager Access toolbarButtons.moreText.buttons.push('rightToLeft'); toolbarButtons.moreText.buttons.push('leftToRight'); toolbarButtons.moreText.buttonsVisible=12; } let settings = editor.opts; // Update the editor's toolbar options editor.opts.toolbarButtons = toolbarButtons; editor.destroy(); // Destroy the current editor instance new FroalaEditor("#yourcustomid", settings); // Create a new editor instance with updated buttons } // Function to execute when the page is fully loaded window.onload = function() { // Ensure the editor instance is fully initialized before adding the custom button addCustomButton(window["yourcustomid"], FroalaEditor); }; //// EXTRA NOTE //// /// change "yourcustomid" to the id or class of the froala you need to change </script> Then, navigate to Toolbox >> Widget Manager to create a widget using this code. After creating the widget, copy its shortcode for future use: 2. Customizing the Form Next, customize the preferred form under Toolbox >> Form Manager. For this example, we will customize the "Feature - Member Articles" form to incorporate the text direction functionality. Next, add a new form field with the type set to "Custom HTML," and then paste the previously copied widget shortcode into this field. Important Note: The Database Variable assigned to this field is not important. Next, click on the gear icon for the Froala Text Editor field and assign a unique "Outer Element ID." Be sure to copy this ID for future use. 3. Customizing the Widget to Refer to the Outer Element ID To ensure the widget interacts correctly with the form field, open the newly created widget under Widget Manager: On lines 83 and 89, replace " yourcustomid " with the Outer Element ID assigned to the Froala Text Editor field. Before: After: This is how the end result would look like: For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . results.title: SEO Variables List | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: SEO Variables List Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000101103 Overview The following variables are available for use within SEO templates and the Web Page Builder. NOTE: All variables below must be wrapped in percent signs (e.g., %first_name% ) to be recognized by the system. Member Variables Label Variable Description User ID %user_id% Ascending numeric value linked to a member. First Name %first_name% First name of the member. Last Name %last_name% Last name of the member. Full Name %full_name% First name and last name of the member. Email %email% Email associated with the member's listing. Company %company% Company name of the member; used by the system when the listing is set to Company. Phone Number %phone_number% Primary phone number associated with the member listing. City %city% City associated with the member listing. State Code %state_code% Two-letter state code associated with the member listing's address. State Ln %state_ln% Long full name of the state. Country Code %country_code% Two-letter country code associated with the member listing's address. Country Ln %country_ln% Long full name of the country. Subscription ID %subscription_id% Membership plan ID# associated with the member listing. Member Profile URL %filename% Link to the member listing. Active %active% Member listing's status. Signup Date %signup_date% Date the member listing was created. Signup Date Formatted %signup_date_format% Formatted version of the signup date. Last Login %last_login% Last login date to the member listing. Location %Location% %Location% is dynamically generated from the member’s City and State fields. For members outside the United States, the Country is also appended. Position %position% Position represented by the owner of the member listing. Profession ID %profession_id% ID number of the top-level category selected by the member. Top Category %Profession_name% Name of the top-level category selected by the member. Sub Category %service_name% Name of the sub-level category selected by the member. Verified %verified% Whether the listing has been manually verified. Nationwide %nationwide% Whether the member listing provides services nationwide. Listing Type %listing_type% Listing type selected by the member. Member Website URL %%%website%%% Displays the website link entered in the contact details form. Website Variables Label Variable Description Website Name %website_name% Name added to the Website Name field in General Settings. Website Domain %website_url% Domain name added through the domain manager. Website Email %website_email% Email address added to the Email Address field in General Settings. Website Phone %website_phone% Phone number added to the Phone Number field in General Settings. Country %country% Primary location added in General Settings. Profession %profession% Profession added to the Profession field in General Settings. Industry %industry% Industry added to the Industry field in General Settings. Currency %currency_code% Currency added in General Settings. Distance %distance% Format used for distances. Post Type Variables Label Variable Description Group Name %%%Group_name%%% Multi-image post type name (Photo Albums, Products, Digital Products, Properties, Classifieds). Data Name %Data_name% Single post type name (Videos, Articles, Jobs, Events, Coupons, Audios, Discussions). Post Category %post_category% The category assigned to each post in My Content . results.title: How to Update Member Data Using API: Google Sheets Example | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: How to Update Member Data Using API: Google Sheets Example Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000101220 This article shows an example of how a Google Spreadsheet can be used to update member data on a site using the site's API. Checklist Before Moving Forward With This Example Make sure to generate a unique API Key using the documentation down below as a guideline. Please make sure to save the API Key in a safe place as it is not accessible after it has been created: How To Generate an API Key Prepare a Google Spreadsheet with at least two essential column, one for the member's ID# (the user_id variable) to reference an existing member on the site, and the second for the variable to be updated. For example: if a member is currently in a membership plan with ID#1 and needs to be updated to plan ID#2, specify these details in the spreadsheet. Note : The user_id variable is the only mandatory field for this process, and multiple data points can be updated simultaneously. When setting up the file we recommend using our CSV import template file as a basis for the API sheet. The file has all of the correct database variables: How To Import Members via CSV However, the column names do not necessarily match with the correct database variable names as this can be mapped later on. How To Connect Google Sheets Using Zapier In this example, we will be using Zapier to integrate Google Sheets into the Brilliant Directories site. Log in to the Zapier account and click on Create Zap : Name the new zap created and select the Google Sheets option as a Trigger: Select the Event type as New Spreadsheet Row and click on Continue : Connect the Google Sheet Account (this would be a Gmail account) and click on Continue : Choose the preferred Spreadsheet, specify the Worksheet and click on Continue : Click on Test Trigger : There will be a confirmation that a spreadsheet row has been found, click Continue : Now the Trigger has been set up correctly, the Action can be created. Search and select the " Brilliant Directories " as the App option: Choose the Update User event and click Continue : If this is the first time creating a Brilliant Directories connection, click on the Sign In option: If there is already a connection created to Brilliant Directories, click on Connect a new account option: Clicking both options above will open a new window where the domain of the site (https:// or http:// included) and the API Key generated can be specified: After clicking Yes, Continue on the window above, click on Continue : Next, we will be setting up the action. In this section, all the available member variables can be found. As we already created a spreadsheet with a row of member information, the next action would be mapping/matching the column names to the correct variable names. First, map the User ID variable by clicking on Custom and selecting the related column in the spreadsheet: Then, map the Membership Plan ID# by selecting the subscription_id column for the "ACCOUNT: Membership Plan ID" field: Now that all the preferred variables are matched and mapped correctly, click on Continue to test the action: Confirm that the information displayed is correct and click on Test Step : This will update the targeted member data on the fly: BEFORE AFTER Click on Publish : Note : Going forward, any new rows added to the connected Google Sheet via the API will automatically update the corresponding member data. For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . Was this article helpful and accurate? results.title: Google Analytics 4: Tracking Membership Plan Sign-Ups Using Key Events (Conversions) | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: Google Analytics 4: Tracking Membership Plan Sign-Ups Using Key Events (Conversions) Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000101323 Understanding user interactions, such as sign-ups for different membership plans, is crucial for assessing website performance and optimizing user engagement. Integrating BD websites with Google Analytics 4 (GA4) enables effective tracking of membership plan sign-ups. Here’s a detailed guide on how to set up this tracking. Part 1: Set Up Tracking on The Brilliant Directories Website 1. Create a New Custom Widget Begin by accessing the BD website dashboard and creating a new custom widget . 2. Name the Widget Assign a simple nickname to the widget, such as "Track Sign Ups - Membership Plan Name," to facilitate identification. 3. Insert the Tracking Code Paste the following code into the widget’s code area on the HTML tab: <script> gtag("event", "bronze_plan_sign_up", { method: "sign_up" }); </script> This code configures a custom event in GA4 to be triggered whenever a sign-up for the specified membership plan occurs. IMPORTANT: Replace bronze_plan_sign_up with the name of the membership plan you're tracking. NO SPACES NO SYMBOLS USE UNDERSCORES _ If there are any spaces or symbols, the tracking will not work Example change: premium_plan_sign_up 4. Save Changes Ensure that the widget is saved to apply the changes. 5. Edit the Membership Plan Go to Finance > Membership Plans, edit the plan that will have the tracking code, find the "Successful Sign Up / Upgrade Conversion Tracking Code Widget" setting in the first tab of the page, and select the widget created for the tracking code. Part 2: Set Up Key Event to Track in Google Analytics 4 (GA4) 1. Copy the Event Name Use the exact event name from the inserted code, for example, bronze_plan_sign_up . 2. Access GA4 Admin Settings Navigate to Google Analytics for the website and click on the ADMIN blue icon located at the bottom-left of the page. 3. Navigate to Key Events Find the DATA DISPLAY section in the sidebar, and click on KEY EVENTS . 4. Create a New Key Event Click on NEW KEY EVENT and enter the copied event name, such as bronze_plan_sign_up IMPORTANT: The KEY EVENT name MUST MATCH EXACTLY the event name defined in the tracking code in the widget. 5. Save the Key Event Click SAVE to finalize the event setup. Events can be viewed under Reports > User Engagement & Retention > Events. After adding a new event in GA4, it typically takes about 24 to 48 hours for the event to appear in the Events report. This delay is due to the time required for data processing and reporting updates within Google Analytics 4. To see the new event sooner, checking the Realtime report might provide immediate insights, though the full data and detailed reports will still be updated within the 24 to 48-hour time-frame. With the tracking for membership plan sign-ups configured, monitoring these events directly in Google Analytics 4 becomes possible. For different membership plans, the process can be repeated with unique event names for each plan. By following these instructions, valuable insights into user engagement with various membership plans can be obtained, enabling data-driven decisions to enhance website performance. results.title: Website Terms and Conditions | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: Website Terms and Conditions Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000101329 A website's Terms of Use (also known as Terms and Conditions or Terms of Service) is basically a set of rules that users agree to follow when they interact with a website. Think of it as the "house rules" that the website owner sets to protect both themselves and the users. These terms cover everything from how the content on the site can be used, to what users can and can't do while they're there, and even what happens if someone violates those rules. Here's a quick rundown of what might be included: User Conduct : Guidelines on what behavior is acceptable or prohibited (e.g., no spamming, no illegal activities). Intellectual Property : Details about who owns the content on the site (text, images, videos) and how it can be used. Privacy : Information on how user data is collected, stored, and used by the website. Disclaimers : Statements that limit the website's liability for errors, inaccuracies, or damages that might occur from using the site. Governing Law : The legal jurisdiction that governs the terms (e.g., laws of a specific state or country). Termination : The right of the website owner to suspend or terminate a user's access for violating the terms. These terms create a legal framework that helps ensure everyone knows what’s expected, keeping the experience smooth and safe for all involved. Terms of Use Page All Brilliant Directories websites come with a Terms of Use page: domain.com /about/terms Example: https://www.demobootstrap.com/about/terms Accepting Terms of Use Users will agree to the Terms and Conditions upon sign up, whether it is a FREE or PAID account. Notes The Terms are accepted upon sign up once. Currently there is no setting to renew/accept Terms & Conditions agreement on a daily, weekly, monthly or yearly basis. results.content: How to Optimize the Bandwidth Usage of a Site Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000101331 How to Optimize the Bandwidth Usage of a Site High bandwidth usage can affect website performance and can require additional capacity. The tools below help measure traffic and reduce unnecessary transfer. Viewing Bandwidth Usage Domain Manager Open Settings > Domain Manager > Usage for the current usage summary. The displayed limit includes the website license and any capacity purchased through the VIP Add-Ons Club or Bandwidth Boost Add-Ons . The Usage tab compares current consumption with the website’s plan limits. cPanel Open Developer Hub > cPanel Dashboard , then select Bandwidth under Metrics. cPanel includes historical totals and separates traffic such as HTTP, FTP, IMAP, POP3, and SMTP. AWStats AWStats identifies traffic sources and the bandwidth each source consumed. See Identifying Sources of Bandwidth Usage with AWStats . General Strategies Set Up Cloudflare Cloudflare can cache static files and filter unwanted traffic, reducing requests to the origin server. See Connecting a Site to Cloudflare . Optimize Images ImageKit can resize and optimize images for the requesting device. See Use a Content Delivery Network for Images . Remove Unneeded Screenshot Previews Disable screenshot previews in admin areas where they are not useful, including Dashboard, Web Page Builder, Edit Post Settings, Form Manager, and Domain Manager. Address Specific Traffic Sources Use AWStats before blocking traffic. For sites using Cloudflare, its WAF custom rules can restrict selected countries or request patterns. Other sites can use the Block Traffic by Country tool. Restore the default crawler rules or add deliberate custom rules through the robots.txt documentation . Blocking legitimate search crawlers can reduce indexing. For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . results.title: Identifying Sources of Bandwidth Usage with AWStats | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: Identifying Sources of Bandwidth Usage with AWStats Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000101333 AWStats, a powerful web analytics tool integrated into cPanel, offers a wealth of information about a website's traffic. Let's delve into how to leverage AWStats to pinpoint traffic sources and identify which ones are consuming the most bandwidth. Accessing AWStats In the Admin area of the website, navigate to the Developer Hub > cPanel Dashboard to log into your cPanel Navigate to the "Metrics" section and click on the "AWStats" icon Select the domain you want to analyze from the dropdown menu and click "View." At the top of the screen, there is an option to choose the "Reported Period". Choose "Monthly" and the month and year to view. The current month will be selected by default. Identifying Sources of Bandwidth Consumption Once in the AWStats interface, there is a lot of information about the traffic to the website. The following sections are the most important when trying to find the primary sources of bandwidth consumption. "Summary" Section This section gives a high level overview of how much traffic a site received from humans ("Viewed traffic") and bots ("Not Viewed Traffic"). Key Takeaways / Action Items One critical piece of information here is the "Bandwidth" column, which gives an indication of how much bandwidth has been consumed by humans vs bots. If the majority of the traffic is coming from humans, checking the "Locales" and "Hosts" sections below will provide more information about the specific sources of that traffic and if there are opportunities to block specific IPs or countries. If the majority of the traffic is coming from bots, the "Robots/Spiders visitors" section below will list the specific bots that are consuming the traffic. This will help identify bots that can be blocked in the robots.txt file to prevent future bandwidth usage. "Locales" Section This section provides a breakdown of visitors based on their geographical location. You'll see the number of visits and the percentage of total traffic each country contributes. Key Takeaways / Action Items If a lot of visitors are coming from outside of the website's target market, blocking traffic from outside of those countries can have a large impact on the bandwidth usage of the site. "Hosts" Section This is a list of IP addresses that have accessed the site. This can help identify the specific IPs, companies, organizations, or internet service providers (ISPs) consuming bandwidth on the site. Key Takeaways / Action Items Specific IPs can sometimes consume an outsized portion of a site's bandwidth. Use a tool like https://www.ip2location.com/ to search for a specific IP and find information about what country it is from, if it is associated with a specific company or ISP, and more. If a single IP is identified to be consuming a large amount of bandwidth and it is not a desirable source of traffic, the IP can be blocked . Note: If a website is using Cloudflare, Securi, or other DNS hosts that act as a proxy, the IPs listed here will be from the DNS host rather than the original user that made the request. More information about the IPs accessing the site can be found in the DNS host account. "Robots/Spiders visitors" Section This section shows the "user agent" of bots that have visited the site, and how much bandwidth has been consumed by each bot. Key Takeaways / Action Items If the "Summary" section described above indicates that most of the bandwidth usage of the website is coming from bots, this section will help identify which specific bots are consuming the bandwidth so a decision can be made whether to block them or not. Once an undesirable bot is identified, it can be blocked in the robots.txt file . The default robots.txt file blocks ALL bots except for Google, Yahoo, Bing, and Twitter / X. Using the default robots.txt rules is recommended for most websites and will prevent a large number of undesirable bots from crawling the site and consuming bandwidth. Important : Facebook has a bot called "facebookexternalhit". This bot must be allowed in the robots.txt file in order for pages on the website to be shared on Facebook. However, this bot is known for consuming an enormous amount of bandwidth, far beyond what is required to share content on Facebook, and is blocked by default. Find more information about the facebookexternalhit bot . For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . results.title: Using CSS to Target Featured Posts | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: Using CSS to Target Featured Posts Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000101382 Previously, customizing the appearance of Pinned Featured Posts required modifying PHP in specific widgets. Brilliant Directories now adds a dedicated CSS class to featured posts, making it much easier to customize their appearance using CSS instead of PHP. This article demonstrates how to target featured posts with CSS and provides an example of how to customize their appearance. CSS Classes for Featured Posts Each featured post includes a CSS class that can be targeted based on its post type. The following examples show two different post types and their corresponding CSS classes: https://bootstrap.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000051517-pin-featured-posts In this example will change the Background Color of the post on the search results page with the CSS code below: .featured-post, .featured-post .img_section, .featured-post .mid_section, .featured-post .grid_element { background-color: aliceblue; } After saving the changes, featured posts will display with the new background color on the search results page. results.title: How to "CREATE" reviews through the API using Zapier | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: How to "CREATE" reviews through the API using Zapier Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000101416 This article shows an example of how a Google Spreadsheet can be used to create a new review for members on a site using the site's API. Checklist Before Moving Forward With This Example 1) Make sure to generate a unique API Key using the documentation down below as a guideline. Please make sure to save the API Key in a safe place as it is not accessible after it has been created: How To Generate an API Key 2) Make sure to have a Google Spreadsheet ready. This spreadsheet should have at least one row of the review information shown below: Please note the following required fields in order to create a member: user_id , review_title Connecting Google Sheets with Zapier Log in to the Zapier account and click on + Create and click on Zaps : Click on Trigger and search for Google Sheet: Select New or Updated Spreadsheet Row for the Trigger event and log into your Google account, once done click on Continue: Select the Spreadsheet that has the review information with the respective Worksheet. If necessary, select a Trigger Column or leave as "any column" and click on Continue: Click on Test Trigger and the Spreadsheet information will display as a preview: Click on Continue with selected record for the next step in this process. Connecting the API with Zapier A new set of options will appear, select the option for Brilliant Directories: Select the Action Event to Create Review and either choose a BD account if you've done this in the past or Connect a new account: If an account is already, skip down to FILL IN THE BLANK. If this is the first time, click on Connect a new account and a popup will show up. Add the website URL and the API Key , and click Yes, Continue to Brilliant Directories: Once finished, click Continue. Configuring the Review Information The next step will be aligning the fields from your worksheet to the correct fields for the Review to be created. Once all the respective fields have been selected and added, click on Continue: If there is a need to send a notification, select Send Email Notifications ? These are the options: Email Member About This Update Email Reviewer About This Update Email Member & Reviewer About This Update The next step will ask to test the trigger, do so to verify that everything went well: If done correctly, the review will show up in the Interactions » Member Reviews : For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard .
