results.content: Member Export Fields Overview Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000101428 Below is a breakdown of the essential data fields that are used for creating and managing listings within the system. The number of export fields differs from site to site, because the list is built from the member fields each site stores, plus any add-on fields that are active. The Export Members window shows the count above the field list (in the screenshot below it reads Showing 1 to 105 of 105 entries ). The user_id and email fields are always exported and are not part of that count: Custom fields are added to the export fields list too, once at least one member has a value saved in them. Type the field name into the search box (1) to find it (2): These fields ensure that each listing is represented accurately and comprehensively, capturing both personal and professional details as well as social media and business information. Here's a detailed explanation for each field in the listings data. Listing & Company Import Fields The table includes various columns designed to capture all the necessary information for a comprehensive listing. These columns help build a detailed profile that encompasses both personal identifiers and business-related data. These also ensure that users can interact with, locate, and learn about the profiles in an organized manner. listing_type : The type of listing, such as business or individual. logo : URL of the logo associated with the listing. profile_photo : URL of the profile photo of the listing. first_name : The first name of the individual associated with the listing. last_name : The last name of the individual associated with the listing. name : The full name of the individual or business. email : The email address for the listing. company : The name of the company associated with the listing. phone_number : The best contact phone number for the listing. fax_number : The fax number for the listing. address1 : Primary street address. address2 : Secondary street address, if applicable. city : The city where the listing is located. zip_code : The postal or ZIP code for the listing. state_code : Two-letter abbreviation of the state. country_code : Two-letter abbreviation of the country. country_name : Full name of the country, if applicable. website : The URL of the listing's website. twitter : Full URL of the listing’s Twitter account. facebook : Full URL of the listing’s Facebook page. linkedin : Full URL of the listing’s LinkedIn profile. youtube : Full URL of the listing’s YouTube account. instagram : Full URL of the listing’s Instagram account. pinterest : Full URL of the listing’s Pinterest account. snapchat : Full URL of the listing’s Snapchat account. tiktok : Full URL of the listing’s TikTok account. whatsapp : Full international phone number link for WhatsApp. blog : Full URL of the listing’s external blog, if applicable. quote : A short quote that represents the listing, suitable for social media. experience : The year the listing's career or business began. affiliation : Any associations the listing is a part of. awards : Any awards received by the business or individual in the listing. published : Any publications where the listing has been featured. education : Additional education information related to the listing. software : Any software used by the business or individual in the listing. about_me : General information about the listing that doesn't fit into other categories. password : The password used by the member to log in to the system. position : The title of the individual represented in the listing. profession_name : The top-level profession category the listing belongs to. services : Sub-level services associated with the listing, separated by commas. google_plus : Full URL of the Google Plus page associated with the listing. search_description : A short description that appears in search results. parent_id : ID of the parent member if the listing is a sub-account. lat : The latitude of the listing's location, used in Google Maps. lon : The longitude of the listing's location, used in Google Maps. verified : Type "1" if the listing is verified, leave blank if not verified. More information: How To Import Members Via CSV File Listing & Company Export Fields These fields are additional attributes that are included in the export file to provide a more detailed profile. These capture various elements ranging from personal details to social media presence and business information. about_me : A section that provides a brief description or biography of the listing. active : Indicates whether the listing is currently active (1 for active, 0 for inactive). address1 : The primary street address of the listing. address2 : The secondary street address, if applicable. affiliation : Any associations or networks the listing is part of. awards : Awards that the individual or business associated with the listing has received. bitly : Member URL lock. 1 means the member’s profile URL is locked and is never regenerated automatically, which corresponds to the Prevent Auto-Update of Member URL checkbox on the member edit form. The field name is historical and has nothing to do with Bitly link shortening. blog : URL of the external blog associated with the listing. city : The city where the listing is located. company : The name of the company associated with the listing. country_code : Two-letter abbreviation of the country where the listing is located. country_ln : Full name of the country where the listing is located, if needed. cover_photo : URL of the cover photo associated with the listing. credentials : Professional credentials or certifications held by the individual or company in the listing. cv : URL or link to the listing's CV or resume, if available. email : The email address associated with the listing. experience : The number of years or start year of experience for the business or individual. facebook : Full URL of the Facebook profile or page associated with the listing. facebook_id : Facebook ID associated with the listing, if applicable. featured : Indicates if the listing is featured (1 for featured, 0 for not featured). filename : The filename of any uploaded files related to the listing. first_name : The first name of the individual associated with the listing. full_filename : The complete filename, including path, for the uploaded file related to the listing. gmap : URL or link to the Google Maps location for the listing. google_id : Google account ID associated with the listing, if applicable. instagram : Full URL of the Instagram profile associated with the listing. last_login : The date and time of the most recent login for the listing’s account. last_name : The last name of the individual associated with the listing. lat : The latitude coordinate for the listing's location, used in mapping tools. linkedin : Full URL of the LinkedIn profile associated with the listing. listing_type : The type or category of the listing (e.g., individual or company). logo_url : URL of the logo associated with the listing. lon : The longitude coordinate for the listing's location, used in mapping tools. member_credit_balance : The member's current credit balance from the Member Credits System . results.content: How to "DELETE" reviews through the API using Zapier Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000101566 This article shows an example of how a Google Spreadsheet can be used to delete a review for members on a site using the site's API. Checklist Before Moving Forward With This Example 1) Make sure to generate a unique API Key using the documentation down below as a guideline. Please make sure to save the API Key in a safe place as it is not accessible after it has been created: How To Generate an API Key 2) Make sure to have a Google Spreadsheet ready. This spreadsheet should have at least one row of the review information shown below: Please note the following required fields in order to delete a member review: review_id review_title Find the ID of the Review in Interactions » Member Reviews : Connecting Google Sheets with Zapier Log in to the Zapier account and click on + Create and click on Zaps : or Click on Zaps Click on + Create then click on New Zap: Click on Trigger and search for Google Sheet: The Trigger event should be set to "New or Updated Spreadsheet Row." After logging into the Google account, clicking on "Continue" will proceed. Select the Spreadsheet that has the review information with the respective Worksheet. If necessary, select a Trigger Column or leave as "any column" and click on Continue: Click on Continue with Selected Record. The Spreadsheet information will display as a preview: Connecting the API with Zapier A new set of options will appear, select the option for Brilliant Directories: The Action Event should be set to "Delete Review." A Brilliant Directories account can be chosen if one has been used before, or a new account can be connected. If an account is already, skip down to FILL IN THE BLANK. If this is the first time, click on Connect a new account and a popup will show up. Add the website URL and the API Key , and click Yes, Continue to Brilliant Directories: Once finished, click Continue. Configuring the Review Information Click on Continue. Click on the vertical dots and select Custom. Select review_id. Hit Continue. Click on Test Step: The record is now deleted, click on Publish to have the Zap active. Add a name to the Zap to find it easily: If done correctly, the review will be removed in the Interactions » Member Reviews : Click on Transfer existing data is there is a need to delete the reviews right away. For automatic deletion, simply waiting a few minutes for the trigger "New or Updated Spreadsheet Row" to take action is all that's needed. This setting can be used to customize the default "Billing Information" page URL in the Member Dashboard. We created a new Advanced Setting called "Member Dashboard URL: Password". This setting can be used to customize the default "Change Member Password" page URL in the Member Dashboard We released a new version of the Brilliant Directories App in Zapier. This version includes the option to unsubscribe email addresses from email notifications and some minor bug fixes. We created a new Web Page Setting called "Disable Screenshot Preview". When this setting is enabled, the Preview Image won't load on the Web Page Builder page in the Admin. We created a new Text Label called "Member Signup Success Message (No Email Sent to Member)". This label will render on the member signup success modal when the "Sign Up Email Sent" Membership Plan Setting is set to "Do not Send an Email" instead of the regular success message. We created a new Post Type Setting called "Trigger Webhook for Initial Save or Every Save?". When set to "Every Save", the system will trigger the webhook every time a member saves a post. When set to "Initial Save Only", the system will trigger the webhook only the first time a post is saved. We created a new Advanced Setting called "Disable Lead Matched Notifications (SMS) Fallback". When enabled, the system will only send messages to the phone number saved in a member's sms_phone_number field, and never fall back to the phone_number saved for a member. Enhancements / Fixes: We updated the Member Category dropdowns in the Admin to sort content alphabetically rather than by ID. We updated the member import logic to create a "service" value in the users_meta table when importing members with Sub Categories in the Admin. We made several small bug fixes and a performance update to increase the speed of importing members using the Business Data tool in the Admin. We improved how the One-Click Google Login Add-On works with the Default Website Language Setting. We updated the Newsletter Campaign logic to check for time zone and date differences to determinate the current email usage for daily and monthly limits when schedule newsletter campaigns. We fixed an issue which was preventing member profile images from displaying properly on member search results pages in some cases. We fixed an issue which was preventing members from being able to remove files uploaded via the File Upload fields in Member Dashboard forms in some cases. results.title: How to "DELETE" a Member through the API using Zapier | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: How to "DELETE" a Member through the API using Zapier Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000102225 This article shows an example of how a Google Spreadsheet can be used to delete member data using the site's API. Checklist Before Moving Forward With This Example 1) Make sure to generate a unique API Key using the documentation down below as a guideline. Please make sure to save the API Key in a safe place as it is not accessible after it has been created: How To Generate an API Key 2) Make sure to have a Google Spreadsheet ready. This spreadsheet should have at least one row of the member data information shown below: Please note the following required fields in order to delete member data: user_id company or first_name / last_name to recognize who is being deleted Connecting Google Sheets with Zapier Log in to the Zapier account and click on + Create and click on Zaps : or Click on Zaps Click on + Create then click on New Zap: Click on Trigger and search for Google Sheet: The Trigger event should be set to "New or Updated Spreadsheet Row." After logging into the Google account, clicking on "Continue" will proceed. Select the Spreadsheet that has the member information with the respective Worksheet. If necessary, select a Trigger Column or leave as "any column" and click on Continue: Click on Continue with Selected Record. The Spreadsheet information will display as a preview: Connecting the API with Zapier A new set of options will appear, select the option for Brilliant Directories: The Action Event should be set to "Delete User." A Brilliant Directories account can be chosen if one has been used before, or a new account can be connected. If this is the first time, click on Connect a new account and a popup will show up. Add the website URL and the API Key , and click Yes, Continue to Brilliant Directories: Once finished, click Continue. Configuring the User Information Click on Continue. Click on the vertical dots and select Custom. Select user_id. Hit Continue. Zapier will display the question, 'Do you also want to delete the member's images?' Click 'Yes' if the images need to be deleted. We recommend selecting 'Yes' to avoid leaving unused images on the site. Click on Test Step: The User is now deleted, click on Publish to have the Zap active. Add a name to the Zap to find it easily: If done correctly, the member will be removed from the website. Click on Transfer existing data if there is a need to delete the members right away. For automatic deletion, simply waiting a few minutes for the trigger "New or Updated Spreadsheet Row" to take action is all that's needed. results.title: How to Update Review Data Using API: Google Sheets Example | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: How to Update Review Data Using API: Google Sheets Example Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000102243 This article shows an example of how a Google Spreadsheet can be used to update review data on a site using the site's API. Checklist Before Moving Forward With This Example 1) Make sure to generate a unique API Key using the documentation down below as a guideline. Please make sure to save the API Key in a safe place as it is not accessible after it has been created: How To Generate an API Key 2) Prepare a Google Spreadsheet with at least two essential columns: one for the review's ID# (the review_id variable) to reference an existing review on the site, and another for the variable to be updated. For example, if the review currently has the title " A pet store with delivery? Genius " and needs to be updated to " A pet store with delivery? Amazing! ", specify these details in the spreadsheet. Note : The column names do not necessarily match with the correct database variable names as this can be mapped later on. How To Connect Google Sheets Using Zapier In this example, we will be using Zapier to integrate Google Sheets into the Brilliant Directories site. Log in to the Zapier account and click on Create Zap : Name the new zap created and select the Google Sheets option as a Trigger: Select the Event type as New Spreadsheet Row and click on Continue : Connect the Google Sheet Account (this would be a Gmail account) and click on Continue : Choose the preferred Spreadsheet, specify the Worksheet, and click on Continue : Click on Test Trigger : There will be a confirmation that a spreadsheet row has been found, click Continue: Now the Trigger has been set up correctly, the Action can be created. Search and select the " Brilliant Directories " as the App option: Choose the Event as Update Review event and connect Account: Select "Connect a new account": This will open a new window where the domain of the site (https:// or http:// included) and the API Key generated can be specified: Next, we will be setting up the action. In this section, all the available review variables can be found. As we already created a spreadsheet with a row of review data, the next action would be mapping/matching the column names to the correct variable names. Select the "Custom" option for the Review ID field and select the review_id value from the spreadsheet: Then, map the Review Title by selecting the review_title column for the "review_title" field: Now that all the preferred variables are matched and mapped correctly, click on Continue to test the action: Confirm that the information displayed is correct and click on Test Step : Make sure that the targeted field is updated: Once confirmed, click on "Publish": Note : Going forward, any new rows added to the connected Google Sheet via the API will automatically update the corresponding member data. results.title: How to Add Cookie Consent | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: How to Add Cookie Consent Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000102536 Implementing cookie consent functionality is essential for ensuring compliance with data privacy regulations. This process typically involves integrating a third-party cookie consent solution into a website. Such tools streamline the process by providing pre-built scripts and customizable interfaces to manage user consent. Select a Cookie Consent Tool Choose a reliable third-party provider that aligns with the website's privacy requirements. Popular options include Cookiebot, OneTrust, and Osano ( click for example ). These tools offer comprehensive features, such as banner customization, consent tracking, and integration support. Adding Cookie Consent Code in Brilliant Directories To integrate cookie consent functionality in a Brilliant Directories website, follow these steps: Access the Brilliant Directories Admin Dashboard . Be sure to be logged into your admin dashboard. Navigate to the Toolbox section and select Widget Manager . Locate the "Widget Manager" option within the Toolbox menu to manage the website's widgets. Search for the Bootstrap Theme - Cookie Consent Code widget. Use the search bar in the Widget Manager to find the specific widget dedicated to cookie consent. Insert the third-party snippet in the HTML editor. Open the widget in the editor and paste the provided cookie consent code snippet into the appropriate section of the HTML. Save the changes. Click on Save Changes to finalize and implement the updates on the website. For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . results.title: Unsubscribe API - Unsubscribe Members from Email Campaigns | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: Unsubscribe API - Unsubscribe Members from Email Campaigns Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000102546 It is possible to Unsubscribe a member from receiving email using the api, only 1 member can be updated at a time. Using the API there are 4 Unsubscribe actions that can be achieved: /api/v2/unsubscribe_list/get/{id} /api/v2/unsubscribe_list/create /api/v2/unsubscribe_list/update /api/v2/unsubscribe_list/delete We will break down these actions and explain how to achieve an end results with each one. The examples shown in this article are completed using https://www.postman.com/ Unsubscribe Get API /api/v2/unsubscribe_list/get/{id} Using this action is simple, add the url above but replace {id} with the actual member ID. This will fetch the member information from the website Unsubscribe Create API /api/v2/unsubscribe_list/create With this action, by sending the email, it will add the member to the unsubscribe list. results.title: How to "DELETE" Leads through the API using Zapier | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: How to "DELETE" Leads through the API using Zapier Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000102581 This article shows an example of how a Google Spreadsheet can be used to delete a lead on a site using the site's API. Checklist Before Moving Forward With This Example 1) Make sure to generate a unique API Key using the documentation down below as a guideline. Please make sure to save the API Key in a safe place as it is not accessible after it has been created: How To Generate an API Key 2) Make sure to have a Google Spreadsheet ready. This spreadsheet should have at least one row of the lead information shown below: Please note the following required fields in order to delete a member lead: lead_id lead_email to identify the emails that submitted the lead being deleted Find the ID of the Lead in Interactions » Member Leads : Connecting Google Sheets with Zapier Log in to the Zapier account and click on + Create and click on Zaps : or Click on Zaps Click on + Create then click on New Zap: Click on Trigger and search for Google Sheet: The Trigger event should be set to "New or Updated Spreadsheet Row." After logging into the Google account, clicking on "Continue" will proceed. Select the Spreadsheet that has the lead information with the respective Worksheet. If necessary, select a Trigger Column or leave as "any column" and click on Continue: Click on Continue with Selected Record. The Spreadsheet information will display as a preview: Connecting the API with Zapier A new set of options will appear, select the option for Brilliant Directories: The Action Event should be set to "Delete Lead." A Brilliant Directories account can be chosen if one has been used before, or a new account can be connected. If an account is already, skip down to FILL IN THE BLANK. If this is the first time, click on Connect a new account and a popup will show up. Add the website URL and the API Key , and click Yes, Continue to Brilliant Directories: Once finished, click Continue. Configuring the Lead Information Click on Continue. Click on the vertical dots and select Custom. Select lead_id. Hit Continue. Click on Test Step: The record is now deleted, click on Publish to have the Zap active. Add a name to the Zap to find it easily: If done correctly, the lead will be removed in the Interactions » Member Leads page. Click on Transfer existing data is there is a need to delete the leads right away. For automatic deletion, simply waiting a few minutes for the trigger "New or Updated Spreadsheet Row" to take action is all that's needed. results.title: Checklist when Changing the Domain of a Live Website | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: Checklist when Changing the Domain of a Live Website Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000102627 Changing an existing website's domain affects its address, email identity, and services that authorize a specific domain. Use this checklist before and after the Switch Over stage in Settings > Domain Manager . Before the switch Confirm access to the new domain's registrar and DNS provider. Record the current DNS and mail-provider settings. Preserve access to existing mailboxes and back up any messages that must be retained. Confirm the mailbox migration plan before changing a domain used for BD-hosted email. Plan old-domain redirects separately. Changing the website address does not, by itself, establish a redirect from every old address. List integrations restricted to the old domain, including Google Maps, reCAPTCHA, Google/Facebook login, payment callbacks, image delivery, and other connected services. Confirm the Managed SSL entitlement or the plan for installing a third-party certificate. Connect the new address Open Settings > Domain Manager > Domain . Click Change my domain name . Follow the connection walkthrough through address validation and DNS pointing. Review the old and new addresses on Switch Over . Confirm the switch only when the new address and remaining consequences are understood. After the switch Open the new address to confirm the intended website loads. Check SSL for the new hostname. Check Emails > Sender Authentication for the new domain. Complete any manual SPF or DKIM instructions shown. Confirm the default sending address and the administrative contact email. The switch moves a sending address that used the old domain or a placeholder to the new domain, keeping the part before the @; an address at another domain is left unchanged. Confirm incoming mail routing in Mailboxes and at the mail provider. Test sending and receiving email. Update domain-restricted integrations at their providers. Test maps, protected forms, social login, checkout, and important member workflows. Update branding, externally stored links, and relevant search/analytics properties. Verify the old-domain redirect if one was configured. The completion screen lists What to do next : the email records, the security certificate request, and the integration keys that need the new domain. It can report that email records were already published when the connected DNS service accepted them. Still check the Emails result and test delivery. A changed domain does not automatically update every external provider's authorized-domain list. Completion means the new website loads securely, outgoing authentication and incoming mail work, the required integrations pass their checks, and any intended old-domain redirects work. results.title: How to "Search"  for members through the API | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: How to "Search" for members through the API Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000102884 In this article, we will be going over how to "Search" members using the /search API . What this API endpoint allows to do is to send information to the endpoint, just like it would emulate the functionality of using one of the member search features on the site. How to "Search" Members The user search API leverages various parameters to retrieve data displayed the same way as on member search results pages on the site. Parameters There are 10 parameters that can be used to filter the results. dynamic: Set to 1 to simulate a Dynamic Category Filter search. q: Enter a keyword to search for in member data. pid: Enter member Top Level Category ID to search for. Enter a comma-separated list of IDs if the Dynamic Category Filter search is enabled. tid: Enter member Sub Level Category ID to search for. Enter a comma-separated list of IDs if the Dynamic Category Filter search is enabled. ttid: Enter member Sub-Sub Level Category ID to search for. Enter a comma-separated list of IDs if the Dynamic Category Filter search is enabled. address: Enter the location to search for. Example: Los Angeles, California, United States. output_type: Enter the type of response to receive. Valid options - html, array. By default the results will show in HTML similar to the search results page on the site. If set to Array the results will show in a JSON array. limit: Enter the maximum number of search results to return per page of results. sort: Set the Order the data would be display. The options here are : reviews, name ASC, name DESC, last_name_asc, last_name_desc page: Enter the page number of results to return. For Example, enter 2 to return the second page of results. Example with Postman When endpoint is sent by default the results will show in the HTML format, the same as the search results page: When selecting Array as the output_type, the results will show in a Json Array format: Important Note When using the address field, it is required for the site to have the Pretty URL advanced setup enabled. For more information on how to do so: Set Up Pretty URLs with Google Maps For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . results.title: Setting Up Razorpay | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: Setting Up Razorpay Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000103082 As of February 1st, 2025, Razorpay is available as a native payment gateway integration in Brilliant Directories. Follow the steps below to generate the necessary credentials and complete the setup process. Step 1: Access the Razorpay API Section Log in to the Razorpay Dashboard at https://dashboard.razorpay.com . Click Account & Settings from the left sidebar. Navigate to API Keys under Website and App Settings . Step 2: Generate the Razorpay API Key If an API Key has not been created yet, click Generate Key . Note whether the system is in Test or Live mode. Test mode keys work only for test transactions. If these keys are for the live website, ensure Live mode is selected before generating keys. Step 3: Copy the Key ID and Key Secret After generating the keys, a pop-up will display the Key ID and Key Secret . Copy the Key ID . This will be required to complete the integration. Copy the Key Secret . The Key Secret will only be displayed once, so ensure it is securely saved. IMPORTANT: If a new API Key is ever created in the future, make sure to update the Brilliant Directories website with the new Key ID and Key Secret to ensure uninterrupted payment processing. Step 4: Add Razorpay as a Payment Gateway in Brilliant Directories Log in to the Brilliant Directories Admin . Navigate to Finance → Payment Settings . Click Add a New Payment Gateway . Select Razorpay from the list of available payment gateways. Step 5: Enter the Razorpay Keys and Save In the Razorpay setup popup, paste the Key ID into the designated field. Paste the Key Secret into the corresponding field. Click Save Changes to complete the integration. Step 6: Verify the Integration Process a test transaction to confirm that payments are being processed correctly. Check the Razorpay Dashboard for transaction logs. If any issues arise, refer to Razorpay’s official support documentation or contact Brilliant Directories support for assistance. IMPORTANT: Required Razorpay Settings The following settings must be configured correctly for the integration to work properly: Under General Settings >> Locatlization >> Website Currency Set To: Indian Rupee Ensure these settings are verified before completing the setup. Incorrect configurations may cause payment issues. Live Mode vs. Test Mode Razorpay offers two modes: Live Mode and Test Mode . Live Mode: Use this mode to process actual transactions. The Key ID and Key Secret generated in Live Mode are separate from those in Test Mode. Test Mode: Use this mode for testing purposes. Transactions in Test Mode do not involve real payments, but the Test Mode Key ID and Key Secret must be used. Ensure the appropriate mode is selected based on the intended use of the integration. After completing these steps and verifying the configuration, transactions will be securely processed through Razorpay, ensuring a seamless payment experience. results.title: Managing Leads From A Member's Perspective | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: Managing Leads From A Member's Perspective Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000103091 Members can manage leads directly from their dashboard. Depending on the lead settings configured by the site administrator, members may be able to: Purchase a lead Accept a free lead Decline a lead This article explains how each action works and how members can track the status of their assigned leads. Purchasing Leads Please find all the relevant information here: Purchasing Leads Accepting Free Leads An email notification is sent when a lead is assigned. The email contains a link to view the lead details. The link included in the email automatically logs into the dashboard and opens the assigned lead. Clicking on " View Details " will open the lead: If lead notifications are configured to display a preview only, Accept Lead must be selected before the full contact information becomes available. After the lead is accepted, the complete lead information becomes available, including contact details such as email address and phone number. Declining Leads The member will receive an email notifying them that they have a lead. A link to view the lead is included in the email template: Clicking on the link will AUTOMATICALLY log that member into his dashboard and take them straight to the lead itself facilitating the purchasing process. Clicking on " View Details " will open the lead: The member will click on " Decline Lead " to not accept it: The system will display a pop-up asking for feedback on why the lead was not accepted. This question is optional. The lead will appear as "Declined" in this section: View Declined Lead Reason The owner of the site views the declined lead reason in the Leads details of the admin: Member Assigned Lead Status When a lead is accepted, the following lead statuses will be displayed: Deal Won Deal Lost In Progress Needs Contact These statuses are designed to help members efficiently manage their leads on the dashboard. This appears in its own column when viewing all leads: Lead Status Text Labels These are text labels which can be found and edited within the Settings » Text Labels : lead_user_status_won lead_user_status_deal_lost lead_user_status_in_progress lead_user_status_needs_contact For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . results.title: Widgets API - How to edit widgets data with API Calls | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content:
Widgets API - How to edit widgets data with API Calls Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000103396 The API allows getting, creating, updating, deleting, rendering, and posting widgets on the website. However, only one widget can be updated at a time. Available API Endpoints Below is a list of the available endpoints for Widgets: https://example.com/api/v2/data_widgets/get/{id} https://example.com/api/v2/data_widgets/create https://example.com/api/v2/data_widgets/update https://example.com/api/v2/data_widgets/delete https://example.com/api/v2/data_widgets/render Using the API, the following actions can be performed: Get a Widget Read the data of a single widget based on the widget_id. Legacy widgets are not returned. The Default widgets included in a /get list response are limited to those supported by the current version of the software. Default widgets that belong only to legacy versions are no longer included, so API responses may contain fewer widgets than in previous versions. This is expected and does not affect the Widget Manager or any existing website. Widgets that support the current version along with older versions are still returned. The filter checks whether the current version is included in the widget's supported versions, not whether it is the only supported version. Customized widgets are also returned regardless of the versions they list, and reading a single widget by its widget_id is not filtered. Endpoint : GET https://example.com/api/v2/data_widgets/get/{id} curl -H "Authorization: YOUR_API_KEY" \ "https://example.com/api/v2/data_widgets/get/{id}" Example Request: GET https://example.com/api/v2/data_widgets/get/?property=widget_id&property_value=29 Query Parameters: property The property key (eg., widget_id). property_value The value associated with the property. Example Response: { "status": "success", "message": [ { "widget_id": "29", "widget_name": "Hello World", "widget_data": "

", "widget_style": ".hello{color:green}", "date_updated": "2025-02-13 10:32:20", "revision_timestamp": "2025-02-13 11:32:20", "widget_javascript": "", } ], "total": "1", "current_page": 1, "total_pages": 1 } Create a Widget Add a new widget to the database. Parameter Notes : The widget_id will be assigned by the system. Endpoint : POST https://example.com/api/v2/data_widgets/create curl -H "Authorization: YOUR_API_KEY" \ "https://example.com/api/v2/data_widgets/create" Example Request: { "widget_name": "Hello World", "widget_data": "

", "widget_style": ".hello{color:red}", "widget_javascript": "" } Query Parameters: widget_name The name of the widget. widget_data HTML + PHP. widget_style CSS. widget_javascript JS. Example Response: { "status": "success", "message": { "widget_id": "28", "widget_name": "Hello World", "widget_data": "

", "widget_style": ".hello{color:red}", "date_updated": "2025-02-13 10:11:19", "widget_javascript": "", } } Update a Widget Update a widget record and their related data from the database. Parameter Notes : Use widget_id or widget_name . Endpoint : PUT https://example.com/api/v2/data_widgets/update curl -H "Authorization: YOUR_API_KEY" \ "https://example.com/api/v2/data_widgets/update" Example Request: { "widget_id": 28, "widget_name": "Hello Amazing World", "widget_data": "

", "widget_style": ".hello{color:green}", "widget_javascript": "" } Query Parameters: widget_id The ID of the widget. widget_name The name of the widget. widget_data HTML + PHP. widget_style CSS. widget_javascript JS. Example Response: { "status": "success", "message": { "widget_id": "28", "widget_name": "Hello Amazing World ", "widget_data": "

", "widget_style": ".hello{color:green}", "date_updated": "2025-02-13 10:11:19", "revision_timestamp": "2025-02-13 11:11:19", "widget_html_element": "", "widget_javascript": "", } } Delete a Widget Delete a widget and their related data from the database. Parameter Notes : Use widget_id or widget_name . Endpoint : DELETE https://example.com/api/v2/data_widgets/delete curl -H "Authorization: YOUR_API_KEY" \ "https://example.com/api/v2/data_widgets/delete" Example Request: { "widget_id": 28 } Query Parameters: widget_id The ID of the widget. widget_name The name of the widget. Example Response: { "status": "success", "message": "data_widgets record was deleted" } Render a Widget Render widget content of specific widget. Parameter Notes : Use widget_id or widget_name . The widget needs to be customized to get the widget output. Endpoint : POST https://example.com/api/v2/data_widgets/render curl -H "Authorization: YOUR_API_KEY" \ "https://example.com/api/v2/data_widgets/render" Example Request: { "widget_id": 31, "widget_name": "Bootstrap Theme - Homepage Search - Yellow Pages Search" } Query Parameters: widget_id The ID of the widget. widget_name The name of the widget. Example Response: { "name": "Bootstrap Theme - Homepage Search - Yellow Pages Search", "output": "
" } For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . Was this article helpful and accurate? Yes No Send feedback Sorry we couldn't be helpful. Help us improve this article with your feedback.

results.title: My Members Search Members » Search Filters | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: My Members Search Members » Search Filters Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000103849 The search filters enable refining the results based on specific criteria, helping to locate members efficiently. Search Filters There are 23 different search filters, 1. Search by Name, ID, URL, or Token Allows searching for a member using their name, unique ID, profile URL, or token. 2. Membership Plan Filters members based on their assigned membership plans. 3. Top-Level Category Enables filtering by the primary category assigned to a member. 4. Joined Date Range Filters members based on the date they joined the platform. 5. Search by Email Address Allows locating a member by their registered email address. 6. Account Status Filters members based on their account status, such as active, inactive, or on hold. 7. Sub-Category Selection Allows refining searches further by selecting a sub-category relevant to a member. 8. Login Date Range Filters members based on their last login activity within a specified date range. 9. Verified Status Filters members based on whether they have been verified on the platform. 10. Transaction Types Filters members based on their payment history, such as No Transactions, Paid, Stopped / Cancelled, Past Due, Refunded, Upcoming, Credits Available. (Includes filter for members with available credits ) 11. Sub-Sub Category Allows for further refinement by selecting a sub-sub category for the member. 12. Joined Via Filters members based on how they registered, such as Admin, API, Import CSV, Business Data Import, Self Signup, Self Signup Via Facebook, Self Signup Via Google, and Self Signup Via Claim Listing. 13. Search by Location Filters members based on their geographic location. 14. Member Type Filters results by member type, such as individual or company. 15. Forms Submitted Filters members based on the forms they have completed and submitted. 16. Forms Not Submitted Filters members based on the forms they have not yet submitted. 17. Profile Status Filter (Complete or Incomplete; only available if the Require Complete Profiles setting is turned on) 18. Find Duplicates The Find Duplicates filter enables the administrator to locate members based on selected fields. If multiple options are chosen, the filter will seek duplicates across all selected criteria. 19. Choose Sales Rep. Name This dropdown will display all the sales representatives that are added to members of the website. Available with the Sales Representative Tracking advanced setting. 20. User IP Country Filters members based on the country associated with their IP address. 21. User IP Allows searching members based on their last recorded IP address. 22. Member Tags Filters members using custom tags assigned to them. (Available with the Member Tags & Tag Groups Add-on) 23. Profile Images The Profile Images Filter has two options: Image Exist : Shows members who have the selected image(s) in the filter. Image Missing : Shows members who are missing the selected image(s). Profile Photo Image: Filters members based on whether they have uploaded a profile picture. This option is typically relevant for individual listings. Company Logo Image: Filters members based on whether they have uploaded a company logo. This option is relevant for company listings. Profile Cover Image: Filters members who have uploaded a cover image for their profile. Cover images help personalize a profile and enhance its visual appeal. Important This is an "AND" search, meaning if all three image types ( Profile, Logo, and Cover Image ) are selected, the system will look for members who have all three images. Only members meeting all three criteria will appear in the search results. Searching by Multiple Member IDs The Member Name, ID, or URL filter allows to search for multiple member IDs simultaneously. To do this, add a # to the search query, followed by a comma-separated list of member IDs. (see screenshot) Example: #44871,44866,44858 Note: This field has a character limit. If the search exceeds the limit, no results will be displayed. In that case, try reducing the number of IDs in the search. Location Search and Multi-Location Add-On If the Multi-Location Add-On is active on the site, an additional checkbox option called Include Service Areas will appear. If Service Areas are excluded, only the members who added the specified location to their contact details form will appear. If Service Areas are included, members who added the specified location to their contact details form and those who added the specified location to their service areas will appear. Multi-Option Filters All dropdown filters on the Search Members page support selecting multiple options. Simply select the desired values within a filter to include them in the search results. results.title: My Members » Search Members » Members Table | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: My Members » Search Members » Members Table Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000103850 Search Results Members Table This is the search results table of all the members in the website. The table will vary its content based on the search parameters used in the search filters. 1. Status This section explains the different account statuses available in the platform, defining what each status represents and how it affects a member's access and functionality. It also includes the profile image if the listing is set as an individual or the company logo if the listing is set to company. For a detailed list of the different account statuses and how to edit them, refer to the following article: Account Status 2. Contact Information This section provides details about the member's contact information, including their name, listing type, email, phone number, location, and social media accounts. Name (Individual) / Company Name (Company) Displays the full name if the member is an individual. If the listing is set as a company, this field will show the registered company name. Listing Type Indicates whether the listing is an individual profile or a company account. Email Address Shows the registered email address associated with the member. Company or Member Alternative Name For individual listings, this field displays the company name if provided. For company listings, it shows the primary contact person’s name. Phone Number Displays the primary phone number associated with the member. Geocoding Information Includes geographic coordinates associated with the member’s location, helping to identify their approximate position on a map. Social Media Accounts Lists links to the member’s social media profiles, such as Facebook, LinkedIn, Twitter, or other platforms. 3. Actions Menu The actions menu provides quick access to essential account management options for each member. These actions allow for profile updates, account maintenance, and communication. The following article describes each option available in this menu: My Members » Search Members » Actions Dropdown 4. Profile Views If the Profile Statistics Add-On and setting are enabled, the amount of views the profile has received, will be displayed here. This setting is setup per membership plan. 5. Membership The results table displays members who match the applied search criteria. Each row represents a member and contains key details. Member ID : A unique identification number assigned to each member. Membership Plan : Displays the membership plan associated with the member. Join Date : Indicates when the member joined the platform. Last Login : Shows the most recent login date of the member. Category : Displays the primary category under which the member is classified. Parent Account ID : If the Multi-Member Manager add-on is activated on the site, this field shows the ID of the parent account. 6. Revenue This column is a financial overview of the member. It displays information like: The total of any past due payments. Credits available . The revenue generated by the member. results.title: Understanding and Editing Schema Markup in Brilliant Directories | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: Understanding and Editing Schema Markup in Brilliant Directories Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000103985 What is Schema Markup? Schema markup is a type of structured data that helps search engines understand the content of a webpage more effectively. Implementing schema correctly can improve search visibility and enhance rich snippets in search results. Does Brilliant Directories Automatically Add Schema? Brilliant Directories includes some schema markup by default in various parts of the website, but users can also add or modify schema based on their needs. Additionally, schema can be added anywhere on the website where structured data is needed, providing full flexibility for customization. When a member profile has approved reviews, aggregateRating and review are added to that profile's LocalBusiness schema automatically — no widget change or custom markup is required. All search results pages automatically include ItemList Schema. Where Can Schema Be Edited in Brilliant Directories? If customization or additions to schema markup are required for a Brilliant Directories website, the following are the main areas where schema can be edited: Widgets Schema markup is included in several system widgets that control how information is displayed on different pages: Bootstrap Theme - Member Profile - Display Member Address Bootstrap Theme - Function - Display Breadcrumbs Bootstrap Theme - Social Media Links Bootstrap Theme - Global Website - Schema Markup Bootstrap Theme - Footer - Scripts Bootstrap Theme - Detail Page - Schema Markup - Community Article Bootstrap Theme - Detail Page - Schema Markup - Website Blog Article Bootstrap Theme - Detail Page - Schema Markup - Event Post Type Bootstrap Theme - Detail Page - Schema Markup - Jobs Post Type Bootstrap Theme - Detail Page - Schema Markup - Video Post Type Bootstrap Theme - Detail Page - Schema Markup - Property Listing Post Type Bootstrap Theme - Detail Page - Schema Markup - Product Post Type Add-On - Bootstrap Theme - Global Search - Sitesearch HEAD Schema Add-On - Bootstrap Theme - Posts - Comments UI Bootstrap Theme - Single Post Page Post Types The search results pages of these post types have the schema markup directly in the post type code by default: Member Article Website Blog Article Videos Jobs Events Coupons Soundcloud Discussions Properties Products Photo Albums Classified Digital Products This can be seen directly in the edit post setting section in the search results tab. Below the example for the Member Articles: Note: This part of the post type default code. If the code marked below is not showing, it will be required to restore the Default code following the guide below: How to Reset to Default Post Types Code Reviews Post Type Code: This can be edited in the Profile Page Design tab . SEO & Static Pages Schema markup can be added to all SEO pages and static pages within Brilliant Directories. Quick Edit Section Unique schema can be added per member in the head section via the Quick Edit feature. How to Add or Modify Schema Markup To add or modify schema markup, consider the following methods: Editing the relevant widget within the Widget Manager. Adding schema directly into the SEO Templates for specific page types. Utilizing the Quick Edit option to add schema per member profile. Adding schema manually into the head section of pages where necessary. Implementing schema markup correctly can improve search rankings and provide search engines with better-structured data. Leveraging the available options in Brilliant Directories ensures the website is optimized for better visibility and user experience. Note: By default, Website & Organization Schema are now included in footer for all BD sites in the widget Bootstrap Theme - Footer - Scripts . This can be viewed by using a tool like Schema Validator ( https://validator.schema.org ) Structured Data Testing Guide After adding or editing schema markup in your Brilliant Directories website, it's essential to test and validate the structured data to ensure it's correctly implemented and eligible for rich results in Google Search. Below are step-by-step instructions to test your schema using Google's Rich Results Test and how to apply these tools to member profile pages or post pages. Using Google's Rich Results Test This tool checks whether your page supports rich results (like star ratings, events, or FAQs) in Google Search. Go to Google’s Rich Results Test . In the “Test your URL” field, enter the full link to a member profile or post on your BD website (e.g., https://yourdomain.com/jane-doe ). Click "Test URL" . Wait a few seconds while the page is analyzed. Review the results: If your page is eligible for rich results, you'll see a success message and the types detected. If there are errors or warnings, they will be displayed with guidance for fixing them. Pro Tip: Use this tool to verify that common schemas like LocalBusiness , Article , or Event are working as expected. For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . Was this article helpful and accurate? results.title: How To Restrict Iframe Access to Specific Domains | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: How To Restrict Iframe Access to Specific Domains Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000104163 A new Advanced Setting has been introduced: Whitelist Domains Allowed to Iframe This Website . This setting provides control over which external domains are permitted to embed content from the website using an <iframe>. Enabling this feature enhances security and ensures better management of where website content can be displayed externally. Available Options This setting has three available option values, each offering different functionality to control iframe access: All, None, and Specific Domains. 1. All (Default) Allows all external domains to embed the website in an iframe. Suitable for websites intended to be widely embedded without restriction. 2. None Prevents all external domains from embedding the website in an iframe. Ideal for cases where iframe embedding is not permitted for any third party. 3. Specific Domains Grants access only to a list of approved domains. Requires a comma-separated list of allowed domains. Supports various URL formats, including: example.com, www.example.com, https://example.com, https://www.example.com, http://example.com, http://www.example.com Appropriate for allowing iframe access from trusted or controlled domains only. results.title: Error Reporting for PHP and Widgets, Forms, and Menus | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: Error Reporting for PHP and Widgets, Forms, and Menus Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000104272 Error handling has been improved across all BD websites, including widgets, forms, and menus. Instead of pages or features failing to load silently, regular users will now see clear and friendly messages when something doesn’t work as expected. Admins get more detailed information to help identify and resolve issues quickly. For more complex situations, our support team continues to receive full technical details to provide additional help. The PHP errors will show up on these sections: Widgets Forms Menus Minor Errors These are the kinds of errors that will break certain functionality, like a search bar, but not the entire page. Website Member/User for Widgets In this example, the header search module is missing. Users won't see the error, the section will simply not appear. Website Admins for Widgets There will be more information available when a website admin is logged in. The widget name and/or PHP error will be displayed. Website Member/User for Forms In this example, the Website - Contact Us form is missing. Users won't see the error, the page will simply show blank. Website Admins for Forms There will be more information available when a website admin is logged in. The form name and/or PHP error will be displayed. Website Member/User for Menus In this example, the footer menu is missing. Users won't see the error, the section will simply not appear. Website Admins for Menus There will be more information available when a website admin is logged in. The menu name and/or PHP error will be displayed. Edit Mode This also appears when the website is in "edit mode" accessible through the admin bar. » How to Locate Widgets, Sidebars, Menus, and Forms Via Admin Bar Critical Errors These kinds of errors will shut down an entire site or page. These errors will automatically notify our technical team so they can investigate the issue. Website Member/User There will be a message indicating that the site cannot load the page with an option to return to the homepage. Website Admins There will be more information available when a website admin is logged in. The widget name and/or PHP error will be displayed. Brilliant Directories Support Our technical and support teams will be able to see in-depth information about the error so we can quickly resolve the fatal error presented by the website. results.title: Finance » Manage Offers | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: Finance » Manage Offers Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000104741 The Manage Offers page in the Admin Dashboard allows directory owners to earn affiliate commissions by promoting trusted third-party business tools to their members. These offers appear in the ‘Business Toolkit’ section of their dashboard. Admins can toggle individual offers on or off, register for affiliate programs, and optionally insert their own affiliate links for each tool. Only offers that are enabled by the admin and enabled within the Membership Plan settings will be shown to members. Accessing the Manage Offers Page This page can be found by navigating to Finance » Manage Offers in the admin sidebar. This section displays all available Business Toolkit offers and allows the admin to control their visibility, as well as optionally add affiliate referral links. Enabling & Disabling Offers Each offer has an ON/OFF toggle. The admin can turn ON the offers that should be visible to members, or turn OFF any solutions that are not being promoted. Even if all offers are enabled, members will only see them if their Membership Plan is configured to display the "Business Toolkit" section. Adding an Affiliate Link Adding a custom affiliate link is optional — it's a perk for directory owners who want to earn a commission, but it is not required to display offers to members. Most solutions include a link to register for their affiliate program. Once approved, the admin can paste the affiliate link into the “Use Your Own Affiliate Link” field for that solution. This will override the default link and ensure credit and commission are received for any referrals made by members. Affiliate Links Are Optional It is not required to enter an affiliate link to offer a tool. The admin can enable a solution in member dashboards and return later to insert an affiliate link if needed. The priority is to provide valuable tools that help members manage and grow their businesses. Controlling Visibility via Membership Plans To show the "Business Toolkit" section inside the member's dashboard, edit the Membership Plan settings for each plan and set Show "Business Toolkit" Offers to YES. If this setting is disabled, members who belong to that membership plan will not see the "Business Toolkit" link in their dashboards, even if offers are turned ON in the admin. Navigate to: Finance Membership Plans Edit a Specific Membership Plan Click the "Member's Dashboard" tab Then scroll down to the "Additional Settings" section Locate the setting for Show "Business Toolkit" Offers Set this to 'YES' to enable the Business Toolkit link in the dashboard side menu Note: If this setting is enabled but no offers are turned ON in the admin, the “Business Toolkit” link will not appear in the member dashboard. Adding a New Custom Offer In addition to enabling the pre-loaded Business Toolkit offers, admins can also create their own custom offers. This is useful if the admin wants to recommend a specific tool, product, or service that is not already included, or if the admin has their own affiliate or partnership links they'd like to promote. Steps to Add a Custom Offer: Click the Add New Offer button for the section that fits best. Enter the ' New Offer' name , Description , and an optional Image or Logo for the tool or service. Provide the Offer Link . This can be a standard link or the admin's own affiliate/referral link. Save the Offer details. Set the Status to 'ON' to make the offer available. By default, it will be OFF. The new option will appear in the member's dashboard: For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . results.title: 06/06/2025 - Software Updates | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: 06/06/2025 - Software Updates Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000104745 We made updates to several default widgets this week. If you customized any of these widgets and want to update them, you can find the latest code in the corresponding default widget. Please remember that if you have a custom version of any of these widgets, the latest updates will not be pushed to your website. Implemented a set of quality improvements to the API Documenation page in the Admin. Fixed an issue that prevented the Post Type Search Results from returning accurate results when using the post category dropdown filter in some cases. Widget Involved: Search - Group - Search Query Fixed an issue that prevented the homepage's sub-sub category dropdowns from respecting the "Content Boxes & Background Corner Styles" Design Detting. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Footer - Scripts - User Search Scripts Added support for Sub and Sub-Sub Categories as variables in SEO Templates. New SEO variables: sub_category_name and sub_sub_category_name. Widget Involved: Search - Member - Search Query The Recent Reviews sidebar widget is now compatible with the "URL Permalink" Post Type Setting. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Module - Recent Reviews Updated the message that displays for the "Origin Page" field on the Lead Details page when a lead is created via the API. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Display - Lead Origin URL Fixed an issue that prevented Google Maps suggestion options from working properly when the "Location Search Suggestions" setting was set to "Only Search Within Primary Country" and the New Google Maps Places API was enabled. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Function - Google Location Suggest Added the ability to import image titles and image descriptions when importing Multi-Photo Posts via CSV File and the API. Added a "Year to Date" (January 1st to current date) option to select when using "Date Picker" search fields in the Admin. Fixed an issue that prevented the Easy-Coupon Codes Add-On from working properly on checkout pages in some cases. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Function - Form Promotion Code Validation Fixed an issue that prevented list bullets in Froala fields (EG the "About Me" field) from displaying on member profile pages when viewed on mobile devices in some cases. Added Default Schema Markup to the Post Details pages of Job, Event, and Video Post Types. Updated the Web Page Builder in the Admin to add a Search Snippet Preview when creating or updating web pages. To use this new feature navigate to the Admin >> My Content >> Web Page Builder >> Create/Edit Web Page >> SEO Settings Tab. Updated the layout of the Login page for the Admin. Added the ability to import Business Data members into different categories than they were originally when reimporting previous imports from the Business Data page in the Admin. Improved the member import validation logic to better handle URL formats when importing members with website links via CSV file and API. results.title: White Labeling Your Brilliant Directories Website | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: White Labeling Your Brilliant Directories Website Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000104915 The ability to fully white label your Brilliant Directories website is free and available to all users. This includes removing all visible mentions of Brilliant Directories from both the front-end (public website) and the back-end (admin area). Front-End White Labeling The front-end of all Brilliant Directories websites is fully white labeled by default. There is never any mention of Brilliant Directories on the public-facing website - ever. No "Powered by Brilliant Directories" text No visible BD branding anywhere on the front-end Your own logo, domain, and branding are displayed at all times There is nothing you need to do to enable this — it is already active on all BD websites at no cost. Admin Area (Back-End) White Labeling By default, the back-end admin area includes links and tools that connect to Brilliant Directories support resources. These include: Links to help articles and videos hosted by Brilliant Directories A button to create support tickets that go directly to the BD support team Footer mentions of Brilliant Directories in support sections How to White Label the Admin Area To remove all visible mentions of Brilliant Directories from the back-end admin area, you can request admin white labeling. This is free and available to all websites. Email the Brilliant Directories support team to request admin white labeling: support@brilliantdirectories.com Support links, help videos, and documentation references will be removed The option to submit support tickets from within the admin will be removed No mentions of Brilliant Directories will remain in the admin interface This creates a more neutral experience in the dashboard, without showing Brilliant Directories branding or links to BD-managed support tools. Using White Labeling as an Agency or Reseller If you are building and managing websites for clients, you can: Launch the site with your client’s branding Request admin white labeling before assigning admin access Add your client as a full-access admin if needed You control how you present and support the website. There are no restrictions on how much you charge your clients or how you package your services. Summary Front-end white labeling is included and active on all BD websites by default Admin white labeling is available to all users at no cost — just email support to enable it Then, there will be no visible mentions of Brilliant Directories on your site or in the admin once both are applied To request admin area white labeling, contact the Brilliant Directories support team and we’ll be happy to activate it for your site. For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . Was this article helpful and accurate? results.title: Cookie Consent Tool – CookiePal | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: Cookie Consent Tool – CookiePal Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000105171 Integrating Third-Party Cookie Consent CookiePal offers an affordable third-party cookie consent solution that can be embedded on a Brilliant Directories website. The steps below outline how to integrate CookiePal to meet cookie compliance requirements. Step 1: Create a CookiePal Account Navigate to https://cookiepal.io/pricing . Select the preferred pricing plan (a free option is available). Complete the sign-up process, including the website domain. Step 2: Configure the Cookie Banner Choose between the Fast or Advanced setup. In this example we will choose the Fast Setup : CookiePal offers an already preconfigured the banner. Customise the layout, colors, position, and content text to align with branding and legal requirements using the side bar on the left. Once the colors, layout and alignment have been selected, click "Next" to proceed. Step 3: Copy the Installation Script Once the configuration is complete, choose the preferred option for installation: COPY & PASTE THE CODE Copy the code to integrate the banner into the website. Click on Finish to go to the CookiePal dashboard. Step 4: Insert the Script into the Website Log into the Brilliant Directories Admin Dashboard. Navigate to Toolbox > Widget Manager . Search for the widget titled Bootstrap Theme - Cookie Consent Code . Paste the CookiePal script into the HTML editor. Click Save Changes . Load the website to see the cookie consent: Step 5: Check the Cookies Return to the CookiePal dashboard. Navigate to Cookie Manager . Check the cookies that have been gathered: Necessary, Analytics, Performance, etc. CookiePal auto-classifies most cookies; remaining cookies can be classified manually. Step 6: Troubleshooting and Testing If the cookie banner does not display as expected: Clear the browser cache and cookies. Open the website in a private/incognito browser window. Verify that the script is correctly placed in the widget and saved. results.title: Admin Universal Search | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: Admin Universal Search Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000105576 The Universal Search allows admins to search across the entire website directly from the admin header. The search sits at the top left of every admin page, beside Switch Website : a filter menu (set to All by default) followed by the Search Website... box. Results are filtered based on each admin’s role permissions, ensuring access is limited to authorized data only. A built-in search cache improves speed and performance by storing recent queries per admin and website. Future updates may include a searchable history of recent admin searches for added convenience. How to Search Optionally, choose a content type from the filter menu at the left of the search box (leave it on All to search everything). Click the Search Website... box and type at least two characters. Matching records appear in a panel below the box, grouped by content type, with a count of how many were found. Click a result to open that record. Universal Search Filters The Universal Search is designed to locate specific records quickly, even on websites with a large amount of content. Filters are available to narrow searches to specific areas of the website, helping admins find exactly what is needed without sifting through unrelated results. Selecting a filter before entering a keyword focuses the search on that content type only, which can make the process faster and more precise. Available filters include: Members Single Photo Posts Multi Photo Posts Reviews Leads Form Inquiries Membership Plans Widgets Sidebars Menus Post Settings Forms There is a limit of 10 results per table. Members Locate member profiles by name or email. Single Photo Posts Find posts that feature a single image. Multi Photo Posts Search posts containing multiple images, like event galleries or product showcases. Reviews Access customer or member reviews quickly by keyword. Leads Retrieve lead submissions to track inquiries and follow-ups. Form Inquiries Search messages submitted through contact or custom forms. Membership Plans Locate and manage membership plan settings and details. Widgets Find the custom widgets saved on the site. Sidebars Identify and edit sidebars assigned to various pages. Menus Search for navigation menus to update links and structure. Post Settings Access and adjust configuration options for posts of all types. Forms Locate forms used for signups, submissions, or other interactions. For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . results.title: How To Create A Custom Webhook | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
results.content: How To Create A Custom Webhook Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000105678 A custom webhook sends the data of one specific form, or one specific Smart List, to its own Webhook Link. Use one for a custom form, a customized copy of a default form, a post type form, or a single Smart List. Creating a Custom Webhook Go to Developer Hub and click Manage Webhooks . Click New Webhook . The New Webhook drawer opens. Under Connect to , choose Form or Smart List . Open the Form (or Smart List ) list and pick the one that should send its data. Type in the Filter box at the top of the list to narrow it down. Check the Webhook nickname . It fills in with the form or Smart List name and can be changed. Optionally, add an Internal description as a reminder of what the webhook is for. Click Save . The page reloads and the new webhook is listed under Custom Webhooks . Switch the new webhook on, paste the endpoint address into its Webhook Link , and click Save in the Unsaved changes bar at the top of the page. Connect to : Form or Smart List . The list of forms (or Smart Lists), in A-Z order, with the form's internal name beside each title. Each form appears once; when the website has its own customized copy of a form, that copy is the one listed. A form already connected to a custom webhook is greyed out and marked Used by with that webhook's nickname. Each form or Smart List can have one custom webhook. Cancel and Save . If anything was changed, Cancel asks before discarding it. Connect to : Form or Smart List. Form : the form whose submissions are sent. A form sends its data each time it is submitted; a Smart List sends its records when Sync Webhook Now is clicked or its schedule runs. Webhook nickname : the name shown on the Webhooks page. It is required. Internal description : an optional note, shown under the nickname on the Webhooks page. Save adds the webhook (or saves the changes when editing). If no form or Smart List is chosen, or the nickname is empty, the drawer shows the problem under the field and does not save. To test the webhook, enter a Webhook Link and submit the form, if a form was selected, or sync the Smart List, if a Smart List was selected. For Smart List webhooks and how to connect them see: How To Create Smart List Webhooks Editing or Deleting a Custom Webhook Custom webhooks are listed under Custom Webhooks , in a Forms or a Smart Lists section. Each row has the same switch, Webhook Link and copy button as the default webhooks. The menu button (three dots) beside the switch. Edit opens the drawer to change the form, nickname or description. Delete Webhook removes the webhook. Deleting asks for confirmation. Once deleted, the form's data stops going to the Webhook Link, and this cannot be undone. Save or discard any unsaved changes to Webhook Links before adding, editing or deleting a custom webhook: these actions reload the page, so the page asks for the changes to be saved first. If the form or Smart List a custom webhook was connected to no longer exists, the row is marked Form Not Available or Smart List Not Available . Custom Webhooks for Post Types The default webhooks Standard Post Saved and Photo Album Post Saved send the data of every Single Image and Multi-Image post type. To send one post type to a different link, create a custom webhook for that post type's form (EG Feature - Blog Articles ). That post type then uses the custom webhook, and the other post types keep using the default webhook for their type. Activity Tracker: Logs of the Webhook actions and the information sent can be seen in the Activity Tracker (Dashboard » Activity Tracker), where each one is listed with the Type Webhook. When a webhook is triggered, this is the information logged in the Activity Tracker: its status, Webhook Link, where it was triggered from and the time (1), and the data sent in the Body (2). This example is a custom Smart List webhook run with Sync Webhook Now: When a Smart List webhook is triggered, only the first record sent to the webhook endpoint with a confirmation message that the webhook data was correctly sent is logged. Multi-Value Fields(Checkboxes, Dropdowns, Radial Buttons) All Multi-value fields types like Checkboxes, Dropdowns and Radial buttons will send the normal information and additionally, it will send information about the field Option labels from the front end and database variables. results.content: Quick Create Wizard - Create Post Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000105770 Create a new post By clicking on the Create Post option a pop up wizard will show onscreen. Select the type of content and author you want to publish on your website. Once the admin selected the type of post type type to work on, the option to assign the Post author shows right underneath the post type. With the AI Tool, the admin will be able to create full posts including images, links and formatting following the steps on the wizard. After selecting the Author, The option to generate a post with AI will appear, along with the option to do a manual post. Generate Post with AI Create a good AI prompt with all the required details so the System is guided to create a high quality post. The admin will also be able to select additional options like: Tone style Length Engagement include images additional links to add in the post. Once that is completed, a status bar will show indicating that is currently working on creating the post and within a minute or two, everything is done automatically. Review and Finalize Post Last Step will be to review and post the AI generated on the site, select if the post should be published, and select the post category. For more information about these post categories: How To Add or Edit Categories For Post Types Review the AI-generated content. The Admin will be able edit and add more details once the post is created: Post Created Successfully Once the post is created, the admin will have the ability to Continue editing the post as normal, it will also have the option to start a new AI post. And if the prompt is high quality and the admin would like to use it a template for other posts, the system will guide the admin the chance to copy the prompt for future use: Important Notes For post types like events that have dates and time, the wizard will not set the date and time of the event. To add a date and time to an event created with the wizard, the admin will need to click on continue editing the post directly from the member dashboard. From here, the admin will be able to set the time and date for the event. Generate Post from Scratch The admin can also create a post without AI with the option Start from Scratch From here the admin will be able to complete the details of the post, by adding the title, also selecting the publish status and Post category : Once completed, the wizard will show a confirmation message: For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard .
